````csharp
  9: public partial class Categories
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected ICategoryService CategoryService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;
 14:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = null!;
 15: 
 16:     private HalCollectionResourceOfCategoryListDto? _categoriesResource;
 17:     private string _searchString = string.Empty;
 18:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 19: 
 20:     private IEnumerable<CategoryListDto> FilteredCategories => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString)
 21:         ? _categoriesResource?.Items ?? Enumerable.Empty<CategoryListDto>()
 22:         : _categoriesResource?.Items?.Where(c =>
 23:             (c.FullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
 24:             (c.MasterCode?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
 25:             (c.ParentFullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))
 26:           ?? Enumerable.Empty<CategoryListDto>();
 27: 
 28:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 29:     {
 30:         await LoadCategories();
 31:     }
 32: 
 33:     private async Task LoadCategories()
 34:     {
 35:         _isLoading = true;
 36:         try
 37:         {
 38:             _categoriesResource = await CategoryService.GetCategoriesAsync();
 39:         }
 40:         catch (Exception ex)
 41:         {
 42:             Snackbar.Add($"Failed to load categories: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 43:         }
 44:         finally
 45:         {
 46:             _isLoading = false;
 47:         }
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
 51:     {
 52:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 53:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateCategoryDialog>("Create Category", options);
 54:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 55: 
 56:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateCategoryDto createDto })
 57:         {
 58:             var success = await CategoryService.CreateCategoryAsync(createDto);
 59:             if (success)
 60:             {
 61:                 Snackbar.Add($"Category '{createDto.FullName}' created successfully", Severity.Success);
 62:                 await LoadCategories();
 63:             }
 64:             else
 65:             {
 66:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to create category.", Severity.Error);
 67:             }
 68:         }
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(CategoryListDto category)
 72:     {
 73:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditCategoryDialog>
 74:         {
 75:             { x => x.ExistingCategory, category }
 76:         };
 77: 
 78:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 79:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditCategoryDialog>("Edit Category", parameters, options);
 80:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 81: 
 82:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateCategoryDto updateDto })
 83:         {
 84:             var success = await CategoryService.UpdateCategoryAsync(updateDto.Id, updateDto);
 85:             if (success)
 86:             {
 87:                 Snackbar.Add($"Category '{updateDto.FullName}' updated successfully", Severity.Success);
 88:                 await LoadCategories();
 89:             }
 90:             else
 91:             {
 92:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to update category.", Severity.Error);
 93:             }
 94:         }
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     private async Task DeleteCategory(CategoryListDto category)
 98:     {
 99:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
100:             "Confirm Delete",
101:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the category '{category.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
102:             yesText: "Delete",
103:             cancelText: "Cancel");
104: 
105:         if (confirm == true)
106:         {
107:             var success = await CategoryService.DeleteCategoryAsync(category.Id);
108:             if (success)
109:             {
110:                 Snackbar.Add($"Category '{category.FullName}' deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
111:                 await LoadCategories();
112:             }
113:             else
114:             {
115:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete category '{category.FullName}'", Severity.Error);
116:             }
117:         }
118:     }
119: }
````

````csharp
40:     private string GetFormatIcon(string? masterCode)
41:     {
42:         return masterCode?.ToUpperInvariant() switch
43:         {
44:             "LOCAL" or "IN_PERSON" or "INPERSON" => Icons.Material.Filled.Place,
45:             "DIGITAL" or "ONLINE" or "VIRTUAL" => Icons.Material.Filled.Videocam,
46:             "HYBRID" => Icons.Material.Filled.Sync,
47:             _ => Icons.Material.Filled.Event
48:         };
49:     }
50: }
````

````csharp
 24:             (t.MasterCode?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))
 25:           ?? Enumerable.Empty<TagListDto>();
 26:

 52:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateTagDialog>("Create Tag", options);

 83:         };
 84: 
 85:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 86:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditTagDialog>("Edit Tag", parameters, options);
 87:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 88: 
 89:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateTagDto updateDto })
 90:         {
 91:             var response = await TagService.UpdateTagAsync(updateDto.Id, updateDto);
 92:             if (response?.Success == true)
 93:             {
 94:                 Snackbar.Add($"Tag '{updateDto.FullName}' updated successfully", Severity.Success);
 95:                 await LoadTags();
 96:             }
 97:             else
 98:             {
 99:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
100:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to update tag: {errors}", Severity.Error);
101:             }
102:         }
103:     }
104: 
105:     private async Task DeleteTag(TagListDto tag)
106:     {
107:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
108:             "Confirm Delete",
109:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the tag '{tag.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
110:             yesText: "Delete",
111:             cancelText: "Cancel");
112: 
113:         if (confirm == true)
114:         {
115:             var success = await TagService.DeleteTagAsync(tag.Id);
116:             if (success)
117:             {
118:                 Snackbar.Add($"Tag '{tag.FullName}' deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
119:                 await LoadTags();
120:             }
121:             else
122:             {
123:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete tag '{tag.FullName}'", Severity.Error);
124:             }
125:         }
126:     }
127: }
````

````csharp
375:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
376:     {
377:         if (!ValidateForm())
378:         {
379:             Snackbar.Add(errorMessage, Severity.Error);
380:             return;
381:         }
382: 
383: 
384:         if (_isUploadingImage)
385:         {
386:             Snackbar.Add("Please wait for the image upload to complete.", Severity.Warning);
387:             return;
388:         }
389: 
390:         if (isProcessing) return;
391:         isProcessing = true;
392:         errorMessage = string.Empty;
393:         StateHasChanged();
394: 
395:         try
396:         {
397: 
398:             Guid? featuredImageId = _uploadedImageStorageObjectId;
399: 
400:             if (featuredImageId.HasValue)
401:             {
402:                 Logger.LogInformation("Using pre-uploaded image. StorageObjectId: {StorageObjectId}", featuredImageId);
403:             }
404: 
405: 
406:             createDto.OrganizationId = OrganizationId;
407:             createDto.FeaturedImageId = featuredImageId;
408:             createDto.MadhabId = selectedMadhabId;
409: 
410: 
411:             var earliestStart = sessions.Min(s => DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(s.StartTime));
412:             var latestEnd = sessions.Max(s => DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(s.EndTime));
413: 
414:             createDto.FirstSessionDate = earliestStart;
415:             createDto.LastSessionDate = latestEnd;
416: 
417: 
418:             Logger.LogInformation("Creating event record");
419:             var response = await EventService.CreateEventAsync(createDto);
420: 
421:             if (response?.Success == true && response.Id != Guid.Empty)
422:             {
423:                 createdEventId = response.Id;
424:                 Logger.LogInformation("Event created with ID: {EventId}", createdEventId);
425: 
426: 
427:                 var tenantId = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001");
428:                 foreach (var categoryId in selectedCategoryIds)
429:                 {
430:                     await CategoryService.AssignCategoryToEventAsync(new CreateEventCategoriesDto
431:                     {
432:                         EventId = createdEventId,
433:                         CategoryId = categoryId,
434:                         TenantId = tenantId
435:                     });
436:                 }
437: 
438: 
439:                 foreach (var tagId in selectedTagIds)
440:                 {
441:                     await TagService.AssignTagToEventAsync(new CreateEventTagsDto
442:                     {
443:                         EventId = createdEventId,
444:                         TagId = tagId,
445:                         TenantId = tenantId
446:                     });
447:                 }
448: 
449: 
450:                 var existingSessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(createdEventId);
451:                 var defaultSession = existingSessions?.FirstOrDefault();
452: 
453: 
454:                 if (defaultSession != null && sessions.Count > 0)
455:                 {
456:                     var firstSessionModel = sessions[0];
457:                     firstSessionModel.Id = defaultSession.Id;
458: 
459:                     var updateDto = firstSessionModel.ToUpdateDto(createdEventId);
460:                     await EventService.UpdateSessionAsync(updateDto);
461: 
462:                     await SaveSessionLanguages(firstSessionModel, defaultSession.Id, tenantId);
463:                 }
464: 
465: 
466:                 for (int i = 1; i < sessions.Count; i++)
467:                 {
468:                     var sessionModel = sessions[i];
469:                     var createSessionDto = sessionModel.ToCreateDto(createdEventId, tenantId);
470:                     var createResponse = await EventService.CreateSessionAsync(createSessionDto);
471: 
472:                     if (createResponse?.Success == true)
473:                     {
474:                          await SaveSessionLanguages(sessionModel, createResponse.Id, tenantId);
475:                     }
476:                 }
477: 
478:                 Snackbar.Add("Event created successfully!", Severity.Success);
479:                 Navigation.NavigateTo($"/event/detail/{createdEventId}");
480:             }
481:             else
482:             {
483:                 var errorMsg = response?.Message ?? "Failed to create event.";
484:                 if (response?.Errors != null && response.Errors.Any())
485:                 {
486:                     errorMsg += " Errors: " + string.Join(", ", response.Errors);
487:                 }
488:                 errorMessage = errorMsg;
489:                 Snackbar.Add(errorMessage, Severity.Error);
490:             }
491:         }
492:         catch (Exception ex)
493:         {
494:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during event creation");
495:             errorMessage = $"Error creating event: {ex.Message}";
496:         }
497:         finally
498:         {
499:             isProcessing = false;
500:             StateHasChanged();
501:         }
502:     }

505:     {

513:                     {

516:                         TenantId = tenantId

522:     }

525:     private void AddSession()
526:     {
527: 
528:         var defaultStart = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1).AddHours(9);
529:         var defaultEnd = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1).AddHours(17);
530: 
531: 
532:         if (sessions.Any())
533:         {
534:             var last = sessions.Last();
535:             defaultStart = last.StartTime.AddDays(1);
536:             defaultEnd = last.EndTime.AddDays(1);
537:         }
538: 
539:         sessions.Add(new SessionEditorModel
540:         {
541:             StartTime = defaultStart,
542:             EndTime = defaultEnd,
543: 
544:             RegistrationModeId = sessions.FirstOrDefault()?.RegistrationModeId ?? 1
545:         });
546:     }
547: 
548:     private async void RemoveSession(int index)
549:     {
550:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
551:         {
552:             if (sessions.Count <= 1)
553:             {
554:                 Snackbar.Add("You must have at least one session.", Severity.Warning);
555:                 return;
556:             }
557: 
558:             var session = sessions[index];
559: 
560:             if (session.Id.HasValue && session.Id != Guid.Empty)
561:             {
562:                 bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
563:                     "Delete Session",
564:                     "This session already exists. Deleting it here will remove it permanently. Continue?",
565:                     yesText: "Delete", cancelText: "Cancel");
566: 
567:                 if (confirm == true)
568:                 {
569:                     try
570:                     {
571:                         await EventService.DeleteSessionAsync(session.Id.Value);
572:                         sessions.RemoveAt(index);
573:                         StateHasChanged();
574:                     }
575:                     catch (Exception ex)
576:                     {
577:                         Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete session: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
578:                     }
579:                 }
580:             }
581:             else
582:             {
583:                 sessions.RemoveAt(index);
584:                 StateHasChanged();
585:             }
586:         }
587:     }
588: 
589:     private void OnSessionChanged(int index, SessionEditorModel session)
590:     {
591:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
592:         {
593:             sessions[index] = session;
594:         }
595:     }
596: 
597:     private string GetBackButtonText() => "Back to Organization";
598: 
599:     private string GetStepDescription() => "Fill in event details and add sessions below.";
600: }
````

````csharp
61:     {

68:     private IEnumerable<List<T>> Chunk<T>(IEnumerable<T> source, int size)
69:     {
70:         var bucket = new List<T>(size);
71:         foreach (var item in source)
72:         {
73:             bucket.Add(item);
74:             if (bucket.Count == size)
75:             {
76:                 yield return bucket;
77:                 bucket = new List<T>(size);
78:             }
79:         }
80:         if (bucket.Count > 0) yield return bucket;
````

````csharp
 96: 
 97:     private static bool CanCreateEvents(OrganizationListDto org)
 98:     {
 99:         return org.CurrentUserRole.HasValue &&
100:                org.CurrentUserRole.Value is 1 or 2 or 3;
101:     }
102: 
103: 
104: 
105: 
106:     private static Color GetOrganizationColor(string? name)
107:     {
108:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) return Color.Primary;
109:         var colors = new[] { Color.Primary, Color.Secondary, Color.Tertiary, Color.Info, Color.Success, Color.Warning };
110:         return colors[Math.Abs(name.GetHashCode()) % colors.Length];
111:     }
112: 
113: 
114: 
115: 
116:     private static Color GetRoleColor(int roleId)
117:     {
118:         return roleId switch
119:         {
120:             1 => Color.Warning,
121:             2 => Color.Success,
122:             3 => Color.Info,
123:             4 => Color.Default,
124:             5 => Color.Default,
125:             6 => Color.Default,
126:             _ => Color.Default
127:         };
128:     }
129: 
130: 
131: 
132: 
133:     private static string GetRoleName(int roleId)
134:     {
135:         return roleId switch
136:         {
137:             1 => "Creator",
138:             2 => "Co-Owner",
139:             3 => "Admin",
140:             4 => "Moderator",
141:             5 => "Member",
142:             6 => "Viewer",
143:             _ => "Member"
144:         };
145:     }
146: 
147: 
148: 
149: 
150:     private static string GetInitials(string? name)
151:     {
152:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return "O";
153: 
154:         var words = name.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
155:         return words.Length switch
156:         {
157:             0 => "O",
158:             1 => words[0][..Math.Min(2, words[0].Length)].ToUpperInvariant(),
159:             _ => $"{words[0][0]}{words[1][0]}".ToUpperInvariant()
160:         };
161:     }
162: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/User/MyRegistrations.razor.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
  5: using MudBlazor;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.User;
  8: 
  9: public partial class MyRegistrations
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected IEventService EventService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;
 14:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 15:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Navigation { get; set; } = null!;
 16: 
 17:     private List<MyRegistrationViewModel> _registrations = new();
 18:     private bool _loading = true;
 19:     private string _searchString = "";
 20: 
 21:     private IEnumerable<MyRegistrationViewModel> FilteredRegistrations =>
 22:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString)
 23:             ? _registrations
 24:             : _registrations.Where(r => r.EventTitle?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true);
 25: 
 26:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 27:     {
 28:         await LoadRegistrations();
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     private async Task LoadRegistrations()
 32:     {
 33:         _loading = true;
 34:         try
 35:         {
 36:             var user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
 37:             if (user != null)
 38:             {
 39:                 var registrations = await EventService.GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(user.Id);
 40: 
 41:                 var tasks = registrations.Select(async r =>
 42:                 {
 43:                     var vm = new MyRegistrationViewModel
 44:                     {
 45:                         RegistrationId = r.Id,
 46:                         EventSessionId = r.EventSessionId,
 47:                         Status = r.ApprovalStatusFullName,
 48:                         StatusId = r.ApprovalStatusId
 49:                     };
 50: 
 51:                     var session = await EventService.GetSessionByIdAsync(r.EventSessionId);
 52:                     if (session != null)
 53:                     {
 54:                         vm.EventId = session.EventId;
 55:                         vm.EventTitle = session.EventTitle;
 56:                         vm.StartTime = session.StartTime;
 57: 
 58:                         var evt = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(session.EventId);
 59:                         if (evt != null)
 60:                         {
 61:                             vm.FeaturedImageUri = evt.FeaturedImageUri;
 62:                             vm.EventTitle = evt.Title;
 63:                         }
 64:                     }
 65: 
 66:                     return vm;
 67:                 });
 68: 
 69:                 _registrations = (await Task.WhenAll(tasks)).ToList();
 70:             }
 71:         }
 72:         catch (Exception ex)
 73:         {
 74:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading registrations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 75:         }
 76:         finally
 77:         {
 78:             _loading = false;
 79:         }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     private async Task CancelRegistration(Guid registrationId)
 83:     {
 84:         var result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
 85:             "Cancel Registration",
 86:             "Are you sure you want to cancel your registration for this event?",
 87:             yesText: "Yes, Cancel", cancelText: "No");
 88: 
 89:         if (result == true)
 90:         {
 91:             try
 92:             {
 93:                 var success = await EventService.CancelEventRegistrationAsync(registrationId);
 94:                 if (success)
 95:                 {
 96:                     Snackbar.Add("Registration cancelled successfully.", Severity.Success);
 97:                     await LoadRegistrations();
````

````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Models
 3: @inject IAuthStateService AuthStateService
 4: @inject ILogger<TenantContextProvider> Logger
 5:

 7:     @ChildContent

14:     private TenantContext _tenantContext = new();
15: 
16:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
17:     {
18:         try
19:         {
20:             // Check if user is authenticated before loading tenant context
21:             var isAuthenticated = await AuthStateService.IsAuthenticatedAsync();
22: 
23:             if (isAuthenticated)
24:             {
25:                 // Load tenant ID and user ID from auth context
26:                 _tenantContext.TenantId = await AuthStateService.GetCurrentTenantIdAsync();
27:                 _tenantContext.UserId = await AuthStateService.GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
28:                 _tenantContext.IsAuthenticated = true;
29: 
30:                 Logger.LogInformation("Tenant context initialized: TenantId={TenantId}, UserId={UserId}",
31:                     _tenantContext.TenantId, _tenantContext.UserId);
32:             }
33:             else
34:             {
35:                 // User is not authenticated - set default values
36:                 _tenantContext.IsAuthenticated = false;
37:                 Logger.LogDebug("User is not authenticated - tenant context not loaded");
38:             }
39:         }
40:         catch (UnauthorizedAccessException ex)
41:         {
42:             // Expected for non-authenticated users
43:             Logger.LogDebug(ex, "User is not authenticated");
44:             _tenantContext.IsAuthenticated = false;
45:         }
46:         catch (Exception ex)
47:         {
48:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to initialize tenant context");
49:             _tenantContext.IsAuthenticated = false;
50:         }
51:     }
52: }
````

````csharp
 31: 
 32: public class AuthStateService : IAuthStateService
 33: {
 34:     private readonly AuthenticationStateProvider _authenticationStateProvider;
 35:     private readonly ILogger<AuthStateService> _logger;
 36:     private readonly TenantConfiguration _tenantConfig;
 37: 
 38:     public AuthStateService(
 39:         AuthenticationStateProvider authenticationStateProvider,
 40:         ILogger<AuthStateService> logger,
 41:         IOptions<TenantConfiguration> tenantConfig)
 42:     {
 43:         _authenticationStateProvider = authenticationStateProvider;
 44:         _logger = logger;
 45:         _tenantConfig = tenantConfig?.Value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tenantConfig));
 46: 
 47: 
 48:         if (!_tenantConfig.IsValid())
 49:         {
 50:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
 51:                 "Invalid tenant configuration. DefaultTenantId and DefaultTenant must be set.");
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public async Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync()
 56:     {
 57:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 58:         var user = authState.User;
 59: 
 60:         if (!user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
 61:         {
 62:             _logger.LogWarning("Attempted to get user ID for unauthenticated user");
 63:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User is not authenticated");
 64:         }
 65: 
 66: 
 67:         var userId = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
 68:                      ?? user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
 69:                      ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
 70:                      ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
 71: 
 72:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
 73:         {
 74:             _logger.LogError("User ID not found in JWT claims for authenticated user. Available claims: {Claims}",
 75:                 string.Join(", ", user.Claims.Select(c => c.Type)));
 76:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User ID not found in token claims");
 77:         }
 78: 
 79:         return userId;
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     public async Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync()
 83:     {
 84:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 85:         var user = authState.User;
 86: 
 87:         if (!user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
 88:         {
 89:             _logger.LogWarning("Attempted to get tenant ID for unauthenticated user");
 90:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User is not authenticated");
 91:         }
 92: 
 93: 
 94: 
 95:         if (!_tenantConfig.Enabled)
 96:         {
 97:             _logger.LogDebug("Single-tenant mode: Using default tenant {TenantId}", _tenantConfig.DefaultTenantId);
 98:             return _tenantConfig.DefaultTenantId;
 99:         }
100: 
101: 
102:         _logger.LogDebug("Multi-tenant mode: Extracting tenant from user claims");
103: 
104: 
105:         var tenantIdString = user.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value
106:                             ?? user.FindFirst("tenantId")?.Value
107:                             ?? user.FindFirst("tid")?.Value
108:                             ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/tenantid")?.Value;
109: 
110:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantIdString))
111:         {
112: 
113:             _logger.LogError("Multi-tenant mode enabled but tenant ID not found in claims. Available claims: {Claims}",
114:                 string.Join(", ", user.Claims.Select(c => c.Type)));
115:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
116:                 "Multi-tenant mode is enabled but no tenant ID found in user claims. " +
117:                 "Ensure your identity provider includes tenant_id claim.");
118:         }
119: 
120:         if (!Guid.TryParse(tenantIdString, out var tenantId))
121:         {
122:             _logger.LogError("Invalid tenant ID format in claims: {TenantId}", tenantIdString);
123:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid tenant ID format: {tenantIdString}");
124:         }
125: 
126:         _logger.LogDebug("Multi-tenant mode: Using tenant {TenantId} from claims", tenantId);
127:         return tenantId;
128:     }
129: 
130:     public async Task<bool> IsAuthenticatedAsync()
131:     {
132:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
133:         return authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
134:     }
135: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/BffAuthenticationStateProvider.cs
````csharp
  1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Http;
  4: using System.Net.Http.Json;
  5: using System.Security.Claims;
  6: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Models;
  7: 
  8: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: public class PersistentAuthenticationStateProvider : AuthenticationStateProvider
 16: {
 17:     private static readonly Task<AuthenticationState> DefaultUnauthenticatedTask =
 18:         Task.FromResult(new AuthenticationState(new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity())));
 19: 
 20:     private readonly Task<AuthenticationState> _authenticationStateTask;
 21:     private readonly ILogger<PersistentAuthenticationStateProvider> _logger;
 22: 
 23:     public PersistentAuthenticationStateProvider(
 24:         PersistentComponentState state,
 25:         IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory,
 26:         ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
 27:     {
 28:         _logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<PersistentAuthenticationStateProvider>();
 29: 
 30: 
 31:         if (state.TryTakeFromJson<UserInfo>(nameof(UserInfo), out var userInfo) && userInfo is not null)
 32:         {
 33:             _logger.LogInformation("[CLIENT AUTH] Restored auth state from PersistentComponentState for user: {Name}", userInfo.Name);
 34:             _authenticationStateTask = Task.FromResult(CreateAuthenticationState(userInfo));
 35:         }
 36:         else
 37:         {
 38: 
 39:             _logger.LogInformation("[CLIENT AUTH] No persisted auth state found, fetching from /bff/me");
 40:             _authenticationStateTask = FetchAuthStateFromBffAsync(httpClientFactory);
 41:         }
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     private async Task<AuthenticationState> FetchAuthStateFromBffAsync(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory)
 45:     {
 46:         try
 47:         {
 48:             var httpClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient");
 49: 
 50:             _logger.LogDebug("[CLIENT AUTH] Making request to /bff/me");
 51:             var response = await httpClient.GetAsync("/bff/me");
 52: 
 53:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
 54:             {
 55:                 var bffUserInfo = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<BffUserInfoResponse>();
 56: 
 57:                 if (bffUserInfo?.Name != null)
 58:                 {
 59:                     _logger.LogInformation("[CLIENT AUTH] Authenticated via /bff/me: {Name}", bffUserInfo.Name);
 60: 
 61: 
 62:                     var userInfo = new UserInfo
 63:                     {
 64:                         UserId = bffUserInfo.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == "sub")?.Value
 65:                                 ?? bffUserInfo.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
 66:                                 ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
 67:                         Name = bffUserInfo.Name,
 68:                         Email = bffUserInfo.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == "email" || c.Type == ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value,
 69:                         Claims = bffUserInfo.Claims?
 70:                             .Where(c => c.Type != "sub" && c.Type != "name" && c.Type != "email"
 71:                                      && c.Type != ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier && c.Type != ClaimTypes.Name && c.Type != ClaimTypes.Email)
 72:                             .GroupBy(c => c.Type)
 73:                             .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Value) ?? new Dictionary<string, string>()
 74:                     };
 75: 
 76:                     return CreateAuthenticationState(userInfo);
 77:                 }
 78:                 else
 79:                 {
 80:                     _logger.LogDebug("[CLIENT AUTH] /bff/me returned null name - user is anonymous");
 81:                 }
 82:             }
 83:             else
 84:             {
 85:                 _logger.LogWarning("[CLIENT AUTH] /bff/me returned {StatusCode}", response.StatusCode);
 86:             }
 87:         }
 88:         catch (HttpRequestException ex)
 89:         {
 90:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "[CLIENT AUTH] HTTP error fetching auth state from /bff/me");
 91:         }
 92:         catch (Exception ex)
 93:         {
 94:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[CLIENT AUTH] Unexpected error fetching auth state from /bff/me");
 95:         }
 96: 
 97: 
 98:         _logger.LogDebug("[CLIENT AUTH] Returning anonymous authentication state");
 99:         return new AuthenticationState(new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity()));
100:     }
101: 
102:     private AuthenticationState CreateAuthenticationState(UserInfo userInfo)
103:     {
104:         var claims = new List<Claim>
105:         {
106:             new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, userInfo.UserId),
107:             new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, userInfo.Name),
108:         };
109: 
110:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userInfo.Email))
111:         {
112:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, userInfo.Email));
113:         }
114: 
115: 
116:         foreach (var claim in userInfo.Claims)
117:         {
118:             claims.Add(new Claim(claim.Key, claim.Value));
119:         }
120: 
121:         return new AuthenticationState(new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims, "BffAuthentication")));
122:     }
123: 
124:     public override Task<AuthenticationState> GetAuthenticationStateAsync() => _authenticationStateTask;
125: 
126: 
127:     private class BffUserInfoResponse
128:     {
129:         public string? Name { get; set; }
130:         public List<BffClaimResponse>? Claims { get; set; }
131:     }
132: 
133:     private class BffClaimResponse
134:     {
135:         public string Type { get; set; } = string.Empty;
136:         public string Value { get; set; } = string.Empty;
137:     }
138: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/BffUnauthorizedHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Net;
 2: using System.Net.Http;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
 6: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 7: 
 8: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 9: 
10: public sealed class BffUnauthorizedHandler : DelegatingHandler
11: {
12:     private readonly NavigationManager _nav;
13:     private readonly ILogger<BffUnauthorizedHandler> _logger;
14: 
15:     public BffUnauthorizedHandler(NavigationManager nav, ILogger<BffUnauthorizedHandler> logger)
16:     {
17:         _nav = nav;
18:         _logger = logger;
19:     }
20: 
21:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
22:     {
23:         HttpResponseMessage response;
24:         try
25:         {
26:             response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
27:         }
28:         catch (Exception ex)
29:         {
30:             _logger.LogError(ex, "BFF handler: request failed for {Method} {Uri}", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
31:             throw;
32:         }
33: 
34:         if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
35:         {
36:             var path = request.RequestUri?.AbsolutePath ?? string.Empty;
37: 
38: 
39: 
40:             var isApiCall = path.StartsWith("/api", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
41:             var acceptHtml = request.Headers.Accept?.Any(h => h.MediaType?.Equals("text/html", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true) == true;
42: 
43:             if (!isApiCall && acceptHtml)
44:             {
45: 
46:                 if (!path.StartsWith("/login", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !path.StartsWith("/auth", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
47:                 {
48:                     _logger.LogWarning("BFF handler: received 401 for {Method} {Uri} - redirecting to /login", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
49: 
50: 
51:                     var returnUrl = Uri.EscapeDataString(_nav.ToBaseRelativePath(_nav.Uri));
52:                     var loginUrl = $"/login?returnUrl={returnUrl}";
53: 
54: 
55:                     _nav.NavigateTo(loginUrl, forceLoad: true);
56:                 }
57:             }
58:             else
59:             {
60:                 _logger.LogInformation("BFF handler: received 401 for API or non-HTML request {Method} {Uri} - returning 401 response to client", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
61: 
62:             }
63:         }
64: 
65:         return response;
66:     }
67: }
````

````csharp
13: 
14:     public BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler()
15:     {
16: 
17:     }
18: 
19:     public BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler(ILogger<BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler> logger)
20:     {
21:         _logger = logger;
22:     }
23: 
24:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
25:         HttpRequestMessage request,
26:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
27:     {
28: 
29:         request.SetBrowserRequestCredentials(BrowserRequestCredentials.Include);
30: 
31: 
32:         request.SetBrowserRequestMode(BrowserRequestMode.SameOrigin);
33: 
34:         _logger?.LogDebug("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Credentials: Include, Mode: SameOrigin",
35:             request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
36: 
37:         try
38:         {
39:             var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
40: 
41:             _logger?.LogDebug("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Response: {StatusCode}",
42:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery, (int)response.StatusCode);
43: 
44: 
45:             if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
46:             {
47:                 _logger?.LogWarning("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Unauthorized (401). User may need to re-authenticate.",
48:                     request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
49:             }
50: 
51:             return response;
52:         }
53:         catch (Exception ex)
54:         {
55:             _logger?.LogError(ex, "[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Request failed",
56:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);

58:         }
59:     }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/S3UploadMessageHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Http;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: public class S3UploadMessageHandler : DelegatingHandler
11: {
12:     private readonly ILogger<S3UploadMessageHandler>? _logger;
13: 
14:     public S3UploadMessageHandler()
15:     {
16:     }
17: 
18:     public S3UploadMessageHandler(ILogger<S3UploadMessageHandler> logger)
19:     {
20:         _logger = logger;
21:     }
22: 
23:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
24:         HttpRequestMessage request,
25:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
26:     {
27: 
28: 
29:         request.SetBrowserRequestMode(BrowserRequestMode.Cors);
30: 
31: 
32: 
33:         request.SetBrowserRequestCredentials(BrowserRequestCredentials.Omit);
34: 
35:         _logger?.LogDebug("[S3 Upload] {Method} {Host} - Mode: CORS, Credentials: Omit",
36:             request.Method, request.RequestUri?.Host);
37: 
38:         try
39:         {
40:             var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
41: 
42:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
43:             {
44:                 _logger?.LogWarning("[S3 Upload] {Method} {Uri} - Failed with status {StatusCode}",
45:                     request.Method, request.RequestUri, (int)response.StatusCode);
46:             }
47:             else
48:             {
49:                 _logger?.LogInformation("[S3 Upload] {Method} {Host} - Success ({StatusCode})",
50:                     request.Method, request.RequestUri?.Host, (int)response.StatusCode);
51:             }
52: 
53:             return response;
54:         }
55:         catch (Exception ex)
56:         {
57:             _logger?.LogError(ex, "[S3 Upload] {Method} {Uri} - Request failed with exception",
58:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri);
59:             throw;
60:         }
61:     }
62: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/Dockerfile
````
 1: # Explore.Blazor/Dockerfile
 2: # Multi-stage build with Infisical CLI for secret management
 3: # Supports zero-downtime deployments with Coolify
 4: 
 5: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0 AS base
 6: USER $APP_UID
 7: WORKDIR /app
 8: EXPOSE 8080
 9: EXPOSE 8081
10: 
11: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build
12: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
13: WORKDIR /src
14: 
15: # Copy all project files for restore
16: COPY ["Explore.Blazor/Explore.Blazor.csproj", "Explore.Blazor/"]
17: COPY ["Explore.Blazor.Client/Explore.Blazor.Client.csproj", "Explore.Blazor.Client/"]
18: COPY ["Explore.ServiceDefaults/Explore.ServiceDefaults.csproj", "Explore.ServiceDefaults/"]
19: 
20: RUN dotnet restore "./Explore.Blazor/Explore.Blazor.csproj"
21: COPY . .
22: WORKDIR "/src/Explore.Blazor"
23: RUN dotnet build "./Explore.Blazor.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/build
24: 
25: FROM build AS publish
26: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
27: RUN dotnet publish "./Explore.Blazor.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false
28: 
29: FROM base AS final
30: WORKDIR /app
31: 
32: # 1. Install dos2unix along with Infisical
33: USER root
34: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash curl ca-certificates dos2unix && \
35:     curl -1sLf 'https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/infisical/infisical-cli/setup.deb.sh' | bash && \
36:     apt-get update && apt-get install -y infisical && \
37:     apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
38: 
39: # Copy published application
40: COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
41: 
42: # Copy entrypoint script
43: COPY Explore.Blazor/entrypoint.sh /app/entrypoint.sh
44: 
45: # 2. FIX LINE ENDINGS
46: RUN dos2unix /app/entrypoint.sh && chmod +x /app/entrypoint.sh
47: 
48: # Switch back to non-root user
49: USER $APP_UID
50: 
51: ENTRYPOINT ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/entrypoint.sh
````bash
 1: set -e
 2: 
 3: echo "Starting Explore.Blazor container..."
 4: 
 5: 
 6: if [ -n "$INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID" ] && [ -n "$INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET" ]; then
 7:     echo "Infisical credentials detected, fetching secrets..."
 8: 
 9: 
10:     [ -n "$INFISICAL_SITE_URL" ] && export INFISICAL_API_URL="$INFISICAL_SITE_URL"
11: 
12: 
13:     export INFISICAL_TOKEN=$(infisical login \
14:         --method=universal-auth \
15:         --client-id="$INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID" \
16:         --client-secret="$INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET" \
17:         --silent --plain)
18: 
19: 
20:     echo "Loading secrets..."
21:     eval "$(infisical export --env="$INFISICAL_ENV" --projectId="$INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID" --path="/keycloak" --format=dotenv-export)"
22:     eval "$(infisical export --env="$INFISICAL_ENV" --projectId="$INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID" --path="/blazor" --format=dotenv-export)"
23: 
24:     echo "Secrets loaded."
25: else
26:     echo "No Infisical credentials found, using existing environment variables."
27: fi
28: 
29: echo "Starting .NET application..."
30: exec dotnet Explore.Blazor.dll "$@"
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/Extensions/BffApiExtensions.cs
````csharp
  1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpResults;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  3: using System.Text.Json;
  4: 
  5: namespace Explore.Blazor.Extensions;
  6: 
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: public static class BffApiExtensions
 12: {
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16:     public static async Task<IResult> ExecuteAsync<T>(
 17:         Func<Task<T>> apiCall,
 18:         ILogger logger,
 19:         string operationName,
 20:         HttpContext? ctx = null)
 21:     {
 22:         try
 23:         {
 24:             logger.LogInformation("BFF: Executing {Operation}", operationName);
 25:             var result = await apiCall();
 26: 
 27:             logger.LogInformation("BFF: {Operation} completed successfully", operationName);
 28:             return Results.Ok(result);
 29:         }
 30:         catch (ApiException ex)
 31:         {
 32:             logger.LogError(ex, "BFF: {Operation} failed with status {StatusCode}", operationName, ex.StatusCode);
 33: 
 34:             return ex.StatusCode switch
 35:             {
 36:                 401 => Results.Unauthorized(),
 37:                 403 => Results.Problem("Access denied", statusCode: 403),
 38:                 404 => Results.NotFound(),
 39:                 _ => Results.Problem(
 40:                     detail: ex.Response ?? ex.Message,
 41:                     statusCode: ex.StatusCode
 42:                 )
 43:             };
 44:         }
 45:         catch (Exception ex)
 46:         {
 47: 
 48:             if (IsTokenRefreshFailure(ex))
 49:             {
 50:                 logger.LogWarning(ex, "BFF: Token refresh or token retrieval failed during {Operation} - returning 401", operationName);
 51:                 return Results.Unauthorized();
 52:             }
 53: 
 54:             logger.LogError(ex, "BFF: Unexpected error in {Operation}", operationName);
 55:             return Results.Problem(
 56:                 detail: ex.Message,
 57:                 statusCode: 500
 58:             );
 59:         }
 60:     }
 61: 
 62: 
 63: 
 64: 
 65:     public static async Task<IResult> ExecuteVoidAsync(
 66:         Func<Task> apiCall,
 67:         ILogger logger,
 68:         string operationName,
 69:         HttpContext? ctx = null)
 70:     {
 71:         try
 72:         {
 73:             logger.LogInformation("BFF: Executing {Operation}", operationName);
 74:             await apiCall();
 75: 
 76:             logger.LogInformation("BFF: {Operation} completed successfully", operationName);
 77:             return Results.NoContent();
 78:         }
 79:         catch (ApiException ex)
 80:         {
 81:             logger.LogError(ex, "BFF: {Operation} failed with status {StatusCode}", operationName, ex.StatusCode);
 82: 
 83:             return ex.StatusCode switch
 84:             {
 85:                 401 => Results.Unauthorized(),
 86:                 403 => Results.Problem("Access denied", statusCode: 403),
 87:                 404 => Results.NotFound(),
 88:                 _ => Results.Problem(
 89:                     detail: ex.Response ?? ex.Message,
 90:                     statusCode: ex.StatusCode
 91:                 )
 92:             };
 93:         }
 94:         catch (Exception ex)
 95:         {
 96:             if (IsTokenRefreshFailure(ex))
 97:             {
 98:                 logger.LogWarning(ex, "BFF: Token refresh or token retrieval failed during {Operation} - returning 401", operationName);
 99:                 return Results.Unauthorized();
100:             }
101: 
102:             logger.LogError(ex, "BFF: Unexpected error in {Operation}", operationName);
103:             return Results.Problem(
104:                 detail: ex.Message,
105:                 statusCode: 500
106:             );
107:         }
108:     }
109: 
110: 
111: 
112: 
113: 
114:     public static IEventApiClient GetApiClient(this HttpContext context) =>
115:         context.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IEventApiClient>();
116: 
117:     private static bool IsTokenRefreshFailure(Exception ex)
118:     {
119:         while (ex != null)
120:         {
121:             var msg = ex.Message ?? string.Empty;
122: 
123: 
124:             if (msg.Contains("invalid_grant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
125:                 msg.Contains("invalid_token", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
126:                 msg.Contains("refresh", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
127:                 msg.Contains("token", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
128:                 msg.Contains("no tokens", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
129:                 msg.Contains("expired", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
130:             {
131:                 return true;
132:             }
133: 
134:             ex = ex.InnerException;
135:         }
136: 
137:         return false;
138:     }
139: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/Extensions/BffEndpointRoutes.cs
````csharp
 1: using Duende.Bff;
 2: using Duende.Bff.AccessTokenManagement;
 3: using Duende.Bff.Yarp;
 4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
 5: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing;
 6: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 7: 
 8: namespace Explore.Blazor.Extensions;
 9: 
10: public static class BffEndpointRoutes
11: {
12: 
13:     private static readonly string[] PublicOnlyEndpoints =
14:     {
15:         "/api/v1/ImageProxy",
16:         "/api/v1/Event",
17:         "/api/v1/Event/{id}",
18:         "/api/v1/ActorType",
19:         "/api/v1/ApprovalStatus",
20:         "/api/v1/AudienceAge",
21:         "/api/v1/AudienceGender",
22:         "/api/v1/DidCustodyType",
23:         "/api/v1/EventFormat",
24:         "/api/v1/EventStatus",
25:         "/api/v1/EventType",
26:         "/api/v1/FileType",
27:         "/api/v1/Language",
28:         "/api/v1/Madhab",
29:         "/api/v1/OrganizationPosition",
30:         "/api/v1/OrganizationReview",
31:         "/api/v1/OrganizationRole",
32:         "/api/v1/RegistrationMode",
33:         "/api/v1/TagType",
34:         "/api/v1/UserRole",
35:         "/api/v1/VisibilityType"
36:     };
37: 
38: 
39:     private static readonly string[] ProtectedOnlyEndpoints =
40:     {
41:         "/api/v1/OrganizationMember",
42:         "/api/v1/User"
43:     };
44: 
45:     public static void MapExploreApiBffEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app, Uri baseApiUri, ILogger logger)
46:     {
47:         foreach (var pattern in PublicOnlyEndpoints)
48:         {
49:             app.MapRemoteBffApiEndpoint(pattern, baseApiUri)
50:                 .WithAccessToken(RequiredTokenType.None);
51:         }
52: 
53:         foreach (var pattern in ProtectedOnlyEndpoints)
54:         {
55:             app.MapRemoteBffApiEndpoint(pattern, baseApiUri)
56:                 .WithAccessToken(RequiredTokenType.User)
57:                 .RequireAuthorization();
58:         }
59: 
60: 
61:         app.MapRemoteBffApiEndpoint("/api/v1/{**catchall}", baseApiUri)
62:             .WithAccessToken(RequiredTokenType.UserOrNone);
63: 
64:         logger.LogInformation(
65:             "BFF: mapped Explore API routes (public-only: {PublicCount}, protected-only: {ProtectedCount}, hybrid default: /api/v1)",
66:             PublicOnlyEndpoints.Length,
67:             ProtectedOnlyEndpoints.Length);
68:     }
69: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/Extensions/ConfigurationExtension.cs
````csharp
 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 2: 
 3: namespace Explore.Blazor.Extensions;
 4: 
 5: public static class ConfigurationExtensions
 6: {
 7:     public static void AddInfisicalBlazorCompatibility(this IConfigurationBuilder configBuilder)
 8:     {
 9:         var tempConfig = configBuilder.Build();
10: 
11: 
12:         var rawRealm = tempConfig["Keycloak:Realm"] ?? tempConfig["KEYCLOAK_REALM"] ?? "islamu-dev";
13:         var rawClientSecret = tempConfig["EXPLORE_BLAZOR_SERVER_CLIENT_SECRET_COOLIFY"];
14:         var rawApiUrl = tempConfig["EXPLORE_API_BASE_URL"];
15:         var baseUrl = tempConfig["KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL"]
16:             ?? tempConfig["KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL"]
17:             ?? "https://keycloak.openislamu.org";
18:         var explicitAuthority = tempConfig["Keycloak:Authority"];
19: 
20: 
21:         var keycloakAuthority = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(explicitAuthority)
22:             ? explicitAuthority
23:             : $"{baseUrl.TrimEnd('/')}/realms/{rawRealm}";
24: 
25:         var mappedConfig = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
26: 
27:         static void TrySet(IDictionary<string, string?> config, IConfiguration root, string key, string? value)
28:         {
29:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(root[key]))
30:             {
31:                 return;
32:             }
33: 
34:             config[key] = value;
35:         }
36: 
37: 
38:         TrySet(mappedConfig, tempConfig, "Keycloak:Authority", keycloakAuthority);
39:         TrySet(mappedConfig, tempConfig, "Keycloak:ClientId", "explore-blazor-server");
40:         TrySet(mappedConfig, tempConfig, "Keycloak:ClientSecret", rawClientSecret);
41:         TrySet(mappedConfig, tempConfig, "Keycloak:RequireHttpsMetadata", "true");
42: 
43: 
44: 
45: 
46:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawApiUrl))
47:         {
48:             TrySet(mappedConfig, tempConfig, "ExploreApi:BaseUrl", rawApiUrl);
49:         }
50: 
51: 
52: 
53: 
54: 
55: 
56: 
57:         configBuilder.AddInMemoryCollection(
58:             mappedConfig.Where(kv => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(kv.Value))
59:                         .ToDictionary(kv => kv.Key, kv => kv.Value)!
60:         );
61:     }
62: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/Services/PersistingServerAuthenticationStateProvider.cs
````csharp
  1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server;
  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web;
  5: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
  6: using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
  7: using System.Diagnostics;
  8: using System.Security.Claims;
  9: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Models;
 10: 
 11: namespace Explore.Blazor.Services;
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: public sealed class PersistingServerAuthenticationStateProvider : ServerAuthenticationStateProvider, IDisposable
 18: {
 19:     private readonly PersistentComponentState _state;
 20:     private readonly ILogger<PersistingServerAuthenticationStateProvider> _logger;
 21:     private readonly PersistingComponentStateSubscription _subscription;
 22: 
 23:     private Task<AuthenticationState>? _authenticationStateTask;
 24: 
 25:     public PersistingServerAuthenticationStateProvider(
 26:         PersistentComponentState state,
 27:         ILogger<PersistingServerAuthenticationStateProvider> logger)
 28:     {
 29:         _state = state;
 30:         _logger = logger;
 31: 
 32: 
 33:         _subscription = state.RegisterOnPersisting(OnPersistingAsync, RenderMode.InteractiveWebAssembly);
 34: 
 35: 
 36:         AuthenticationStateChanged += OnAuthenticationStateChanged;
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     private void OnAuthenticationStateChanged(Task<AuthenticationState> task)
 40:     {
 41:         _authenticationStateTask = task;
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     private async Task OnPersistingAsync()
 45:     {
 46:         if (_authenticationStateTask is null)
 47:         {
 48:             _logger.LogDebug("[PERSIST AUTH] No authentication state task available");
 49:             throw new UnreachableException($"Authentication state not set in {nameof(OnPersistingAsync)}().");
 50:         }
 51: 
 52:         var authenticationState = await _authenticationStateTask;
 53:         var principal = authenticationState.User;
 54: 
 55:         if (principal.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
 56:         {
 57:             var userId = principal.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
 58:                       ?? principal.FindFirst("sub")?.Value;
 59:             var name = principal.Identity.Name;
 60:             var email = principal.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value
 61:                      ?? principal.FindFirst("email")?.Value;
 62: 
 63:             if (userId != null && name != null)
 64:             {
 65: 
 66:                 var claims = new Dictionary<string, string>();
 67:                 foreach (var claim in principal.Claims)
 68:                 {
 69: 
 70:                     if (claim.Type == ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier ||
 71:                         claim.Type == "sub" ||
 72:                         claim.Type == ClaimTypes.Name ||
 73:                         claim.Type == "name" ||
 74:                         claim.Type == ClaimTypes.Email ||
 75:                         claim.Type == "email")
 76:                     {
 77:                         continue;
 78:                     }
 79: 
 80: 
 81:                     if (!claims.ContainsKey(claim.Type))
 82:                     {
 83:                         claims[claim.Type] = claim.Value;
 84:                     }
 85:                 }
 86: 
 87:                 var userInfo = new UserInfo
 88:                 {
 89:                     UserId = userId,
 90:                     Name = name,
 91:                     Email = email,
 92:                     Claims = claims
 93:                 };
 94: 
 95:                 _logger.LogInformation("[PERSIST AUTH] Persisting auth state for user: {Name} (ID: {UserId})", name, userId);
 96:                 _state.PersistAsJson(nameof(UserInfo), userInfo);
 97:             }
 98:             else
 99:             {
100:                 _logger.LogWarning("[PERSIST AUTH] User is authenticated but missing required claims (UserId: {UserId}, Name: {Name})", userId, name);
101:             }
102:         }
103:         else
104:         {
105:             _logger.LogDebug("[PERSIST AUTH] User is not authenticated, not persisting auth state");
106:         }
107:     }
108: 
109:     public void Dispose()
110:     {
111:         _subscription.Dispose();
112:         AuthenticationStateChanged -= OnAuthenticationStateChanged;
113:     }
114: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/Services/ServerCookieForwardingHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Net.Http;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
 5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Services;
 8: 
 9: public sealed class ServerCookieForwardingHandler : DelegatingHandler
10: {
11:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
12:     private readonly ILogger<ServerCookieForwardingHandler> _logger;
13: 
14:     public ServerCookieForwardingHandler(
15:         IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
16:         ILogger<ServerCookieForwardingHandler> logger)
17:     {
18:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
19:         _logger = logger;
20:     }
21: 
22:     protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
23:         HttpRequestMessage request,
24:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
25:     {
26:         var context = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;
27:         if (context == null)
28:         {
29:             return base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
30:         }
31: 
32:         var cookieHeader = context.Request.Headers.Cookie.ToString();
33:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cookieHeader) && !request.Headers.Contains("Cookie"))
34:         {
35:             request.Headers.Add("Cookie", cookieHeader);
36:         }
37: 
38:         return base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
39:     }
40: }
````
