## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/DeleteEventDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  5: 
  6: <MudDialog>
  7:     <TitleContent>
  8:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
  9:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Warning" Color="Color.Error" Class="mr-2" />
 10:             Delete Event
 11:         </MudText>
 12:     </TitleContent>
 13:     <DialogContent>
 14:         @if (_isLoading)
 15:         {
 16:             <div class="d-flex align-center justify-center pa-4">
 17:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
 18:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="ml-3">Loading event details...</MudText>
 19:             </div>
 20:         }
 21:         else
 22:         {
 23:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">
 24:                 Are you sure you want to delete the event "<strong>@EventTitle</strong>"?
 25:             </MudText>
 26: 
 27:             @if (_sessionCount > 0)
 28:             {
 29:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Dense="true" Class="mb-3">
 30:                     This event has <strong>@_sessionCount</strong> @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions") that will also be deleted.
 31:                 </MudAlert>
 32:             }
 33: 
 34:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Dense="true">
 35:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 36:                     <strong>This action cannot be undone.</strong>
 37:                 </MudText>
 38:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mt-2">
 39:                     The following will be permanently deleted:
 40:                 </MudText>
 41:                 <ul class="mt-1 mb-0">
 42:                     <li>Event details and metadata</li>
 43:                     @if (_sessionCount > 0)
 44:                     {
 45:                         <li>@_sessionCount event @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions")</li>
 46:                         <li>All registrations for @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "this session" : "these sessions")</li>
 47:                     }
 48:                 </ul>
 49:             </MudAlert>
 50:         }
 51:     </DialogContent>
 52:     <DialogActions>
 53:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel" Variant="Variant.Text" Disabled="@_isDeleting">Cancel</MudButton>
 54:         <MudButton Color="Color.Error"
 55:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 56:                    OnClick="ConfirmDelete"
 57:                    Disabled="@(_isDeleting || _isLoading)"
 58:                    StartIcon="@(_isDeleting ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassBottom : Icons.Material.Filled.Delete)">
 59:             @(_isDeleting ? "Deleting..." : "Delete Event")
 60:         </MudButton>
 61:     </DialogActions>
 62: </MudDialog>
 63: 
 64: @code {
 65:     [CascadingParameter]
 66:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
 67: 
 68:     [Parameter]
 69:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 70: 
 71:     [Parameter]
 72:     public string EventTitle { get; set; } = "";
 73: 
 74:     [Inject]
 75:     private IEventService EventService { get; set; } = default!;
 76: 
 77:     [Inject]
 78:     private ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = default!;
 79: 
 80:     [Inject]
 81:     private ILogger<DeleteEventDialog> Logger { get; set; } = default!;
 82: 
 83:     private bool _isDeleting = false;
 84:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 85:     private int _sessionCount = 0;
 86: 
 87:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 88:     {
 89:         await LoadSessionCount();
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     private async Task LoadSessionCount()
 93:     {
 94:         _isLoading = true;
 95:         StateHasChanged();
 96: 
 97:         try
 98:         {
 99:             var sessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
100:             _sessionCount = sessions?.Count ?? 0;
101:             Logger.LogDebug("Loaded {SessionCount} sessions for event {EventId}", _sessionCount, EventId);
102:         }
103:         catch (Exception ex)
104:         {
105:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading session count for event {EventId}", EventId);
106:             // Continue anyway - deletion should still work even if we can't load session count
107:             _sessionCount = 0;
108:         }
109:         finally
110:         {
111:             _isLoading = false;
112:             StateHasChanged();
113:         }
114:     }
115: 
116:     private void Cancel()
117:     {
118:         Logger.LogDebug("Delete cancelled for event {EventId}", EventId);
119:         MudDialog.Cancel();
120:     }
121: 
122:     private async Task ConfirmDelete()
123:     {
124:         if (_isDeleting || _isLoading) return;
125: 
126:         _isDeleting = true;
127:         StateHasChanged();
128: 
129:         try
130:         {
131:             Logger.LogInformation("Attempting to delete event {EventId} with {SessionCount} sessions", EventId, _sessionCount);
132: 
133:             var success = await EventService.DeleteEventAsync(EventId);
134: 
135:             if (success)
136:             {
137:                 var message = _sessionCount > 0
138:                     ? $"Event and {_sessionCount} {(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions")} deleted successfully"
139:                     : "Event deleted successfully";
140: 
141:                 Logger.LogInformation("Successfully deleted event {EventId}", EventId);
142:                 Snackbar.Add(message, Severity.Success);
143:                 MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
144:             }
145:             else
146:             {
147:                 Logger.LogWarning("Failed to delete event {EventId} - API returned false", EventId);
148:                 Snackbar.Add("Failed to delete event. You may not have permission or the event may not exist.", Severity.Error);
149:                 _isDeleting = false;
150:                 StateHasChanged();
151:             }
152:         }
153:         catch (Exception ex)
154:         {
155:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting event {EventId}", EventId);
156:             Snackbar.Add($"Error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
157:             _isDeleting = false;
158:             StateHasChanged();
159:         }
160:     }
161: }
````

````razor
 69:

 72:     private Guid _previousEventId;

 74:

 84:     public async Task LoadSessions()

100:             StateHasChanged();
101:         }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/SessionSelectionDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: 
  4: <MudDialog>
  5:     <DialogContent>
  6:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">Select Session</MudText>
  7:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-4">Which session(s) would you like to attend?</MudText>
  8:         
  9:         <MudStack Spacing="3">
 10:             <!-- Register All Option -->
 11:             <MudPaper Class="pa-4 cursor-pointer" 
 12:                       Elevation="@(IsAllSelected ? 4 : 0)"
 13:                       Style="@GetAllSelectionStyle()"
 14:                       OnClick="ToggleSelectAll">
 15:                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 16:                     <MudCheckBox T="bool" Value="IsAllSelected" 
 17:                                  ValueChanged="@((v) => ToggleSelectAll())" 
 18:                                  Color="Color.Primary" />
 19:                     <div>
 20:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Color="Color.Primary"><b>Register for ALL Sessions</b></MudText>
 21:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Select all @Sessions.Count available sessions</MudText>
 22:                     </div>
 23:                 </div>
 24:             </MudPaper>
 25: 
 26:             <MudDivider Class="my-2" />
 27: 
 28:             @foreach (var session in Sessions)
 29:             {
 30:                 <MudPaper Class="pa-4 cursor-pointer" 
 31:                           Elevation="@(_selectedSessionIds.Contains(session.Id) ? 4 : 0)"
 32:                           Style="@GetSessionStyle(session.Id)"
 33:                           OnClick="@(() => ToggleSelection(session.Id))">
 34:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 35:                         <MudCheckBox T="bool" Value="@_selectedSessionIds.Contains(session.Id)" 
 36:                                      ValueChanged="@((v) => ToggleSelection(session.Id))" 
 37:                                      Color="Color.Primary" />
 38:                         <div>
 39:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1">@session.Title</MudText>
 40:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@session.StartTime.ToString("f")</MudText>
 41:                         </div>
 42:                     </div>
 43:                 </MudPaper>
 44:             }
 45:         </MudStack>
 46:     </DialogContent>
 47:     <DialogActions>
 48:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
 49:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Submit" Disabled="@(!_selectedSessionIds.Any())">
 50:             Register (@_selectedSessionIds.Count)
 51:         </MudButton>
 52:     </DialogActions>
 53: </MudDialog>
 54: 
 55: @code {
 56:     [CascadingParameter] IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
 57:     [Parameter] public List<EventSessionListDto> Sessions { get; set; } = new();
 58: 
 59:     private HashSet<Guid> _selectedSessionIds = new();
 60: 
 61:     private bool IsAllSelected => Sessions.Any() && _selectedSessionIds.Count == Sessions.Count;
 62: 
 63:     private void ToggleSelectAll()
 64:     {
 65:         if (IsAllSelected)
 66:         {
 67:             _selectedSessionIds.Clear();
 68:         }
 69:         else
 70:         {
 71:             _selectedSessionIds = Sessions.Select(s => s.Id).ToHashSet();
 72:         }
 73:     }
 74: 
 75:     private string GetAllSelectionStyle()
 76:     {
 77:         return IsAllSelected 
 78:             ? "border: 2px solid var(--mud-palette-primary); background-color: var(--mud-palette-primary-hover);" 
 79:             : "border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);";
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     private void ToggleSelection(Guid sessionId)
 83:     {
 84:         if (_selectedSessionIds.Contains(sessionId))
 85:             _selectedSessionIds.Remove(sessionId);
 86:         else
 87:             _selectedSessionIds.Add(sessionId);
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     private string GetSessionStyle(Guid sessionId)
 91:     {
 92:         return _selectedSessionIds.Contains(sessionId) 
 93:             ? "border: 2px solid var(--mud-palette-primary); background-color: var(--mud-palette-primary-hover);" 
 94:             : "border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);";
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
 98: 
 99:     private void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(_selectedSessionIds.ToList()));
100: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/ImageUpload.razor
````razor
  1: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  4: @inject IImageStorageService ImageStorageService
  5: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  6: @inject ILogger<ImageUpload> Logger
  7: 
  8: <div class="image-upload">
  9:     <div class="image-upload__preview @(HasImage ? "image-upload__preview--has-image" : "")" style="@($"width: {Width}; height: {Height};")">
 10:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PreviewUrl))
 11:         {
 12:             <img class="image-upload__image" src="@PreviewUrl" alt="@(Alt ?? "Image preview")" />
 13:         }
 14:         else
 15:         {
 16:             <div class="image-upload__placeholder">
 17:                 <MudIcon Icon="@(Icon ?? Icons.Material.Filled.Image)" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 18:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@(PlaceholderText ?? "No image selected")</MudText>
 19:             </div>
 20:         }
 21:     </div>
 22: 
 23:     <div class="image-upload__actions">
 24:         <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile"
 25:                        @ref="_fileUpload"
 26:                        FilesChanged="OnFileSelected"
 27:                        Accept="@AcceptedFormats"
 28:                        MaximumFileCount="1">
 29:             <ActivatorContent>
 30:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 31:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CloudUpload"
 32:                            Color="Color.Primary">
 33:                     @(UploadButtonText ?? "Select Image")
 34:                 </MudButton>
 35:             </ActivatorContent>
 36:         </MudFileUpload>
 37: 
 38:         @if (HasImage)
 39:         {
 40:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
 41:                        Color="Color.Error"
 42:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
 43:                        OnClick="RemoveImage">
 44:                 Remove
 45:             </MudButton>
 46:         }
 47:     </div>
 48: 
 49:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(HintText))
 50:     {
 51:         <MudText Class="image-upload__hint">@HintText</MudText>
 52:     }
 53: </div>
 54: 
 55: @code {
 56:     [Parameter] public string? PreviewUrl { get; set; }
 57:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<string?> PreviewUrlChanged { get; set; }
 58: 
 59:     /// <summary>
 60:     /// Legacy callback that passes IBrowserFile. Prefer using FileDataSelected for reliable WASM uploads.
 61:     /// </summary>
 62:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<IBrowserFile?> FileSelected { get; set; }
 63: 
 64:     /// <summary>
 65:     /// Preferred callback that passes FileUploadData (bytes read into memory).
 66:     /// This prevents stream exhaustion issues in Blazor WASM.
 67:     /// </summary>
 68:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<FileUploadData?> FileDataSelected { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     // Customization parameters
 71:     [Parameter] public string Width { get; set; } = "100%";
 72:     [Parameter] public string Height { get; set; } = "250px";
 73:     [Parameter] public string? PlaceholderText { get; set; }
 74:     [Parameter] public string? UploadButtonText { get; set; }
 75:     [Parameter] public string? HintText { get; set; } = "Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP (Max 5MB)";
 76:     [Parameter] public string? Icon { get; set; }
 77:     [Parameter] public string? Alt { get; set; }
 78:     [Parameter] public string AcceptedFormats { get; set; } = ".jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp";
 79:     [Parameter] public long MaxFileSize { get; set; } = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB default
 80: 
 81:     /// <summary>
 82:     /// Set to true to show a loading indicator while processing the file.
 83:     /// </summary>
 84:     [Parameter] public bool IsProcessing { get; set; }
 85: 
 86:     private MudFileUpload<IBrowserFile>? _fileUpload;
 87:     private bool _isReadingFile;
 88:     private bool HasImage => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PreviewUrl);
 89: 
 90:     private async Task OnFileSelected(IBrowserFile? file)
 91:     {
 92:         if (file == null) return;
 93: 
 94:         // Validate file type
 95:         var allowedTypes = new[] { "image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/gif", "image/webp" };
 96:         if (!allowedTypes.Contains(file.ContentType.ToLower()))
 97:         {
 98:             Snackbar.Add("Please select a valid image file (JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP)", Severity.Error);
 99:             return;
100:         }
101: 
102:         // Validate file size
103:         if (file.Size > MaxFileSize)
104:         {
105:             var maxSizeMB = MaxFileSize / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
106:             Snackbar.Add($"File size must be less than {maxSizeMB:F1}MB", Severity.Error);
107:             return;
108:         }
109: 
110:         _isReadingFile = true;
111:         StateHasChanged();
112: 
113:         try
114:         {
115:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Starting file processing for {FileName} ({Size} bytes)", file.Name, file.Size);
116: 
117:             // STEP 1: Read the file bytes FIRST - this is reliable
118:             // We'll generate the preview from these bytes (skip browser-side resizing which can hang)
119:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 1: Reading file {FileName} ({Size} bytes) into memory...", file.Name, file.Size);
120:             var fileData = await ImageStorageService.ReadFileAsync(file, MaxFileSize);
121: 
122:             if (fileData == null)
123:             {
124:                 Logger.LogError("[ImageUpload] ReadFileAsync returned null for {FileName}", file.Name);
125:                 Snackbar.Add("Failed to read the selected file. Please try again.", Severity.Error);
126:                 await RemoveImage();
127:                 return;
128:             }
129: 
130:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 1a: Successfully read {ByteCount} bytes from {FileName}", fileData.Size, fileData.FileName);
131: 
132:             // STEP 2: Generate preview from the bytes we just read
133:             // Use full-size bytes directly - browser-side resizing (RequestImageFileAsync) can hang in WASM
134:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 2: Generating preview from bytes...");
135:             string localPreview = ImageStorageService.GenerateLocalPreviewFromBytes(fileData);
136: 
137:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(localPreview))
138:             {
139:                 Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] Failed to generate preview for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
140:                 Snackbar.Add("Failed to generate image preview", Severity.Warning);
141:                 // Continue anyway - the upload might still work
142:             }
143:             else
144:             {
145:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 2a: Preview generated successfully");
146:             }
147: 
148:             // STEP 3: Update preview URL and notify parent
149:             // Yield to allow UI thread to process before heavy operations
150:             await Task.Yield();
151:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3: Setting preview URL (length={Length} chars)...", localPreview?.Length ?? 0);
152:             try
153:             {
154:                 PreviewUrl = localPreview;
155:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3a: PreviewUrl property set");
156: 
157:                 // Use InvokeAsync to ensure we're on the correct sync context
158:                 await InvokeAsync(() =>
159:                 {
160:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3b: Inside InvokeAsync, calling StateHasChanged...");
161:                     StateHasChanged();
162:                 });
163:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3c: StateHasChanged completed");
164: 
165:                 // Yield again after render to let browser process
166:                 await Task.Yield();
167: 
168:                 if (PreviewUrlChanged.HasDelegate)
169:                 {
170:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3d: Invoking PreviewUrlChanged callback...");
171:                     await PreviewUrlChanged.InvokeAsync(localPreview);
172:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3e: PreviewUrlChanged callback completed");
173:                 }
174:                 else
175:                 {
176:                     Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] Step 3d: PreviewUrlChanged has no delegate");
177:                 }
178:             }
179:             catch (Exception previewEx)
180:             {
181:                 Logger.LogError(previewEx, "[ImageUpload] Error during preview URL update: {Message}", previewEx.Message);
182:                 // Continue - don't fail the entire upload just because preview failed
183:             }
184: 
185:             // STEP 4: Pass the file data to the parent component for upload
186:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4: Checking FileDataSelected delegate (HasDelegate={HasDelegate})...", FileDataSelected.HasDelegate);
187:             if (FileDataSelected.HasDelegate)
188:             {
189:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4a: Invoking FileDataSelected callback with {Size} bytes...", fileData.Size);
190:                 await FileDataSelected.InvokeAsync(fileData);
191:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4b: FileDataSelected callback completed successfully");
192:             }
193:             else
194:             {
195:                 Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] FileDataSelected has no delegate - parent callback not configured!");
196:             }
197: 
198:             // STEP 5: Also invoke legacy callback for backward compatibility
199:             if (FileSelected.HasDelegate)
200:             {
201:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 5: Invoking legacy FileSelected callback...");
202:                 await FileSelected.InvokeAsync(file);
203:             }
204: 
205:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] ✓ File processing completed successfully for {FileName}", file.Name);
206:         }
207:         catch (Exception ex)
208:         {
209:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing selected file {FileName}", file.Name);
210:             Snackbar.Add($"An error occurred while processing the image: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
211:             await RemoveImage();
212:         }
213:         finally
214:         {
215:             _isReadingFile = false;
216:             StateHasChanged();
217:         }
218:     }
219: 
220:     public async Task RemoveImage()
221:     {
222:         PreviewUrl = null;
223:         await PreviewUrlChanged.InvokeAsync(null);
224: 
225:         // Notify parent that file was removed
226:         if (FileDataSelected.HasDelegate)
227:         {
228:             await FileDataSelected.InvokeAsync(null);
229:         }
230:         if (FileSelected.HasDelegate)
231:         {
232:             await FileSelected.InvokeAsync(null);
233:         }
234: 
235:         // Clear the file upload component
236:         if (_fileUpload != null)
237:         {
238:             await _fileUpload.ClearAsync();
239:         }
240: 
241:         StateHasChanged();
242:     }
243: 
244:     // NOTE: Removed OnParametersSetAsync that was invoking PreviewUrlChanged
245:     // This was causing an infinite loop:
246:     // 1. ImageUpload invokes PreviewUrlChanged
247:     // 2. Parent updates bound property
248:     // 3. Blazor re-renders ImageUpload with new PreviewUrl
249:     // 4. OnParametersSetAsync invokes PreviewUrlChanged AGAIN -> infinite loop -> crash
250:     // The callback should ONLY be invoked when the user actively selects a file.
251: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Layout/NavMenu.razor.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
 2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
 4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
 5: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Routing;
 6: using System.Security.Claims;
 7: 
 8: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Layout;
 9: 
10: public partial class NavMenu
11: {
12:     [Inject]
13:     protected NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = null!;
14: 
15:     [Inject]
16:     protected AuthenticationStateProvider AuthStateProvider { get; set; } = null!;
17: 
18:     [Inject]
19:     protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
20: 
21:     [Parameter]
22:     public EventCallback OnToggleTheme { get; set; }
23: 
24:     private bool _dropdownOpen = false;
25:     private UserDto? _currentUser;
26:     private bool _userLoaded = false;
27:     public string SearchQuery { get; set; } = "";
28: 
29:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
30:     {
31:         await LoadCurrentUserAsync();
32:     }
33: 
34:     private void HandleSearchKeyPress(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.KeyboardEventArgs e)
35:     {
36:         if (e.Key == "Enter")
37:         {
38:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchQuery))
39:             {
40:                 Nav.NavigateTo($"/?q={Uri.EscapeDataString(SearchQuery)}");
41:             }
42:             else
43:             {
44:                 Nav.NavigateTo("/");
45:             }
46:         }
47:     }
48: 
49:     private async Task LoadCurrentUserAsync()
50:     {
51:         if (_userLoaded) return;
52: 
53:         try
54:         {
55:             var authState = await AuthStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
56:             if (authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
57:             {
58:                 _currentUser = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
59:                 _userLoaded = true;
60:             }
61:         }
62:         catch
63:         {
64: 
65:         }
66:     }
67: 
68:     private void ToggleDropdown()
69:     {
70:         _dropdownOpen = !_dropdownOpen;
71:     }
72: 
73:     private void CloseDropdown()
74:     {
75:         _dropdownOpen = false;
76:     }
77: 
78:     private string GetInitials(string? name)
79:     {
80:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return "?";
81:         var parts = name.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
82:         if (parts.Length >= 2)
83:             return $"{parts[0][0]}{parts[1][0]}".ToUpper();
84:         return name.Length >= 2 ? name[..2].ToUpper() : name.ToUpper();
85:     }
86: 
87:     private bool IsAdmin(ClaimsPrincipal user)
88:     {
89:         return user.IsInRole("Admin") ||
90:                user.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "role" && c.Value == "Admin") ||
91:                user.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "roles" && c.Value.Contains("Admin"));
92:     }
93: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/EventStatuses.razor
````razor
 1: @page "/admin/event-statuses"
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
 4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
 5: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
 6: 
 7: <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" GutterBottom="true">Event Statuses</MudText>
 8: 
 9: <MudTable Items="@_eventStatuses"
10:           Dense="true" Hover="true" Striped="true" @ref="_table">
11:     <ToolBarContent>
12:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Manage Event Statuses</MudText>
13:         <MudSpacer />
14:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" @onclick="(() => OpenDialog(null))">Create Event Status</MudButton>
15:     </ToolBarContent>
16:     <HeaderContent>
17:         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
18:         <MudTh>Description</MudTh>
19:         <MudTh>Actions</MudTh>
20:     </HeaderContent>
21:     <RowTemplate>
22:         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">@context.FullName</MudTd>
23:         <MudTd DataLabel="Description">@context.Description</MudTd>
24:         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions">
25:             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" OnClick="@(() => OpenDialog(context.Id))" />
26:             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" OnClick="@(() => DeleteEventStatus(context.Id))" />
27:         </MudTd>
28:     </RowTemplate>
29:     <PagerContent>
30:         <MudTablePager />
31:     </PagerContent>
32: </MudTable>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/LookupTables.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin/lookup-tables"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  5: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
  6: 
  7: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mt-4">
  8:     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="mb-4">
  9:         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.TableChart" Class="mr-2" />
 10:         Lookup Tables Management
 11:     </MudText>
 12: 
 13:     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-4" Color="Color.Secondary">
 14:         View and manage system lookup tables (read-only). These tables are typically seeded during database initialization.
 15:     </MudText>
 16: 
 17:     @if (isLoading)
 18:     {
 19:         <MudProgressLinear Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Class="mb-4" />
 20:     }
 21: 
 22:     <MudTabs Elevation="2" Rounded="true" ApplyEffectsToContainer="true" PanelClass="pa-4">
 23:         <!-- Event Related -->
 24:         <MudTabPanel Text="Event Types" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Event">
 25:             <MudDataGrid T="EventTypeListDto" Items="@eventTypes" Dense="true" Hover="true" Bordered="true">
 26:                 <Columns>
 27:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Id" Title="ID" />
 28:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.FullName" Title="Name" />
 29:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Description" Title="Description" />
 30:                 </Columns>
 31:             </MudDataGrid>
 32:         </MudTabPanel>
 33: 
 34:         <MudTabPanel Text="Event Formats" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.FormatListBulleted">
 35:             <MudDataGrid T="EventFormatListDto" Items="@eventFormats" Dense="true" Hover="true" Bordered="true">
 36:                 <Columns>
 37:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Id" Title="ID" />
 38:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.MasterCode" Title="Code" />
 39:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.FullName" Title="Name" />
 40:                 </Columns>
 41:             </MudDataGrid>
 42:         </MudTabPanel>
 43: 
 44:         <MudTabPanel Text="Event Statuses" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Flag">
 45:             <MudDataGrid T="EventStatusListDto" Items="@eventStatuses" Dense="true" Hover="true" Bordered="true">
 46:                 <Columns>
 47:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Id" Title="ID" />
 48:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.MasterCode" Title="Code" />
 49:                     <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.FullName" Title="Name" />
 50:                 </Columns>
 51:             </MudDataGrid>
 52:         </MudTabPanel>
 53: 
 54:         <MudTabPanel Text="Visibility Types" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility">
 55:             <MudDataGrid T="VisibilityTypeListDto" Items="@visibilityTypes" Dense="true" Hover="true" Bordered="true">
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventCreated.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Blazouter.Services
  4: @inject IEventService EventService
  5: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
  6: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  7: @inject RouterStateService RouterState
  8: 
  9: <PageTitle>Event Created - Explore</PageTitle>
 10: 
 11: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Medium" Class="mt-8">
 12:     @if (isLoading)
 13:     {
 14:         <MudPaper Class="pa-8 text-center">
 15:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 16:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4">Loading event details...</MudText>
 17:         </MudPaper>
 18:     }
 19:     else if (eventDetails != null)
 20:     {
 21:         <MudPaper Class="pa-8">
 22:             <div class="text-center mb-6">
 23:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle"
 24:                         Color="Color.Success"
 25:                         Size="Size.Large"
 26:                         Style="font-size: 5rem;" />
 27:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Color="Color.Success" Class="mt-4">
 28:                     Event Created Successfully!
 29:                 </MudText>
 30:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-2 text-muted">
 31:                     Your event has been created and is now visible in your events.
 32:                 </MudText>
 33:             </div>
 34: 
 35:             <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
 36: 
 37:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-4">Event Details</MudText>
 38: 
 39:             <MudGrid>
 40:                 <MudItem xs="12">
 41:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Title</MudText>
 42:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.Title</MudText>
 43:                 </MudItem>
 44: 
 45:                 <MudItem xs="12">
 46:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Description</MudText>
 47:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.Description</MudText>
 48:                 </MudItem>
 49: 
 50:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 51:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Event Format</MudText>
 52:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.EventFormatFullName</MudText>
 53:                 </MudItem>
 54: 
 55:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 56:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Event Type</MudText>
 57:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.EventTypeFullName</MudText>
 58:                 </MudItem>
 59: 
 60:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 61:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Target Audience</MudText>
 62:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.AudienceGenderFullName, @eventDetails.AudienceAgeFullName</MudText>
 63:                 </MudItem>
 64: 
 65:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 66:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Price</MudText>
 67:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">
 68:                         @(eventDetails.Price > 0 ? $"{eventDetails.CurrencyCode} {eventDetails.Price:N2}" : "Free")
 69:                     </MudText>
 70:                 </MudItem>
 71: 
 72:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 73:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Registration Required</MudText>
 74:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">
 75:                         @(eventDetails.IsRegistrationRequired ? "Yes" : "No")
 76:                     </MudText>
 77:                 </MudItem>
 78: 
 79:                 @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventDetails.EventUrl))
 80:                 {
 81:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 82:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Event URL</MudText>
 83:                         <MudLink Href="@eventDetails.EventUrl" Target="_blank" Typo="Typo.body1">
 84:                             View Event Page
 85:                         </MudLink>
 86:                     </MudItem>
 87:                 }
 88: 
 89:                 @if (eventDetails.FirstSessionDate.HasValue)
 90:                 {
 91:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 92:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">First Session</MudText>
 93:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.FirstSessionDate.Value.ToString("g")</MudText>
 94:                     </MudItem>
 95:                 }
 96:             </MudGrid>
 97: 
 98:             <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
 99: 
100:             <div class="d-flex justify-content-between mt-6">
101:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
102:                           Color="Color.Primary"
103:                           OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/createevent"))">
104:                     Create Another Event
105:                 </MudButton>
106:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
107:                           Color="Color.Primary"
108:                           OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents"))">
109:                     View My Events
110:                 </MudButton>
111:             </div>
112:         </MudPaper>
113:     }
114:     else
115:     {
116:         <MudPaper Class="pa-8 text-center">
117:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Error" Color="Color.Error" Size="Size.Large" />
118:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4">Event not found</MudText>
119:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
120:                       Color="Color.Primary"
121:                       Class="mt-4"
122:                       OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents"))">
123:                 Go to My Events
124:             </MudButton>
125:         </MudPaper>
126:     }
127: </MudContainer>
128: 
129: @code {
130:     private Guid EventId { get; set; }
131: 
132:     private EventDto? eventDetails;
133:     private bool isLoading = true;
134: 
135:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
136:     {
137:         // Get route parameter from Blazouter
138:         var eventIdStr = RouterState.GetParam("eventId");
139:         if (Guid.TryParse(eventIdStr, out var id))
140:         {
141:             EventId = id;
142:         }
143: 
144:         try
145:         {
146:             isLoading = true;
147:             eventDetails = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(EventId);
148:         }
149:         catch (Exception ex)
150:         {
151:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading event details: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
152:         }
153:         finally
154:         {
155:             isLoading = false;
156:         }
157:     }
158: }
````

````csharp
 80:     private async Task LoadUserRegistrationsAsync()
 81:     {
 82:         try
 83:         {
 84:             var authState = await AuthStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 85:             if (authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
 86:             {
 87:                 var user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
 88:                 if (user != null)
 89:                 {
 90:                     var registrations = await EventService.GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(user.Id);
 91:                     if (registrations != null)
 92:                     {
 93:                         var eventIds = new HashSet<Guid>();
 94:                         foreach (var reg in registrations)
 95:                         {
 96:                             var sessionResource = await EventService.GetSessionByIdAsync(reg.EventSessionId);
 97:                             if (sessionResource?.Data != null)
 98:                             {
 99:                                 eventIds.Add(sessionResource.Data.EventId);
100:                             }
101:                         }
102:                         _registeredEventIds = eventIds;
103:                     }
104:                 }
105:             }
106:         }
107:         catch (Exception ex)
108:         {
109:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Failed to load user registrations");
110:         }
111:     }

145: 
146:             await Task.WhenAll(eventsTask, eventTypesTask, eventFormatsTask, categoriesTask, tagsTask, madhabsTask, locationsTask, registrationModesTask, languagesTask, sessionsTask, sessionLanguagesTask);
147: 
148:             allEvents = await eventsTask;
149:             eventTypes = await eventTypesTask;
150:             eventFormats = await eventFormatsTask;
151:             categories = await categoriesTask;
152:             tags = await tagsTask;
153:             madhabs = await madhabsTask;
154:             locations = await locationsTask;
155:             registrationModes = await registrationModesTask;
156:             languages = await languagesTask;
157:             allSessions = await sessionsTask;
158:             sessionLanguages = await sessionLanguagesTask;
159: 
160:             BuildLookupMaps();
161:             _dataLoaded = true;
162:         }
163:         catch (Exception ex)

173:     private List<EventListDto> AllFilteredEvents
174:     {
175:         get
176:         {
177:             var filteredEvents = allEvents?.Items ?? Enumerable.Empty<EventListDto>();
178: 
179:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchText))
180:             {
181:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e =>
182:                     e.Title.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
183:                     (e.Description?.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
184:             }
185: 
186:             if (selectedCategoryId.HasValue)
187:             {
188:                 if (eventsByCategory != null && eventsByCategory.Any())
189:                 {
190:                     var categoryEventIds = eventsByCategory.Select(e => e.Id).ToHashSet();
191:                     filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => categoryEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
192:                 }
193:                 else if (!isLoadingCategory)
194:                 {
195:                     filteredEvents = Enumerable.Empty<EventListDto>();
196:                 }
197:             }
198: 
199:             if (selectedTagId.HasValue)
200:             {
201:                 if (eventsByTag != null && eventsByTag.Any())
202:                 {
203:                     var tagEventIds = eventsByTag.Select(e => e.Id).ToHashSet();
204:                     filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => tagEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
205:                 }
206:                 else if (!isLoadingTag)
207:                 {
208:                     filteredEvents = Enumerable.Empty<EventListDto>();
209:                 }
210:             }
211: 
212:             if (selectedFormatId.HasValue)
213:             {
214:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => e.EventFormatId == selectedFormatId.Value);
215:             }
216: 
217:             if (selectedMadhabId.HasValue)
218:             {
219:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => e.MadhabId == selectedMadhabId.Value);
220:             }
221: 
222:             if (selectedLocationId.HasValue && allSessions?.Items != null && allSessions.Items.Any())
223:             {
224:                 var locationEventIds = allSessions.Items
225:                     .Where(s => s.LocationId == selectedLocationId.Value)
226:                     .Select(s => s.EventId)
227:                     .ToHashSet();
228:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => locationEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
229:             }
230: 
231:             if (selectedRegistrationModeId.HasValue && allSessions?.Items != null && allSessions.Items.Any())
232:             {
233:                 var registrationEventIds = allSessions.Items
234:                     .Where(s => s.RegistrationModeId == selectedRegistrationModeId.Value)
235:                     .Select(s => s.EventId)
236:                     .ToHashSet();
237:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => registrationEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
238:             }
239: 
240:             if (selectedLanguageId.HasValue && allSessions?.Items != null && allSessions.Items.Any() && sessionLanguages != null && sessionLanguages.Any())
241:             {
242:                 var languageSessionIds = sessionLanguages
243:                     .Where(l => l.LanguageId == selectedLanguageId.Value)
244:                     .Select(l => l.EventSessionId)
245:                     .ToHashSet();
246:                 var languageEventIds = allSessions.Items
247:                     .Where(s => languageSessionIds.Contains(s.Id))
248:                     .Select(s => s.EventId)
249:                     .ToHashSet();
250:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => languageEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
251:             }
252: 
253:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedDate))
254:             {
255:                 var today = DateTimeOffset.Now.Date;
256:                 filteredEvents = selectedDate switch
257:                 {
258:                     "today" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date == today),
259:                     "tomorrow" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date == today.AddDays(1)),
260:                     "thisweek" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date >= today && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date <= today.AddDays(7)),
261:                     "thismonth" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date >= today && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date <= today.AddDays(30)),
262:                     _ => filteredEvents
263:                 };
264:             }
265: 
266:             return filteredEvents.ToList();
267:         }
268:     }

407:     private async Task OpenDeleteDialog(EventListDto evt)

410:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseOnEscapeKey = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
411:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<DeleteEventDialog>("Delete Event", parameters, options);

420:     private async Task OpenQuickRegisterDialog(EventListDto evt)
421:     {
422:         var sessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(evt.Id);
423:         if (sessions?.Items == null || !sessions.Items.Any())
424:         {

426:             return;
427:         }
428:         var primarySession = sessions.Items.First();
429:         var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["EventSessionId"] = primarySession.Id, ["Title"] = $"Register for {evt.Title}" };
430:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseOnEscapeKey = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true };
431:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.EventRegistration>("Register", parameters, options);

446:     {
447:         if (eventItem.EventFormatId == 1) return "Online";
448:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventItem.EventFormatFullName)) return eventItem.EventFormatFullName;
449:         return eventFormatMap.TryGetValue(eventItem.EventFormatId, out var formatName) ? formatName : "Location TBD";

452:     private string GetEventImage(EventListDto eventItem)
453:     {
454:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventItem.FeaturedImageUri)) return eventItem.FeaturedImageUri;
455:         var encodedTitle = Uri.EscapeDataString(eventItem.Title.Length > 30 ? eventItem.Title.Substring(0, 30) + "..." : eventItem.Title);
456:         var color = GetEventColorForEvent(eventItem);
457:         return $"https://placehold.co/600x400/{color}/ffffff?text={encodedTitle}";
458:     }
459: 
460:     private string GetEventColorForEvent(EventListDto eventItem)
461:     {
462:         var typeColors = new Dictionary<int, string>
463:         {
464:             { 1, "2196F3" }, { 2, "FF9800" }, { 3, "4CAF50" }, { 4, "E91E63" }, { 5, "9C27B0" },
465:         };
466:         if (typeColors.TryGetValue(eventItem.EventTypeId, out var color)) return color;
467:         var colors = new[] { "2196F3", "FF9800", "4CAF50", "E91E63", "9C27B0", "607D8B" };
468:         return colors[Math.Abs(eventItem.Title.GetHashCode()) % colors.Length];
469:     }
470: 
471:     private string GetTruncatedDescription(string? description)
472:     {
473:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description)) return "No description available.";
474:         var sentences = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Split(description, @"(?<=[.!?])\s+");
475:         var result = string.Join(" ", sentences.Take(2));
476:         if (sentences.Length > 2) result += "...";
477:         if (result.Length > 150) result = result.Substring(0, 147) + "...";
478:         return result;
479:     }
480: 
481:     private string GetActorInitials(string? displayName)
482:     {
483:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName)) return "?";
484:         var words = displayName.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
485:         if (words.Length >= 2) return $"{words[0][0]}{words[1][0]}".ToUpperInvariant();
486:         return displayName.Length >= 2 ? displayName.Substring(0, 2).ToUpperInvariant() : displayName.ToUpperInvariant();
487:     }
488: }
````

````csharp
 83:             Snackbar.Add(_errorMessage, Severity.Error);
 84:         }
 85:         finally
 86:         {
 87:             _isLoading = false;
 88:         }
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     private async Task RetryLoadAsync()
 92:     {
 93:         _errorMessage = null;
 94:         await LoadDataAsync();
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     private bool CanEditEvent(EventListDto evt)
 98:     {
 99:         var org = _myOrganizations.FirstOrDefault(o => o.Id == evt.ActorId);
100:         if (org == null) return false;
101:         return org.CurrentUserRole is 1 or 2 or 3;
102:     }
103: 
104:     private void EditEvent(EventListDto evt)
105:     {
106:         if (CanEditEvent(evt))
107:         {
108:             Navigation.NavigateTo($"/eventedit/{evt.Id}");
109:         }
110:         else
111:         {
112:             Snackbar.Add("You do not have permission to edit this event.", Severity.Error);
113:         }
114:     }
115: 
116:     private void ViewEventDetails(EventListDto evt)
117:     {
118:         Navigation.NavigateTo($"/event/detail/{evt.Id}");
119:     }
120: 
121:     private async Task ViewRegistrations(EventListDto evt)
122:     {
123:         var sessionsResource = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(evt.Id);
124:         if (sessionsResource?.Items == null || !sessionsResource.Items.Any())
125:         {
126:             Snackbar.Add("No sessions available for this event yet.", Severity.Warning);
127:             return;
128:         }
129: 
130:         var sessionParameters = new DialogParameters { ["EventId"] = evt.Id };
131:         var sessionDialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SelectSessionDialog>($"Select a session for {evt.Title}", sessionParameters);
132:         var sessionResult = await sessionDialog.Result;
133: 
134:         if (sessionResult is { Canceled: false, Data: Guid selectedSessionId })
135:         {
136:             var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["EventSessionId"] = selectedSessionId };
137:             var options = new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true };
138:             var dialog = DialogService.Show<RegistrationManagerDialog>("Registrations for session", parameters, options);
139:             await dialog.Result;
140:         }
141:     }
142: 
143:     private async Task DeleteEvent(EventListDto evt)
144:     {
145:         if (!CanEditEvent(evt))
146:         {
147:             Snackbar.Add("You do not have permission to delete this event.", Severity.Error);
148:             return;
149:         }
150: 
151:         var result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
152:             "Delete Event",
153:             $"Are you sure you want to delete '{evt.Title}'? This action cannot be undone.",
154:             yesText: "Delete", cancelText: "Cancel",
155:             options: new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small });
156: 
157:         if (result == true)
158:         {
159:             var success = await EventService.DeleteEventAsync(evt.Id);
160:             if (success)
161:             {
162:                 Snackbar.Add($"Event '{evt.Title}' has been deleted.", Severity.Success);
163:                 _eventsResource?.Items?.Remove(evt);
164:                 if (!FilteredEvents.Any() && _currentPage > 1) _currentPage = 1;
165:                 StateHasChanged();
166:             }
167:             else
168:             {
169:                 Snackbar.Add("Failed to delete event. You may not have permission.", Severity.Error);
170:             }
171:         }
172:     }
173: 
174:     private void OnSearch(string value) { _searchString = value; _currentPage = 1; }
175:     private void OnCategoryChanged(string value) { _selectedCategory = value; _isCategoryOpen = false; _currentPage = 1; }
176:     private void OnOrganizationChanged(Guid organizationId) { _selectedOrganizationId = organizationId; _isOrganizationOpen = false; _currentPage = 1; }
177:     private void OnPageChanged(int page) => _currentPage = page;
178:     private void ToggleOrganizationFilter() => _isOrganizationOpen = !_isOrganizationOpen;
179:     private void ToggleCategoryFilter() => _isCategoryOpen = !_isCategoryOpen;
180:     private void NavigateToCreateEvent() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/organization/my");
181:     private void NavigateToCreateOrganization() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/organization/create");
182: 
183:     private static string GetEventColorCode(EventListDto evt) => evt.EventTypeFullName?.ToLower() switch
184:     {
185:         var s when s?.Contains("conference") == true => "2196F3",
186:         var s when s?.Contains("workshop") == true => "FF9800",
187:         var s when s?.Contains("webinar") == true => "4CAF50",
188:         var s when s?.Contains("seminar") == true => "E91E63",
189:         var s when s?.Contains("training") == true => "9C27B0",
190:         _ => "607D8B"
191:     };
192: 
193:     private static string GetEventImageUrl(EventListDto evt)
194:     {
195:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.FeaturedImageUri)) return evt.FeaturedImageUri;
196:         var encodedTitle = Uri.EscapeDataString(evt.Title.Length > 30 ? evt.Title.Substring(0, 30) + "..." : evt.Title);
197:         var color = GetEventColorCode(evt);
198:         return $"https://placehold.co/600x400/{color}/ffffff?text={encodedTitle}";
199:     }
200: 
201:     private string GetSelectedOrganizationName()
202:     {
203:         if (_selectedOrganizationId == Guid.Empty) return "All Organizations";
204:         return _myOrganizations.FirstOrDefault(o => o.Id == _selectedOrganizationId)?.FullName ?? "All Organizations";
205:     }
206: 
207:     private static string GetActorInitials(string? displayName)
208:     {
209:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName)) return "?";
210:         var words = displayName.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
211:         if (words.Length >= 2) return $"{words[0][0]}{words[1][0]}".ToUpperInvariant();
212:         return displayName.Length >= 2 ? displayName.Substring(0, 2).ToUpperInvariant() : displayName.ToUpperInvariant();
213:     }
214: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/OrganizationReviews.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  5: @using Blazouter.Services
  6: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  7: @inject IOrganizationService OrganizationService
  8: @inject IOrganizationReviewService OrganizationReviewService
  9: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
 10: @inject RouterStateService RouterState
 11: @inject ILogger<OrganizationReviews> Logger
 12: 
 13: <PageTitle>Organization Reviews</PageTitle>
 14: <MudContainer Class="organization-reviews">
 15:     <MudButton StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack" OnClick="GoBack" Class="mb-4">Back to Profile</MudButton>
 16: 
 17:     @if (_isLoading)
 18:     {
 19:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
 20:     }
 21:     else if (_organization == null)
 22:     {
 23:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">Organization not found.</MudAlert>
 24:     }
 25:     else
 26:     {
 27:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="mb-2">Reviews for @_organization.FullName</MudText>
 28:         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="mb-6" Color="Color.Secondary">
 29:             @_reviews.Count reviews • @(_reviews.Any() ? _reviews.Average(r => r.Rating).ToString("0.0") : "0.0")★ average rating
 30:         </MudText>
 31: 
 32:         <MudGrid>
 33:             @if (_reviews.Any())
 34:             {
 35:                 @foreach (var review in _reviews)
 36:                 {
 37:                     <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
 38:                         <MudPaper Class="pa-4 organization-reviews__card" Elevation="0">
 39:                             <MudStack Spacing="2">
 40:                                 <MudStack Row AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2">
 41:                                     <MudAvatar Size="Size.Medium" Color="Color.Primary">
 42:                                         <MudText>@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(review.UserFullName) ? "?" : review.UserFullName.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper())</MudText>
 43:                                     </MudAvatar>
 44:                                     <MudStack Spacing="0">
 45:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2">@review.UserFullName</MudText>
 46:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@review.CreatedAt.DateTime.ToShortDateString()</MudText>
 47:                                     </MudStack>
 48:                                 </MudStack>
 49: 
 50:                                 <MudStack Row AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2">
 51:                                     <div class="organization-reviews__rating">
 52:                                         @for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
 53:                                         {
 54:                                             if (i <= review.Rating)
 55:                                             {
 56:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Star" />
 57:                                             }
 58:                                             else
 59:                                             {
 60:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.StarBorder" />
 61:                                             }
 62:                                         }
 63:                                     </div>
 64:                                 </MudStack>
 65: 
 66:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 67:                                     @review.Comment
 68:                                 </MudText>
 69:                             </MudStack>
 70:                         </MudPaper>
 71:                     </MudItem>
 72:                 }
 73:             }
 74:             else
 75:             {
 76:                 <MudItem xs="12">
 77:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary">No reviews yet.</MudText>
 78:                 </MudItem>
 79:             }
 80:         </MudGrid>
 81:     }
 82: </MudContainer>
 83: 
 84: @code {
 85:     private Guid Id { get; set; }
 86: 
 87:     private OrganizationDto? _organization;
 88:     private List<OrganizationReviewDto> _reviews = new();
 89:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 90: 
 91:     // Client-only load state (no prerender persistence)
 92:     private string? _errorMessage;
 93: 
 94:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 95:     {
 96:         // Get route parameter from Blazouter
 97:         var idStr = RouterState.GetParam("id");
 98:         if (Guid.TryParse(idStr, out var id))
 99:         {
100:             Id = id;
101:         }
102: 
103:         _isLoading = true;
104:         _errorMessage = null;
105: 
106:         try
107:         {
108:             // Load organization and its reviews from API (client-side)
109:             _organization = await OrganizationService.GetOrganizationByIdAsync(Id);
110:             _reviews = (await OrganizationReviewService.GetReviewsByOrganizationId(Id)).ToList();
111:             Logger.LogDebug("Loaded organization {OrganizationId} with {ReviewCount} reviews", Id, _reviews.Count);
112:         }
113:         catch (Exception ex)
114:         {
115:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load reviews: {ex.Message}";
116:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load organization reviews for {OrganizationId}", Id);
117:         }
118:         finally
119:         {
120:             _isLoading = false;
121:         }
122:     }
123: 
124:     // PersistData removed: no PersistentComponentState usage in client-only rendering mode.
125: 
126:     // Dispose removed: no persistence subscription to dispose.
127: 
128:     private void GoBack()
129:     {
130:         Navigation.NavigateTo($"/organization/profile/{Id}");
131:     }
132: }
````

````csharp
221:     public async Task<bool> UploadImageAsync(string uploadUrl, IBrowserFile file)
222:     {
223:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uploadUrl))
224:         {
225:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL (empty/null) - aborting upload");
226:             return false;
227:         }
228: 
229:         if (!Uri.TryCreate(uploadUrl, UriKind.Absolute, out var validatedUri))
230:         {
231:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL format: {UploadUrl} - aborting upload", uploadUrl);
232:             return false;
233:         }
234: 
235:         try
236:         {
237:             _logger.LogInformation("Uploading to S3: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}, Host: {Host}",
238:                 file.Name, file.Size, file.ContentType, validatedUri.Host);
239: 
240: 
241:             using var s3Client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("S3Upload");
242: 
243: 
244:             const long maxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
245:             await using var stream = file.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: maxFileSize);
246:             using var content = new StreamContent(stream);
247: 
248: 
249:             content.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(file.ContentType);
250: 
251:             _logger.LogDebug("Sending PUT request to S3...");
252: 
253: 
254:             var response = await s3Client.PutAsync(validatedUri, content);
255: 
256:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
257:             {
258:                 var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
259:                 _logger.LogError("S3 upload failed: {StatusCode} - {ReasonPhrase} - {ErrorContent}",
260:                     (int)response.StatusCode, response.ReasonPhrase, errorContent);
261: 
262: 
263:                 if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
264:                 {
265:                     _logger.LogError("S3 403 Forbidden - Check: 1) CORS config on bucket 2) Pre-signed URL expired 3) Content-Type mismatch");
266:                 }
267:                 else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.BadRequest)
268:                 {
269:                     _logger.LogError("S3 400 Bad Request - Check: 1) Content-Type header matches pre-signed URL 2) Request headers are correct");
270:                 }
271:             }
272:             else
273:             {
274:                 var etag = response.Headers.ETag?.Tag ?? "no-etag";
275:                 _logger.LogInformation("S3 upload successful! ETag: {ETag}", etag);
276:             }
277: 
278:             return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
279:         }
280:         catch (HttpRequestException ex)
281:         {
282:             _logger.LogError(ex, "HTTP request error uploading to S3. This may be a CORS issue - check bucket CORS configuration.");
283:             return false;
284:         }
285:         catch (Exception ex)
286:         {
287:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error uploading image to S3");
288:             return false;
289:         }
290:     }

313:         try
314:         {
315:             _logger.LogInformation("Uploading to S3: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}, Host: {Host}",

317: 
318: 
319:             using var s3Client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("S3Upload");
320: 
321: 
322: 
323:             using var content = new ByteArrayContent(fileData.Content);
324: 
325: 
326:             content.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(fileData.ContentType);
327:

329: 
330: 
331:             using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(3));

334:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
335:             {
336:                 var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

340: 
341:                 if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)

344:                 }

348:                 }
349: 
350:                 return false;
351:             }
352: 
353:             var etag = response.Headers.ETag?.Tag ?? "no-etag";
354:             _logger.LogInformation("S3 upload successful! ETag: {ETag}, Size: {Size} bytes", etag, fileData.Size);
355:             return true;

360:             return false;

365:             return false;

706:     private int GetFileTypeId(string contentType)
707:     {
708:         return contentType.ToLower() switch
709:         {
710:             "image/jpeg" or "image/jpg" => 1,
711:             "image/png" => 2,
712:             "image/gif" => 3,
713:             "image/webp" => 4,
714:             "image/svg+xml" => 5,
715:             _ => 1
716:         };
717:     }
718: }
````

````csharp
28:     public async Task<string> GetEmbedUrlAsync(string query)
29:     {

31:         {
32:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query))
33:             {
34:                 return string.Empty;
35:             }
36: 
37:             var encodedQuery = Uri.EscapeDataString(query);
38:             var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync($"/bff/api/Maps/embed-url?query={encodedQuery}");
39: 
40:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
41:             {
42:                 var embedUrl = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
43: 
44:                 return embedUrl?.Trim('"') ?? string.Empty;
45:             }
46: 
47:             _logger.LogWarning("Error getting map embed URL: {StatusCode}", response.StatusCode);
48:             return string.Empty;
49:         }
50:         catch (Exception ex)
````
