  4: >
  5: > Fast lookup for critical rules and patterns. For full details, see [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md).
  6: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  7: 
  8: **Last Updated**: January 2026
  9: 
 10: ---
 11: 
 12: ## 12 Critical Rules (Never Violate)
 13: 
 14: ### 1. Repositories Return ENTITIES, Never DTOs
 15: 
 16: ```csharp
 17: // ❌ WRONG
 18: public interface I{Entity}Repository
 19: {
 20:     Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // WRONG
 21: }
 22: 
 23: // ✅ CORRECT
 24: public interface I{Entity}Repository
 25: {
 26:     Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // CORRECT
 27: }
 28: 
 29: // Handler maps entities to DTOs
 30: public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(...)
 31: {
 32:     var entities = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // Entities
 33:     return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>(entities);  // DTOs
 34: }
 35: ```
 36: 
 37: **Why (SOLID - Single Responsibility)**: Repositories handle data access; handlers handle mapping.
 38: 
 39: ---
 40: 
 41: ### 2. Validators Use Manual Instantiation (NOT DI)
 42: 
 43: ```csharp
 44: // ❌ WRONG - DI injection
 45: public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
 46:     I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
 47:     IValidator<Create{Entity}Dto> validator)  // WRONG
 48: {
 49:     _validator = validator;
 50: }
 51: 
 52: // ✅ CORRECT - Manual instantiation
 53: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(...)
 54: {
 55:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
 56:         _{relatedEntity}Repository,
 57:         _{lookupEntity}Repository);
 58: 
 59:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
 60: }
 61: ```
 62: 
 63: **Why**: Fine-grained control; avoids DI complexity; consistent pattern.
 64: 
 65: ---
 66: 
 67: ### 3. Navigation Properties on Link Tables Are Readonly
 68: 
 69: ```csharp
 70: // ❌ WRONG - Write through navigation
 71: var {parentEntity} = await _{parentEntity}Repository.GetById(id);
 72: {parentEntity}.{ChildEntities}.Add({childEntity});  // WRONG
 73: await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 74: 
 75: // ✅ CORRECT - Write through repository
 76: var {linkEntity} = new {LinkEntity}
 77: {
 78:     {ParentEntity}Id = id,
 79:     {ChildEntity}Id = childId
 80: };
 81: await _{linkEntity}Repository.Create({linkEntity});  // CORRECT
 82: ```
 83: 
 84: **Why**: Tenant isolation; explicit writes; prevents accidental cross-tenant data mixing.
 85: 
 86: ---
 87: 
 88: ### 4. Use int Instead of long (Except Size/Cursor)
 89: 
 90: ```csharp
 91: // ❌ WRONG
 92: public long Id { get; set; }
 93: 
 94: // ✅ CORRECT
 95: public int Id { get; set; }      // For lookup tables
 96: public Guid Id { get; set; }     // For main entities
 97: public long Size { get; set; }   // OK for file size
 98: public long Cursor { get; set; } // OK for pagination cursor
 99: ```
100: 
101: **Why**: Consistent conventions; `int` sufficient for most scenarios.
102: 
103: ---
104: 
105: ### 5. No Default Values in Entities
106: 
107: ```csharp
108: // ❌ WRONG
109: public class {Entity}
110: {
111:     public int ViewCount { get; set; } = 0;  // WRONG
112: }
113: 
114: // ✅ CORRECT
115: public class {Entity}
116: {
117:     public int ViewCount { get; set; }  // Set in handler or DB
118: }
119: 
120: // In handler:
121: var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
122: entity.ViewCount = 0;  // Set here
123: ```
124: 
125: **Why**: Clear initialization; avoids confusion between default and database values.
126: 
127: ---
128: 
129: ### 6. Do Not Remove Using Statements
130: 
131: ```csharp
132: // ✅ KEEP all using statements even if they appear unused
133: using System;
134: using System.Collections.Generic;
135: using System.Linq;
136: using System.Threading;
137: using System.Threading.Tasks;
138: using AutoMapper;
139: using MediatR;
140: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
141: using {Project}.Domain;
142: // ... keep all
143: ```
144: 
145: **Why**: Build system may need them; prevents hard-to-debug issues.
146: 
147: ---
148: 
149: ### 7. Commands Return BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>
150: 
151: ```csharp
152: // ❌ WRONG
153: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<{IdType}>
154: 
155: // ✅ CORRECT
156: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
157: ```
158: 
159: **Response Structure**:
160: ```csharp
161: public class BaseCommandResponse<T>
162: {
163:     public bool Success { get; set; }
164:     public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
165:     public T? Id { get; set; }
166:     public List<string> Errors { get; set; } = new();
167: }
168: ```
169: 
170: **Why**: Consistent error handling; validation messages; success/failure distinction.
171: 
172: ---
173: 
174: ### 8. GET = AllowAnonymous, Write = Authorize, Admin = Roles
175: 
176: ```csharp
177: [HttpGet]
178: [AllowAnonymous]  // ✅ Public read access
179: public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll() { }
180: 
181: [HttpPost]
182: [Authorize]  // ✅ Authenticated write access
183: public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create(...) { }
184: 
185: [HttpPut("{id}")]
186: [Authorize]  // ✅ Authenticated write access
187: public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Update(...) { }
188: 
189: [HttpDelete("{id}")]
190: [Authorize]  // ✅ Authenticated write access (or use Roles="Admin" for admin-only)
191: public async Task<ActionResult> Delete({IdType} id) { }
192: 
193: // Admin-only endpoints
194: [HttpDelete("{id}")]
195: [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]  // ✅ Admin-only access
196: public async Task<ActionResult> DeletePermanent({IdType} id) { }
197: ```
198: 
199: **Why (Security)**: Public discovery; protected writes; role-based access control for sensitive operations.
200: 
201: ---
202: 
203: ### 9. Extract UserId with Fallback Pattern
204: 
205: ```csharp
206: var userId = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
207:     ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst(
208:         "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
209:     ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
210: 
211: if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
212: {
213:     return Unauthorized(new { error = "User ID not found in token" });
214: }
215: ```
216: 
217: **Claim Priority**: `sub` → `nameidentifier` → `sid`
218: 
219: **Why**: Different auth providers use different claim names.
220: 
221: ---
222: 
223: ### 10. File-Scoped Namespaces
224: 
225: ```csharp
226: // ❌ WRONG - Nested namespace
227: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands
228: {
229:     public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler { }
230: }
231: 
232: // ✅ CORRECT - File-scoped namespace
233: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
234: 
235: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler { }
236: ```
237: 
238: **Why (Clean Code)**: C# 10+ convention; reduces nesting; cleaner code.
239: 
240: ---
241: 
242: ### 11. Entities Include Auditing Fields
243: 
244: ```csharp
245: // ✅ CORRECT - Include auditing fields
246: public class {Entity}
247: {
248:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
249:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
250: 
251:     // Auditing fields
252:     public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
253:     public Guid? CreatedBy { get; set; }
254:     public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
255:     public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
256: 
257:     // Soft delete
258:     public bool IsDeleted { get; set; }
259: 
260:     // Tenant isolation
261:     public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
262: }
263: 
264: // Set in handler
265: var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
266: entity.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
267: entity.CreatedBy = currentUserId;  // From HttpContext
268: entity.IsDeleted = false;
269: ```
270: 
271: **Why (Audit Trail)**: Track who created/modified entities and when; enables soft delete; maintains data history.
272: 
273: ---
274: 
275: ### 12. Use Named Query Filters for Soft Delete
276: 
277: ```csharp
278: // ❌ WRONG - Single combined filter
279: modelBuilder.Entity<{Entity}>()
280:     .HasQueryFilter(e => !e.IsDeleted && (TenantContext == null || e.TenantId == TenantContext.TenantId));
281: 
282: // ✅ CORRECT - Named filters (EF Core 10+)
283: modelBuilder.Entity<{Entity}>()
284:     .HasQueryFilter(e => TenantContext == null || e.TenantId == TenantContext.TenantId);
285: 
286: modelBuilder.Entity<{Entity}>()
287:     .HasQueryFilter(name: "SoftDelete", predicate: e => !e.IsDeleted);
288: 
289: // Temporarily disable soft delete filter when needed
290: var allEntities = await _dbContext.{Entities}
291:     .IgnoreQueryFilter("SoftDelete")
292:     .ToListAsync();
293: ```
294: 
295: **Why (EF Core 10)**: Named filters allow selective disabling; tenant filter always active; soft delete filter can be bypassed for admin operations.
296: 
297: ---
298: 
299: ## CQRS Pattern Quick Reference
300: 
301: ### Command Pattern (Write)
302: 
303: ```csharp
304: // 1. Command Request
305: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
306: {
307:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; } = null!;
308: }
309: 
310: // 2. Command Handler
311: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
312: {
313:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
314:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity}Repository _{relatedEntity}Repository;
315:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
316: 
317:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(...)
318:     {
319:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
320: 
321:         // Instantiate validator manually
322:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(_{relatedEntity}Repository);
323:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
324: 
325:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
326:         {
327:             response.Success = false;
328:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
329:             return response;
330:         }
331: 
332:         var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
333:         entity = await _{entity}Repository.Create(entity);
334: 
335:         response.Success = true;
336:         response.Id = entity.Id;
337:         return response;
338:     }
339: }
340: ```
341: 
342: ### Query Pattern (Read)
343: 
344: ```csharp
345: // 1. Query Request
346: public class Get{Entity}ListRequest : IRequest<List<{Entity}ListDto>> { }
347: 
348: // 2. Query Handler
349: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
350: {
351:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
352:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
353: 
354:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(...)
355:     {
356:         var entities = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // Entities
357:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>(entities);  // DTOs
358:     }
359: }
360: ```
361: 
362: ---
363: 
364: ## Folder Structure
365: 
366: ```
367: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/
368: ├── Requests/
369: │   ├── Commands/
370: │   │   ├── Create{Entity}Command.cs
371: │   │   ├── Update{Entity}Command.cs
372: │   │   └── Delete{Entity}Command.cs
373: │   └── Queries/
374: │       ├── Get{Entity}ListRequest.cs
375: │       ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequest.cs
376: │       └── Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}Request.cs
377: └── Handlers/
378:     ├── Commands/
379:     │   ├── Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
380:     │   ├── Update{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
381:     │   └── Delete{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
382:     └── Queries/
383:         ├── Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
384:         ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler.cs
385:         └── Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}RequestHandler.cs
386: 
387: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/
388: ├── {Entity}Dto.cs              // Full details
389: ├── {Entity}ListDto.cs          // List view
390: ├── Create{Entity}Dto.cs        // Create payload
391: ├── Update{Entity}Dto.cs        // Update payload
392: └── Validators/
393:     ├── Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
394:     └── Update{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
395: ```
396: 
397: ---
398: 
399: ## Controller Pattern
400: 
401: ```csharp
402: [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
403: [ApiController]
404: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
405: {
406:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
407: 
408:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator) => _mediator = mediator;
409: 
410:     [HttpGet]
411:     [AllowAnonymous]
412:     [EndpointSummary("Get all {Entities}")]
413:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(List<{Entity}ListDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
414:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
415:         => Ok(await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest()));
416: 
417:     [HttpGet("{id}")]
418:     [AllowAnonymous]
419:     [EndpointSummary("Get {Entity} by ID")]
420:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof({Entity}Dto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
421:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
422:     public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
423:         => Ok(await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}DetailsRequest { Id = id }));
424: 
425:     [HttpPost]
426:     [Authorize]
427:     [EndpointSummary("Create {Entity}")]
428:     [Consumes("application/json")]
429:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
430:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
431:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create([FromBody] Create{Entity}Dto dto)
432:     {
433:         var response = await _mediator.Send(new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto });
434:         return response.Success ? Ok(response) : BadRequest(response);
435:     }
436: 
437:     [HttpPut("{id}")]
438:     [Authorize]
439:     [EndpointSummary("Update {Entity}")]
440:     [Consumes("application/json")]
441:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Update({IdType} id, [FromBody] Update{Entity}Dto dto)
442:     {
443:         if (id != dto.Id) return BadRequest(new { error = "ID mismatch" });
444:         var response = await _mediator.Send(new Update{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto });
445:         return response.Success ? Ok(response) : BadRequest(response);
446:     }
447: 
448:     [HttpDelete("{id}")]
449:     [Authorize]
450:     [EndpointSummary("Delete {Entity}")]
451:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
452:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
453:     public async Task<ActionResult> Delete({IdType} id)
454:     {
455:         var result = await _mediator.Send(new Delete{Entity}Command { Id = id });
456:         return result ? NoContent() : NotFound();
457:     }
458: }
459: ```
460: 
461: ---
462: 
463: ## API Endpoint Metadata (Required)
464: 
465: All controller actions must include OpenAPI attributes:
466: 
467: ```csharp
468: [HttpGet("{id}")]
469: [EndpointSummary("Get {Entity} Details")]
470: [EndpointDescription("Returns full {entity} details including related entities.")]
471: [AllowAnonymous]
472: [ProducesResponseType(typeof({Entity}Dto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
473: [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
474: public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
475: ```
476: 
477: **Required Attributes**:
478: - `[EndpointSummary]` - Short title
479: - `[EndpointDescription]` - Detailed description
480: - `[ProducesResponseType]` - Success + failure codes
481: - `[Consumes]` - For POST/PUT with JSON body
482: 
483: ---
484: 
485: ## Common Mistakes & Fixes
486: 
487: | Mistake | Fix |
488: |---------|-----|
489: | Repository returns DTOs | Return entities; map in handler |
490: | Validator injected via DI | Instantiate manually in handler |
491: | `{parentEntity}.{ChildEntities}.Add()` | Use `_{linkEntity}Repository.Create()` |
492: | `public long Id` | Use `public int Id` or `public Guid Id` |
493: | `= 0` default in entity | Remove; set in handler |
494: | Removed using statements | Keep all using statements |
495: | `IRequest<{IdType}>` | Use `IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>` |
496: | Nested namespaces | Use file-scoped namespaces |
497: | Missing userId fallback | Use sub → nameidentifier → sid |
498: | Missing [AllowAnonymous] on GET | Add for public read access |
499: | Missing auditing fields | Add CreatedAt, CreatedBy, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy |
500: | Missing soft delete | Add IsDeleted, use named query filter |
501: | Admin endpoint without Roles | Add `[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]` |
502: | Combined query filters | Use named filters: `HasQueryFilter(name: "SoftDelete", ...)` |
503: 
504: ---
505: 
506: ## Design Principles Summary
507: 
508: | Principle | Application |
509: |-----------|-------------|
510: | **S**ingle Responsibility | Each handler handles ONE command/query |
511: | **O**pen/Closed | Use interfaces for extension |
512: | **L**iskov Substitution | Repositories implement interfaces correctly |
513: | **I**nterface Segregation | Small, focused interfaces |
514: | **D**ependency Inversion | Depend on abstractions |
515: | **DRY** | Use `GenericRepository<T, TId>` |
516: | **KISS** | Simple handlers, one responsibility |
517: | **YAGNI** | Don't add unused abstractions |
518: 
519: ---
520: 
521: ## Related Documentation
522: 
523: - **[TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md)** - Placeholder substitution guide
524: - **[GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md)** - Complete coding conventions
525: - **[ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)** - System architecture overview
526: 
527: ## Skills Reference
528: 
529: - **`clean-architecture-rules`** - Dependency rules and layer boundaries
530: - **`cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`** - CQRS patterns with MediatR
531: - **`dotnet-efcore-guidelines`** - EF Core and repository patterns
532: 
533: ---
534: 
535: **Remember**: These rules ensure architectural consistency across all projects. Follow them without exception.
````

## File: docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md
````markdown
  1: # Troubleshooting
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic .NET Backend Troubleshooting Guide**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: **Last Updated**: January 2026
  8: 
  9: ---
 10: 
 11: ## Placeholder Substitutions
 12: 
 13: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 14: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 15: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 16: | `{Project}.API` | API project | `Explore.API` |
 17: | `{Project}.Application` | Application project | `Explore.Application` |
 18: | `{Project}.Domain` | Domain project | `Explore.Domain` |
 19: | `{Project}.Persistence` | Persistence project | `Explore.Persistence` |
 20: | `{Project}.Infrastructure` | Infrastructure project | `Explore.Infrastructure` |
 21: 
 22: ---
 23: 
 24: This guide focuses on common issues when working on the **backend** projects:
 25: 
 26: - `{Project}.API`
 27: - `{Project}.Application`
 28: - `{Project}.Domain`
 29: - `{Project}.Persistence`
 30: - `{Project}.Infrastructure`
 31: - Migration/worker services (if applicable)
 32: 
 33: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 34: 
 35: ```
 36: - Explore.API
 37: - Explore.Application
 38: - Explore.Domain
 39: - Explore.Persistence
 40: - Explore.Infrastructure
 41: - Event.MigrationService
 42: ```
 43: 
 44: ## Build & Restore
 45: 
 46: ```powershell
 47: dotnet restore
 48: dotnet build
 49: dotnet test
 50: ```
 51: 
 52: ### Common issues
 53: 
 54: #### Target framework / SDK mismatch
 55: 
 56: All backend projects target `net10.0`. If your SDK is older, install the .NET 10 SDK.
 57: 
 58: #### "The type or namespace name 'X' could not be found"
 59: 
 60: Typical causes:
 61: 
 62: - Missing `using` (do not remove existing usings)
 63: - Missing project reference (check `.csproj`)
 64: - Wrong layer dependency (see `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md`)
 65: 
 66: ## OpenAPI / Swagger / Scalar
 67: 
 68: ### Swagger UI loads but endpoints are missing metadata
 69: 
 70: Controllers should annotate actions with:
 71: 
 72: - `[EndpointSummary]`
 73: - `[EndpointDescription]`
 74: - `[ProducesResponseType]`
 75: 
 76: See `docs/API.md`.
 77: 
 78: ### swagger.json file is stale
 79: 
 80: In Development, `{Project}.API` runs `OpenApiExportService` which exports a `swagger.json` file at startup.
 81: 
 82: If it doesn't update:
 83: 
 84: - Ensure `{Project}.API` starts successfully in Development.
 85: - Check startup logs for the hosted service.
 86: - Confirm the file is not locked by another process.
 87: 
 88: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Explore.API` exports `swagger.json` to `Explore.API/swagger.json`
 89: 
 90: ## Authentication / Authorization
 91: 
 92: ### 401 Unauthorized on write endpoints
 93: 
 94: - Ensure you are sending `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
 95: - Confirm Keycloak settings in configuration match your environment.
 96: 
 97: ### UserId missing in token
 98: 
 99: Controllers that require a user id MUST use the fallback claim extraction:
100: 
101: `sub` → `http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier` → `sid`
102: 
103: If all are missing, return `401`.
104: 
105: ## Database / EF Core / Migrations
106: 
107: ### Apply migrations (Development)
108: 
109: `{Project}.API` exposes a Development-only endpoint:
110: 
111: ```http
112: POST /admin/migrate
113: ```
114: 
115: It is protected with `.RequireAuthorization()`.
116: 
117: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Explore.API` provides `POST /admin/migrate`
118: 
119: ### Migration worker (if applicable)
120: 
121: If your project has a dedicated migration service, it's responsible for background migration/maintenance tasks.
122: 
123: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Event.MigrationService` handles background migrations (see `Event.MigrationService/Program.cs`)
124: 
125: ### Duplicate key violations
126: 
127: `GenericRepository.Create` catches PostgreSQL unique constraint violations (`SqlState == "23505"`) and rethrows with more context.
128: 
129: If you see duplicate key errors:
130: 
131: - Check unique constraints in EF configurations/migrations.
132: - Verify seed data and id generation.
133: 
134: 
135: ### Development URLs (Default)
136: 
137: | Service | URL |
138: |---------|-----|
139: | Aspire Dashboard | `https://localhost:17225` |
140: | API | `https://localhost:7001` |
141: | Blazor | `https://localhost:7002` |
142: | Scalar API Docs | `https://localhost:7001/scalar/v1` |
143: | Swagger UI | `https://localhost:7001/swagger` |
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/_Imports.razor
````razor
 1: @using System.Net.Http

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/AudienceAges.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin/audience-ages"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  5: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
  6: 
  7: <div class="admin-lookup">
  8:     <!-- Hero Section -->
  9:     <MudPaper Class="admin-lookup__hero admin-lookup__hero--age" Elevation="0">
 10:         <div class="admin-lookup__hero-top">
 11:             <div class="admin-lookup__hero-title">
 12:                 <div class="admin-lookup__hero-badge admin-lookup__hero-badge--age">
 13:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cake" Color="Color.Warning" />
 14:                 </div>
 15:                 <div>
 16:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.2px;">
 17:                         Audience Ages
 18:                     </MudText>
 19:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-lookup__hero-subtitle">
 20:                         Age group classifications for events (read-only lookup table)
 21:                     </MudText>
 22:                 </div>
 23:             </div>
 24: 
 25:             <MudStack Row Spacing="1" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
 26:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 27:                            Color="Color.Default"
 28:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 29:                            OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin"))"
 30:                            Style="border-radius:999px; padding:10px 16px;">
 31:                     Back to Admin
 32:                 </MudButton>
 33:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 34:                            Color="Color.Warning"
 35:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
 36:                            OnClick="LoadData"
 37:                            Style="border-radius:999px; padding:10px 16px;">
 38:                     Refresh
 39:                 </MudButton>
 40:             </MudStack>
 41:         </div>
 42: 
 43:         <!-- Stats -->
 44:         <div class="admin-lookup__stats">
 45:             <div class="admin-lookup__stat">
 46:                 <div class="admin-lookup__stat-row">
 47:                     <div class="admin-lookup__stat-icon admin-lookup__stat-icon--age">
 48:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cake" Color="Color.Warning" />
 49:                     </div>
 50:                     <div>
 51:                         <div class="admin-lookup__stat-label">Total Age Groups</div>
 52:                         <div class="admin-lookup__stat-value">@_items.Count</div>
 53:                     </div>
 54:                 </div>
 55:             </div>
 56:         </div>
 57:     </MudPaper>
 58: 
 59:     @if (_isLoading)
 60:     {
 61:         <MudPaper Class="admin-lookup__panel" Elevation="0" Style="margin-top:14px;">
 62:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 63:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Warning" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 64:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading audience ages…</MudText>
 65:             </MudStack>
 66:         </MudPaper>
 67:     }
 68:     else
 69:     {
 70:         <div class="admin-lookup__section">
 71:             <!-- Info Banner -->
 72:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="mb-3" Style="border-radius:14px;">
 73:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 74:                     <strong>Read-only lookup table.</strong> Audience age groups are system-defined values.
 75:                     Contact system administrator if changes are needed.
 76:                 </MudText>
 77:             </MudAlert>
 78: 
 79:             <!-- Table -->
 80:             <MudPaper Class="admin-lookup__table-panel" Elevation="0">
 81:                 <MudTable Items="@_items"
 82:                           Dense="true"
 83:                           Hover="true"
 84:                           Striped="true"
 85:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
 86:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
 87:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Warning">
 88:                     <HeaderContent>
 89:                         <MudTh Style="width:80px">ID</MudTh>
 90:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
 91:                         <MudTh>Master Code</MudTh>
 92:                         <MudTh Style="width:120px">Min Age</MudTh>
 93:                         <MudTh Style="width:120px">Max Age</MudTh>
 94:                         <MudTh>Description</MudTh>
 95:                     </HeaderContent>
 96:                     <RowTemplate>
 97:                         <MudTd DataLabel="ID">
 98:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Default">
 99:                                 @context.Id
100:                             </MudChip>
101:                         </MudTd>
102:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
103:                             <div class="admin-lookup__name-cell">
104:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cake" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Warning" />
105:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight:600;">@context.FullName</MudText>
106:                             </div>
107:                         </MudTd>
108:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Code">
109:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default">
110:                                 @context.MasterCode
111:                             </MudChip>
112:                         </MudTd>
113:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Min Age">
114:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
115:                                 @(context.MinAge?.ToString() ?? "—")
116:                             </MudText>
117:                         </MudTd>
118:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Max Age">
119:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
120:                                 @(context.MaxAge?.ToString() ?? "∞")
121:                             </MudText>
122:                         </MudTd>
123:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Description">
124:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-lookup__muted">
125:                                 @(context.Description ?? "—")
126:                             </MudText>
127:                         </MudTd>
128:                     </RowTemplate>
129:                     <NoRecordsContent>
130:                         <div class="admin-lookup__empty">
131:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cake" Size="Size.Large" />
132:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="margin-top:10px; font-weight:800;">No age groups found</MudText>
133:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-lookup__muted">
134:                                 The lookup table is empty.
135:                             </MudText>
136:                         </div>
137:                     </NoRecordsContent>
138:                 </MudTable>
139:             </MudPaper>
140:         </div>
141:     }
142: </div>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Categories.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin/categories"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Admin
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  6: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
  7: 
  8: <div class="admin-categories">
  9:     <!-- Hero Section -->
 10:     <MudPaper Class="admin-categories__hero" Elevation="0">
 11:         <div class="admin-categories__hero-top">
 12:             <div class="admin-categories__hero-title">
 13:                 <div class="admin-categories__hero-badge">
 14:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Category" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 15:                 </div>
 16:                 <div>
 17:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="admin-categories__title-text">
 18:                         Categories Management
 19:                     </MudText>
 20:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-categories__hero-subtitle">
 21:                         Create, edit, and manage event categories
 22:                     </MudText>
 23:                 </div>
 24:             </div>
 25: 
 26:             <MudStack Row Spacing="1" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
 27:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 28:                            Color="Color.Default"
 29:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 30:                            OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin"))"
 31:                            Class="admin-categories__action-btn">
 32:                     Back to Admin
 33:                 </MudButton>
 34:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 35:                            Color="Color.Secondary"
 36:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
 37:                            OnClick="LoadCategories"
 38:                            Class="admin-categories__action-btn">
 39:                     Refresh
 40:                 </MudButton>
 41:             </MudStack>
 42:         </div>
 43: 
 44:         <!-- Stats -->
 45:         <div class="admin-categories__stats">
 46:             <div class="admin-categories__stat">
 47:                 <div class="admin-categories__stat-row">
 48:                     <div class="admin-categories__stat-icon">
 49:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Category" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 50:                     </div>
 51:                     <div>
 52:                         <div class="admin-categories__stat-label">Total Categories</div>
 53:                         <div class="admin-categories__stat-value">@_categories.Count</div>
 54:                     </div>
 55:                 </div>
 56:             </div>
 57:             <div class="admin-categories__stat">
 58:                 <div class="admin-categories__stat-row">
 59:                     <div class="admin-categories__stat-icon admin-categories__stat-icon--parent">
 60:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.AccountTree" Color="Color.Info" />
 61:                     </div>
 62:                     <div>
 63:                         <div class="admin-categories__stat-label">Parent Categories</div>
 64:                         <div class="admin-categories__stat-value">@_categories.Count(c => c.ParentId == null)</div>
 65:                     </div>
 66:                 </div>
 67:             </div>
 68:         </div>
 69:     </MudPaper>
 70: 
 71:     @if (_isLoading)
 72:     {
 73:         <MudPaper Class="admin-categories__panel" Elevation="0">
 74:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 75:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 76:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading categories…</MudText>
 77:             </MudStack>
 78:         </MudPaper>
 79:     }
 80:     else
 81:     {
 82:         <div class="admin-categories__section">
 83:             <!-- Toolbar -->
 84:             <MudPaper Class="admin-categories__panel" Elevation="0">
 85:                 <div class="admin-categories__toolbar">
 86:                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 87:                                   Placeholder="Search categories..."
 88:                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 89:                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 90:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 91:                                   Immediate="true"
 92:                                   Clearable="true"
 93:                                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
 94:                                   Class="admin-categories__search-field" />
 95: 
 96:                     <MudSpacer />
 97: 
 98:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 99:                                Color="Color.Secondary"
100:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
101:                                OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
102:                                Class="admin-categories__create-btn">
103:                         Create Category
104:                     </MudButton>
105:                 </div>
106:             </MudPaper>
107: 
108:             <!-- Table -->
109:             <MudPaper Class="admin-categories__table-panel" Elevation="0">
110:                 <MudTable Items="@FilteredCategories"
111:                           Dense="true"
112:                           Hover="true"
113:                           Striped="true"
114:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
115:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
116:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Secondary">
117:                     <HeaderContent>
118:                         <MudTh Class="admin-categories__col-id">#</MudTh>
119:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
120:                         <MudTh>Master Code</MudTh>
121:                         <MudTh>Parent Category</MudTh>
122:                         <MudTh Class="admin-categories__col-actions">Actions</MudTh>
123:                     </HeaderContent>
124:                     <RowTemplate>
125:                         <MudTd DataLabel="#">
126:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-categories__id">@context.Id.ToString()[..8]…</MudText>
127:                         </MudTd>
128:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
129:                             <div class="admin-categories__name-cell">
130:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Category" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
131:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-categories__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
132:                             </div>
133:                         </MudTd>
134:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Code">
135:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default">
136:                                 @context.MasterCode
137:                             </MudChip>
138:                         </MudTd>
139:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Parent">
140:                             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.ParentFullName))
141:                             {
142:                                 <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Info">
143:                                     @context.ParentFullName
144:                                 </MudChip>
145:                             }
146:                             else
147:                             {
148:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Class="admin-categories__muted">Root category</MudText>
149:                             }
150:                         </MudTd>
151:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Class="admin-categories__cell-actions">
152:                             <div class="admin-categories__actions">
153:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Edit">
154:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
155:                                                    Color="Color.Primary"
156:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
157:                                                    OnClick="@(() => OpenEditDialog(context))" />
158:                                 </MudTooltip>
159:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Delete">
160:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
161:                                                    Color="Color.Error"
162:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
163:                                                    OnClick="@(() => DeleteCategory(context))" />
164:                                 </MudTooltip>
165:                             </div>
166:                         </MudTd>
167:                     </RowTemplate>
168:                     <NoRecordsContent>
169:                         <div class="admin-categories__empty">
170:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Category" Size="Size.Large" />
171:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-categories__empty-title">No categories found</MudText>
172:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-categories__muted">
173:                                 @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
174:                                 {
175:                                     <span>Create your first category to get started.</span>
176:                                 }
177:                                 else
178:                                 {
179:                                     <span>No categories match your search criteria.</span>
180:                                 }
181:                             </MudText>
182:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
183:                                        Color="Color.Secondary"
184:                                        OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
185:                                        Class="admin-categories__empty-btn">
186:                                 Create Category
187:                             </MudButton>
188:                         </div>
189:                     </NoRecordsContent>
190:                     <PagerContent>
191:                         <MudTablePager PageSizeOptions="new int[] { 10, 25, 50, 100 }" />
192:                     </PagerContent>
193:                 </MudTable>
194:             </MudPaper>
195:         </div>
196:     }
197: </div>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Categories.razor.css
````css
  1: ::deep :root {
  2:     --admin-categories-radius-xl: 22px;
  3:     --admin-categories-radius-lg: 16px;
  4:     --admin-categories-radius-md: 12px;
  5:     --admin-categories-spacing: 24px;
  6: }
  7: 
  8: 
  9: ::deep .admin-categories {
 10:     max-width: 1280px;
 11:     margin: 0 auto;
 12:     padding: 22px;
 13: }
 14: 
 15: 
 16: ::deep .admin-categories__hero {
 17:     border-radius: var(--admin-categories-radius-xl);
 18:     padding: 20px;
 19:     position: relative;
 20:     overflow: hidden;
 21:     border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
 22:     background:
 23:         radial-gradient(
 24:             900px 300px at 20% 10%,
 25:             rgba(156, 39, 176, 0.22),
 26:             transparent 55%
 27:         ),
 28:         radial-gradient(
 29:             800px 280px at 80% 0%,
 30:             rgba(233, 30, 99, 0.14),
 31:             transparent 55%
 32:         ),
 33:         linear-gradient(
 34:             180deg,
 35:             rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
 36:             rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)
 37:         );
 38:     box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
 39: }
 40: 
 41: 
 42: ::deep .admin-categories__hero-top {
 43:     display: flex;
 44:     gap: 16px;
 45:     align-items: flex-start;
 46:     justify-content: space-between;
 47:     flex-wrap: wrap;
 48: }
 49: 
 50: 
 51: ::deep .admin-categories__hero-title {
 52:     display: flex;
 53:     gap: 12px;
 54:     align-items: center;
 55: }
 56: 
 57: ::deep .admin-categories__title-text {
 58:     font-weight: 800;
 59:     letter-spacing: 0.2px;
 60: }
 61: 
 62: 
 63: ::deep .admin-categories__hero-badge {
 64:     width: 44px;
 65:     height: 44px;
 66:     border-radius: 14px;
 67:     display: grid;
 68:     place-items: center;
 69:     background: rgba(156, 39, 176, 0.18);
 70:     border: 1px solid rgba(156, 39, 176, 0.35);
 71: }
 72: 
 73: 
 74: ::deep .admin-categories__hero-subtitle {
 75:     opacity: 0.85;
 76: }
 77: 
 78: ::deep .admin-categories__action-btn {
 79:     border-radius: 999px;
 80:     padding: 10px 16px;
 81: }
 82: 
 83: 
 84: ::deep .admin-categories__stats {
 85:     margin-top: 16px;
 86:     display: grid;
 87:     grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
 88:     gap: 12px;
 89: }
 90: 
 91: 
 92: ::deep .admin-categories__stat {
 93:     border-radius: var(--admin-categories-radius-lg);
 94:     padding: 14px;
 95:     border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
 96:     background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
 97:     box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
 98:     transition:
 99:         transform 0.15s ease,
100:         box-shadow 0.15s ease;
101: }
102: 
103: ::deep .admin-categories__stat:hover {
104:     transform: translateY(-2px);
105:     box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
106: }
107: 
108: 
109: ::deep .admin-categories__stat-row {
110:     display: flex;
111:     align-items: center;
112:     gap: 12px;
113: }
114: 
115: 
116: ::deep .admin-categories__stat-icon {
117:     width: 42px;
118:     height: 42px;
119:     border-radius: 14px;
120:     display: grid;
121:     place-items: center;
122:     background: rgba(156, 39, 176, 0.16);
123:     border: 1px solid rgba(156, 39, 176, 0.35);
124: }
125: 
126: 
127: ::deep .admin-categories__stat-icon--parent {
128:     background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16);
129:     border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
130: }
131: 
132: 
133: ::deep .admin-categories__stat-label {
134:     opacity: 0.8;
135:     font-size: 0.82rem;
136: }
137: 
138: 
139: ::deep .admin-categories__stat-value {
140:     font-size: 1.55rem;
141:     font-weight: 700;
142:     letter-spacing: 0.3px;
143: }
144: 
145: 
146: ::deep .admin-categories__section {
147:     margin-top: 18px;
148: }
149: 
150: 
151: ::deep .admin-categories__panel {
152:     border-radius: var(--admin-categories-radius-xl);
153:     border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
154:     background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
155:     box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
156:     padding: 14px;
157:     margin-top: 14px;
158: }
159: 
160: ::deep .admin-categories__search-field {
161:     min-width: 280px;
162:     border-radius: 999px;
163: }
164: 
165: 
166: ::deep .admin-categories__toolbar {
167:     display: flex;
168:     gap: 12px;
169:     align-items: center;
170:     flex-wrap: wrap;
171: }
172: 
173: 
174: ::deep .admin-categories__create-btn {
175:     border-radius: 999px !important;
176:     padding: 10px 24px !important;
177:     font-weight: 600;
178:     box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(156, 39, 176, 0.3);
179: }
180: 
181: 
182: ::deep .admin-categories__table-panel {
183:     border-radius: var(--admin-categories-radius-xl);
184:     overflow: hidden;
185:     border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
186:     background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
187:     box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
188:     margin-top: 12px;
189: }
190: 
191: ::deep .admin-categories__col-id {
192:     width: 50px;
193: }
194: 
195: ::deep .admin-categories__col-actions {
196:     text-align: center;
197:     width: 150px;
198: }
199: 
200: 
201: ::deep .admin-categories__id {
202:     font-family: monospace;
203:     font-size: 0.75rem;
204:     opacity: 0.7;
205: }
206: 
207: 
208: ::deep .admin-categories__name-cell {
209:     display: flex;
210:     align-items: center;
211:     gap: 8px;
212: }
213: 
214: ::deep .admin-categories__name-text {
215:     font-weight: 600;
216: }
217: 
218: 
219: ::deep .admin-categories__actions {
220:     display: flex;
221:     gap: 4px;
222:     justify-content: center;
223: }
224: 
225: ::deep .admin-categories__cell-actions {
226:     text-align: center;
227: }
228: 
229: 
230: ::deep .admin-categories__empty {
231:     display: flex;
232:     flex-direction: column;
233:     align-items: center;
234:     padding: 48px 24px;
235:     text-align: center;
236: }
237: 
238: ::deep .admin-categories__empty-title {
239:     margin-top: 10px;
240:     font-weight: 800;
241: }
242: 
243: ::deep .admin-categories__empty-btn {
244:     margin-top: 12px;
245:     border-radius: 999px;
246: }
247: 
248: 
249: ::deep .admin-categories__muted {
250:     color: var(--mud-palette-text-secondary);
251: }
252: 
253: 
254: @media (max-width: 768px) {
255:     ::deep .admin-categories {
256:         padding: 16px;
257:     }
258: 
259:     ::deep .admin-categories__hero-top {
260:         flex-direction: column;
261:         align-items: stretch;
262:     }
263: 
264:     ::deep .admin-categories__toolbar {
265:         flex-direction: column;
266:         align-items: stretch;
267:     }
268: }
269: 
270: 
271: @media (max-width: 480px) {
272:     ::deep .admin-categories {
273:         padding: 12px;
274:     }
275: 
276:     ::deep .admin-categories__hero {
277:         padding: 16px;
278:     }
279: 
280:     ::deep .admin-categories__create-btn {
281:         width: 100%;
282:     }
283: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/EventFormats.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin/event-formats"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  5: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
  6: 
  7: <div class="admin-event-formats">
  8:     <!-- Hero Section -->
  9:     <MudPaper Class="admin-event-formats__hero" Elevation="0">
 10:         <div class="admin-event-formats__hero-top">
 11:             <div class="admin-event-formats__hero-title">
 12:                 <div class="admin-event-formats__hero-badge">
 13:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Videocam" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 14:                 </div>
 15:                 <div>
 16:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="admin-event-formats__title-text">
 17:                         Event Formats
 18:                     </MudText>
 19:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-event-formats__hero-subtitle">
 20:                         Event format options: In-person, Online, Hybrid (read-only lookup table)
 21:                     </MudText>
 22:                 </div>
 23:             </div>
 24: 
 25:             <MudStack Row Spacing="1" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
 26:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 27:                            Color="Color.Default"
 28:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 29:                            OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin"))"
 30:                            Class="admin-event-formats__action-btn">
 31:                     Back to Admin
 32:                 </MudButton>
 33:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 34:                            Color="Color.Secondary"
 35:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
 36:                            OnClick="LoadData"
 37:                            Class="admin-event-formats__action-btn">
 38:                     Refresh
 39:                 </MudButton>
 40:             </MudStack>
 41:         </div>
 42: 
 43:         <!-- Stats -->
 44:         <div class="admin-event-formats__stats">
 45:             <div class="admin-event-formats__stat">
 46:                 <div class="admin-event-formats__stat-row">
 47:                     <div class="admin-event-formats__stat-icon">
 48:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Videocam" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 49:                     </div>
 50:                     <div>
 51:                         <div class="admin-event-formats__stat-label">Total Formats</div>
 52:                         <div class="admin-event-formats__stat-value">@_items.Count</div>
 53:                     </div>
 54:                 </div>
 55:             </div>
 56:         </div>
 57:     </MudPaper>
 58: 
 59:     @if (_isLoading)
 60:     {
 61:         <MudPaper Class="admin-event-formats__panel" Elevation="0">
 62:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 63:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 64:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading event formats…</MudText>
 65:             </MudStack>
 66:         </MudPaper>
 67:     }
 68:     else
 69:     {
 70:         <div class="admin-event-formats__section">
 71:             <!-- Info Banner -->
 72:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="admin-event-formats__alert mb-3">
 73:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 74:                     <strong>Read-only lookup table.</strong> Event formats are system-defined values (In-person, Online, Hybrid).
 75:                     Contact system administrator if changes are needed.
 76:                 </MudText>
 77:             </MudAlert>
 78: 
 79:             <!-- Table -->
 80:             <MudPaper Class="admin-event-formats__table-panel" Elevation="0">
 81:                 <MudTable Items="@_items"
 82:                           Dense="true"
 83:                           Hover="true"
 84:                           Striped="true"
 85:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
 86:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
 87:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Secondary">
 88:                     <HeaderContent>
 89:                         <MudTh Class="admin-event-formats__col-id">ID</MudTh>
 90:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
 91:                         <MudTh>Master Code</MudTh>
 92:                         <MudTh>Description</MudTh>
 93:                     </HeaderContent>
 94:                     <RowTemplate>
 95:                         <MudTd DataLabel="ID">
 96:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Default">
 97:                                 @context.Id
 98:                             </MudChip>
 99:                         </MudTd>
100:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
101:                             <div class="admin-event-formats__name-cell">
102:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@GetFormatIcon(context.MasterCode)" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
103:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-event-formats__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
104:                             </div>
105:                         </MudTd>
106:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Code">
107:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default">
108:                                 @context.MasterCode
109:                             </MudChip>
110:                         </MudTd>
111:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Description">
112:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-event-formats__muted">
113:                                 @(context.Description ?? "—")
114:                             </MudText>
115:                         </MudTd>
116:                     </RowTemplate>
117:                     <NoRecordsContent>
118:                         <div class="admin-event-formats__empty">
119:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Videocam" Size="Size.Large" />
120:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-event-formats__empty-title">No event formats found</MudText>
121:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-event-formats__muted">
122:                                 The lookup table is empty.
123:                             </MudText>
124:                         </div>
125:                     </NoRecordsContent>
126:                 </MudTable>
127:             </MudPaper>
128:         </div>
129:     }
130: </div>
````

````razor
  1: @page "/admin/locations"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients

 52:                     <div class="admin-locations__stat-icon">

 54:                     </div>

 58:                     </div>

 61:             <div class="admin-locations__stat">

 63:                     <div class="admin-locations__stat-icon admin-locations__stat-icon--countries">
 64:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Public" Color="Color.Info" />
 65:                     </div>
 66:                     <div>
 67:                         <div class="admin-locations__stat-label">Countries</div>
 68:                         <div class="admin-locations__stat-value">@_locations.Select(l => l.Country).Distinct().Count()</div>
 69:                     </div>
 70:                 </div>
 71:             </div>
 72:             <div class="admin-locations__stat">
 73:                 <div class="admin-locations__stat-row">
 74:                     <div class="admin-locations__stat-icon admin-locations__stat-icon--cities">
 75:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationCity" Color="Color.Warning" />
 76:                     </div>
 77:                     <div>
 78:                         <div class="admin-locations__stat-label">Cities</div>
 79:                         <div class="admin-locations__stat-value">@_locations.Select(l => l.City).Distinct().Count()</div>
 80:                     </div>
 81:                 </div>
 82:             </div>
 83:         </div>
 84:     </MudPaper>
 85: 
 86:     @if (_isLoading)
 87:     {
 88:         <MudPaper Class="admin-locations__panel" Elevation="0">
 89:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 90:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Success" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 91:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading locations…</MudText>
 92:             </MudStack>
 93:         </MudPaper>
 94:     }
 95:     else
 96:     {
 97:         <div class="admin-locations__section">
 98:             <!-- Toolbar -->
 99:             <MudPaper Class="admin-locations__panel" Elevation="0">
100:                 <div class="admin-locations__toolbar">
101:                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
102:                                   Placeholder="Search locations..."
103:                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
104:                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
105:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
106:                                   Immediate="true"
107:                                   Clearable="true"
108:                                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
109:                                   Class="admin-locations__search-field" />
110: 
111:                     <MudSpacer />
112: 
113:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
114:                                Color="Color.Success"
115:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
116:                                OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
117:                                Class="admin-locations__create-btn">
118:                         Create Location
119:                     </MudButton>
120:                 </div>
121:             </MudPaper>
122: 
123:             <!-- Table -->
124:             <MudPaper Class="admin-locations__table-panel" Elevation="0">
125:                 <MudTable Items="@FilteredLocations"
126:                           Dense="true"
127:                           Hover="true"
128:                           Striped="true"
129:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
130:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
131:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Success">
132:                     <HeaderContent>
133:                         <MudTh Class="admin-locations__col-id">#</MudTh>
134:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
135:                         <MudTh>Address</MudTh>
136:                         <MudTh>City</MudTh>
137:                         <MudTh>Country</MudTh>
138:                         <MudTh Class="admin-locations__col-actions">Actions</MudTh>
139:                     </HeaderContent>
140:                     <RowTemplate>
141:                         <MudTd DataLabel="#">
142:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__id">@context.Id.ToString()[..8]…</MudText>
143:                         </MudTd>
144:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
145:                             <div class="admin-locations__name-cell">
146:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Success" />
147:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
148:                             </div>
149:                         </MudTd>
150:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Address">
151:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@(context.Address ?? "—")</MudText>
152:                         </MudTd>
153:                         <MudTd DataLabel="City">
154:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Info">
155:                                 @(context.City ?? "—")
156:                             </MudChip>
157:                         </MudTd>
158:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Country">
159:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Default">
160:                                 @(context.Country ?? "—")
161:                             </MudChip>
162:                         </MudTd>
163:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Class="admin-locations__cell-actions">
164:                             <div class="admin-locations__actions">
165:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Edit">
166:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
167:                                                    Color="Color.Primary"
168:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
169:                                                    OnClick="@(() => OpenEditDialog(context))" />
170:                                 </MudTooltip>
171:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Delete">
172:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
173:                                                    Color="Color.Error"
174:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
175:                                                    OnClick="@(() => DeleteLocation(context))" />
176:                                 </MudTooltip>
177:                             </div>
178:                         </MudTd>
179:                     </RowTemplate>
180:                     <NoRecordsContent>
181:                         <div class="admin-locations__empty">
182:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Large" />
183:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-locations__empty-title">No locations found</MudText>
184:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__muted">
185:                                 @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
186:                                 {
187:                                     <span>Create your first location to get started.</span>
188:                                 }
189:                                 else
190:                                 {
191:                                     <span>No locations match your search criteria.</span>
192:                                 }
193:                             </MudText>
194:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
195:                                        Color="Color.Success"
196:                                        OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
197:                                        Class="admin-locations__empty-btn">
198:                                 Create Location
199:                             </MudButton>
200:                         </div>
201:                     </NoRecordsContent>
202:                     <PagerContent>
203:                         <MudTablePager PageSizeOptions="new int[] { 10, 25, 50, 100 }" />
204:                     </PagerContent>
205:                 </MudTable>
206:             </MudPaper>
207:         </div>
208:     }
209: </div>
210: 
211: @code {
212:     private ICollection<LocationListDto> _locations = new List<LocationListDto>();
213:     private string _searchString = string.Empty;
214:     private bool _isLoading = true;
215: 
216:     private IEnumerable<LocationListDto> FilteredLocations => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString)
217:         ? _locations
218:         : _locations.Where(l =>
219:             (l.FullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
220:             (l.Address?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
221:             (l.City?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
222:             (l.Country?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
223: 
224:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
225:     {
226:         await LoadLocations();
227:     }
228: 
229:     private async Task LoadLocations()
230:     {
231:         _isLoading = true;
232:         try
233:         {
234:             _locations = await LocationService.GetLocations();
235:         }
236:         catch (Exception ex)
237:         {
238:             Snackbar.Add($"Failed to load locations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
239:             _locations = new List<LocationListDto>();
240:         }
241:         finally
242:         {
243:             _isLoading = false;
244:         }
245:     }
246: 
247:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
248:     {
249:         var options = new DialogOptions
250:         {
251:             CloseButton = true,
252:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
253:             FullWidth = true
254:         };
255: 
256:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateLocationDialog>("Create Location", options);
257:         var result = await dialog.Result;
258: 
259:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateLocationDto createDto })
260:         {
261:             var response = await LocationService.CreateLocationAsync(createDto);
262:             if (response?.Success == true)
263:             {
264:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{createDto.FullName}' created successfully", Severity.Success);
265:                 await LoadLocations();
266:             }
267:             else
268:             {
269:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
270:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to create location: {errors}", Severity.Error);
271:             }
272:         }
273:     }
274: 
275:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(LocationListDto location)
276:     {
277:         // First, get the full location details
278:         var locationDetails = await LocationService.GetLocationByIdAsync(location.Id);
279:         if (locationDetails == null)
280:         {
281:             Snackbar.Add("Failed to load location details", Severity.Error);
282:             return;
283:         }
284: 
285:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditLocationDialog>
286:         {
287:             { x => x.ExistingLocation, locationDetails }
288:         };
289: 
290:         var options = new DialogOptions
291:         {
292:             CloseButton = true,
293:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
294:             FullWidth = true
295:         };
296: 
297:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditLocationDialog>("Edit Location", parameters, options);
298:         var result = await dialog.Result;
299: 
300:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateLocationDto updateDto })
301:         {
302:             var response = await LocationService.UpdateLocationAsync(updateDto.Id, updateDto);
303:             if (response?.Success == true)
304:             {
305:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{updateDto.FullName}' updated successfully", Severity.Success);
306:                 await LoadLocations();
307:             }
308:             else
309:             {
310:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
311:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to update location: {errors}", Severity.Error);
312:             }
313:         }
314:     }
315: 
316:     private async Task DeleteLocation(LocationListDto location)
317:     {
318:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
319:             "Confirm Delete",
320:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the location '{location.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
321:             yesText: "Delete",
322:             cancelText: "Cancel");
323: 
324:         if (confirm == true)
325:         {
326:             var success = await LocationService.DeleteLocationAsync(location.Id);
327:             if (success)
328:             {
329:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{location.FullName}' deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
330:                 await LoadLocations();
331:             }
332:             else
333:             {
334:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete location '{location.FullName}'", Severity.Error);
335:             }
336:         }
337:     }
338: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Madhabs.razor
````razor

 12:                 <div class="admin-madhabs__hero-badge">

 14:                 </div>
 15:                 <div>
 16:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="admin-madhabs__title-text">
 17:                         Madhabs
 18:                     </MudText>
 19:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__hero-subtitle">
 20:                         Islamic jurisprudence schools (read-only lookup table)
 21:                     </MudText>
 22:                 </div>
 23:             </div>
 24: 
 25:             <MudStack Row Spacing="1" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
 26:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 27:                            Color="Color.Default"
 28:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 29:                            OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin"))"
 30:                            Class="admin-madhabs__action-btn">
 31:                     Back to Admin
 32:                 </MudButton>
 33:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 34:                            Color="Color.Tertiary"
 35:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
 36:                            OnClick="LoadData"
 37:                            Class="admin-madhabs__action-btn">
 38:                     Refresh
 39:                 </MudButton>
 40:             </MudStack>
 41:         </div>
 42: 
 43:         <!-- Stats -->
 44:         <div class="admin-madhabs__stats">
 45:             <div class="admin-madhabs__stat">
 46:                 <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-row">
 47:                     <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-icon">
 48:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" Color="Color.Tertiary" />
 49:                     </div>
 50:                     <div>
 51:                         <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-label">Total Madhabs</div>
 52:                         <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-value">@_items.Count</div>
 53:                     </div>
 54:                 </div>
 55:             </div>
 56:         </div>
 57:     </MudPaper>
 58: 
 59:     @if (_isLoading)
 60:     {
 61:         <MudPaper Class="admin-madhabs__panel" Elevation="0">
 62:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 63:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Tertiary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 64:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading madhabs…</MudText>
 65:             </MudStack>

 68:     else

 73:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 74:                     <strong>Read-only lookup table.</strong> Madhabs are system-defined values used throughout the application.
 75:                     Contact system administrator if changes are needed.
 76:                 </MudText>
 77:             </MudAlert>
 78: 
 79:             <!-- Table -->
 80:             <MudPaper Class="admin-madhabs__table-panel" Elevation="0">

 84:                           Striped="true"

 87:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Tertiary">
 88:                     <HeaderContent>
 89:                         <MudTh Class="admin-madhabs__col-id">ID</MudTh>
 90:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
 91:                         <MudTh>Master Code</MudTh>
 92:                         <MudTh>Description</MudTh>
 93:                     </HeaderContent>
 94:                     <RowTemplate>
 95:                         <MudTd DataLabel="ID">
 96:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Default">

 98:                             </MudChip>
 99:                         </MudTd>
100:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
101:                             <div class="admin-madhabs__name-cell">
102:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Tertiary" />
103:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
104:                             </div>
105:                         </MudTd>
106:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Code">
107:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default">
108:                                 @context.MasterCode
109:                             </MudChip>
110:                         </MudTd>
111:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Description">
112:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__muted">
113:                                 @(context.Description ?? "—")
114:                             </MudText>
115:                         </MudTd>
116:                     </RowTemplate>
117:                     <NoRecordsContent>
118:                         <div class="admin-madhabs__empty">
119:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" Size="Size.Large" />
120:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-madhabs__empty-title">No madhabs found</MudText>
121:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__muted">
122:                                 The lookup table is empty.
123:                             </MudText>
124:                         </div>
125:                     </NoRecordsContent>
126:                 </MudTable>
127:             </MudPaper>
128:         </div>
129:     }
130: </div>
