## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Tags.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin/tags"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Admin
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  6: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
  7: 
  8: <div class="admin-tags">
  9:     <!-- Hero Section -->
 10:     <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__hero" Elevation="0">
 11:         <div class="admin-tags__hero-top">
 12:             <div class="admin-tags__hero-title">
 13:                 <div class="admin-tags__hero-badge">
 14:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Color="Color.Primary" />
 15:                 </div>
 16:                 <div>
 17:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="admin-tags__title-text">
 18:                         Tags Management
 19:                     </MudText>
 20:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__hero-subtitle">
 21:                         Create, edit, and manage event tags
 22:                     </MudText>
 23:                 </div>
 24:             </div>
 25: 
 26:             <MudStack Row Spacing="1" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
 27:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 28:                            Color="Color.Default"
 29:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 30:                            OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin"))"
 31:                            Class="admin-tags__action-btn">
 32:                     Back to Admin
 33:                 </MudButton>
 34:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 35:                            Color="Color.Primary"
 36:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
 37:                            OnClick="LoadTags"
 38:                            Class="admin-tags__action-btn">
 39:                     Refresh
 40:                 </MudButton>
 41:             </MudStack>
 42:         </div>
 43: 
 44:         <!-- Stats -->
 45:         <div class="admin-tags__stats">
 46:             <div class="admin-tags__stat">
 47:                 <div class="admin-tags__stat-row">
 48:                     <div class="admin-tags__stat-icon">
 49:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Color="Color.Primary" />
 50:                     </div>
 51:                     <div>
 52:                         <div class="admin-tags__stat-label">Total Tags</div>
 53:                         <div class="admin-tags__stat-value">@_tags.Count</div>
 54:                     </div>
 55:                 </div>
 56:             </div>
 57:         </div>
 58:     </MudPaper>
 59: 
 60:     @if (_isLoading)
 61:     {
 62:         <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__panel" Elevation="0">
 63:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 64:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 65:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading tags…</MudText>
 66:             </MudStack>
 67:         </MudPaper>
 68:     }
 69:     else
 70:     {
 71:         <div class="admin-tags__section">
 72:             <!-- Toolbar -->
 73:             <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__panel" Elevation="0">
 74:                 <div class="admin-tags__toolbar">
 75:                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 76:                                   Placeholder="Search tags..."
 77:                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 78:                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 79:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 80:                                   Immediate="true"
 81:                                   Clearable="true"
 82:                                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
 83:                                   Class="admin-tags__search-field" />
 84: 
 85:                     <MudSpacer />
 86: 
 87:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 88:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 89:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 90:                                OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
 91:                                Class="admin-tags__create-btn">
 92:                         Create Tag
 93:                     </MudButton>
 94:                 </div>
 95:             </MudPaper>
 96: 
 97:             <!-- Table -->
 98:             <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__table-panel" Elevation="0">
 99:                 <MudTable Items="@FilteredTags"
100:                           Dense="true"
101:                           Hover="true"
102:                           Striped="true"
103:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
104:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
105:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Primary">
106:                     <HeaderContent>
107:                         <MudTh Class="admin-tags__col-id">#</MudTh>
108:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
109:                         <MudTh>Master Code</MudTh>
110:                         <MudTh Class="admin-tags__col-actions">Actions</MudTh>
111:                     </HeaderContent>
112:                     <RowTemplate>
113:                         <MudTd DataLabel="#">
114:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__id">@context.Id.ToString()[..8]…</MudText>
115:                         </MudTd>
116:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
117:                             <div class="admin-tags__name-cell">
118:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" />
119:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
120:                             </div>
121:                         </MudTd>
122:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Code">
123:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default">
124:                                 @context.MasterCode
125:                             </MudChip>
126:                         </MudTd>
127:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Class="admin-tags__cell-actions">
128:                             <div class="admin-tags__actions">
129:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Edit">
130:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
131:                                                    Color="Color.Primary"
132:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
133:                                                    OnClick="@(() => OpenEditDialog(context))" />
134:                                 </MudTooltip>
135:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Delete">
136:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
137:                                                    Color="Color.Error"
138:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
139:                                                    OnClick="@(() => DeleteTag(context))" />
140:                                 </MudTooltip>
141:                             </div>
142:                         </MudTd>
143:                     </RowTemplate>
144:                     <NoRecordsContent>
145:                         <div class="admin-tags__empty">
146:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Size="Size.Large" />
147:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-tags__empty-title">No tags found</MudText>
148:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__muted">
149:                                 @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
150:                                 {
151:                                     <span>Create your first tag to get started.</span>
152:                                 }
153:                                 else
154:                                 {
155:                                     <span>No tags match your search criteria.</span>
156:                                 }
157:                             </MudText>
158:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
159:                                        Color="Color.Primary"
160:                                        OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
161:                                        Class="admin-tags__empty-btn">
162:                                 Create Tag
163:                             </MudButton>
164:                         </div>
165:                     </NoRecordsContent>
166:                     <PagerContent>
167:                         <MudTablePager PageSizeOptions="new int[] { 10, 25, 50, 100 }" />
168:                     </PagerContent>
169:                 </MudTable>
170:             </MudPaper>
171:         </div>
172:     }
173: </div>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Home.razor
````razor
 1: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Landing
 3: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
 4: @inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
 5: @inject ILogger<Home> Logger
 6: 
 7: <PageTitle>ISLAMU Explore</PageTitle>
 8: 
 9: @if (isLoading)
10: {
11:     <div class="home-page__loading">
12:         <div class="home-page__loading-content">
13:             <div class="home-page__loading-title">Loading...</div>
14:             <div class="home-page__loading-text">Please wait while we check your authentication status</div>
15:         </div>
16:     </div>
17: }
18: else if (isAuthenticated)
19: {
20:     <LandingPageForUsers />
21: }
22: else
23: {
24:     <LandingPageForNonUsers />
25: }
26: 
27: @code {
28:     private bool isLoading = true;
29:     private bool isAuthenticated = false;
30: 
31:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
32:     {
33:         try
34:         {
35:             var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
36:             isAuthenticated = authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
37:         }
38:         catch (Exception ex)
39:         {
40:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Auth check failed");
41:             isAuthenticated = false;
42:         }
43:         finally
44:         {
45:             isLoading = false;
46:         }
47:     }
48: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/EditMemberRoleDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Models.Enums
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 4: @using MudBlazor
 5: @inject IOrganizationMemberService MemberService
 6: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 7: 
 8: <MudDialog>
 9:     <DialogContent>
10:         <MudText>Change role for @Member.UserEmail</MudText>
11:         <MudSelect T="OrganizationRole" Label="Role" @bind-Value="newRole" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter">
12:             @foreach (OrganizationRole role in Enum.GetValues(typeof(OrganizationRole)))
13:             {
14:                 if (role != OrganizationRole.Creator)
15:                 {
16:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@role">@role</MudSelectItem>
17:                 }
18:             }
19:         </MudSelect>
20:     </DialogContent>
21:     <DialogActions>
22:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
23:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Save</MudButton>
24:     </DialogActions>
25: </MudDialog>
26: 
27: @code {
28:     [CascadingParameter] MudBlazor.IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; }
29:     [Parameter] public OrganizationMemberDto Member { get; set; }
30:     [Parameter] public Guid OrganizationId { get; set; }
31: 
32:     private OrganizationRole newRole;
33: 
34:     protected override void OnInitialized()
35:     {
36:         newRole = (OrganizationRole)Member.OrganizationRoleId;
37:     }
38: 
39:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
40: 
41:     private async Task Submit()
42:     {
43:         try
44:         {
45:             var updateDto = new UpdateOrganizationMemberRoleDto
46:             {
47:                 Id = Member.Id,
48:                 Role = (int)newRole
49:             };
50: 
51:             await MemberService.UpdateMemberRoleAsync(updateDto);
52:             Snackbar.Add("Role updated successfully", Severity.Success);
53:             MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
54:         }
55:         catch (Exception ex)
56:         {
57:             Snackbar.Add($"Error updating role: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
58:         }
59:     }
60: }
````

````razor
 1: @page "/user/reviews"
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients

 8: 
 9: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mt-4">
10:     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center mb-4">
11:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h4">My Reviews</MudText>
12:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack" Href="/user/profile">
13:             Back to Profile
14:         </MudButton>
15:     </div>
16: 
17:     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString" Placeholder="Search reviews..." Adornment="Adornment.Start" AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search" Class="mb-4" />
18: 
19:     @if (_loading)
20:     {
21:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Class="d-block mx-auto" />
22:     }
23:     else if (!FilteredReviews.Any())
24:     {
25:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Align="Align.Center">No reviews found.</MudText>
26:     }
27:     else
28:     {

31:             {

33:                     <MudCard>

36:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@review.OrganizationFullName</MudText>
37:                                 <MudRating ReadOnly="true" SelectedValue="@review.Rating" />
38:                             </CardHeaderContent>
39:                             <CardHeaderActions>
40:                                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" Color="Color.Error" OnClick="@(() => DeleteReview(review))" />

45:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Class="mt-2">@review.CreatedAt.ToString("g")</MudText>
46:                         </MudCardContent>
47:                     </MudCard>
48:                 </MudItem>
49:             }
50:         </MudGrid>
51:     }
52: </MudContainer>
````

````csharp
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: public partial class UserProfile : ComponentBase
 15: {
 16:     [Inject] private IUserService UserService { get; set; } = default!;
 17:     [Inject] private IEventService EventService { get; set; } = default!;
 18:     [Inject] private IOrganizationReviewService OrganizationReviewService { get; set; } = default!;
 19:     [Inject] private AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider { get; set; } = default!;
 20:     [Inject] private ILogger<UserProfile> Logger { get; set; } = default!;
 21: 
 22: 
 23:     private UserDto? UserData { get; set; }
 24:     private bool IsLoading { get; set; } = true;
 25:     private string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }
 26: 
 27: 
 28:     private int EventsAttended { get; set; }
 29:     private int ReviewsGiven { get; set; }
 30:     private ICollection<OrganizationReviewDto> MyReviews { get; set; } = new List<OrganizationReviewDto>();
 31: 
 32:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 33:     {
 34:         Logger.LogInformation("[UserProfile] OnInitializedAsync starting...");
 35:         await LoadUserDataAsync();
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     private async Task LoadUserDataAsync()
 39:     {
 40:         IsLoading = true;
 41:         ErrorMessage = null;
 42: 
 43:         try
 44:         {
 45:             Logger.LogInformation("[UserProfile] Loading user data...");
 46: 
 47: 
 48:             var userData = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
 49: 
 50:             if (userData == null)
 51:             {
 52:                 Logger.LogWarning("[UserProfile] User data not found, attempting sync...");
 53: 
 54: 
 55:                 var syncResult = await UserService.SyncUserAsync();
 56: 
 57:                 if (syncResult?.Success == true)
 58:                 {
 59:                     Logger.LogInformation("[UserProfile] User synced successfully, retrying load...");
 60: 
 61:                     await Task.Delay(200);
 62:                     userData = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
 63:                 }
 64:                 else
 65:                 {
 66:                     Logger.LogWarning("[UserProfile] User sync failed: {Message}", syncResult?.Message ?? "Unknown error");
 67:                 }
 68:             }
 69: 
 70:             if (userData != null)
 71:             {
 72:                 UserData = userData;
 73:                 Logger.LogInformation("[UserProfile] User data loaded: {Email}", UserData.Email);
 74: 
 75: 
 76:                 await LoadStatisticsAsync(userData.Id);
 77:             }
 78:             else
 79:             {
 80:                 Logger.LogWarning("[UserProfile] UserData is still null after sync attempt");
 81:                 ErrorMessage = "Unable to load user profile. Please try refreshing the page.";
 82:             }
 83:         }
 84:         catch (Exception ex)
 85:         {
 86:             Logger.LogError(ex, "[UserProfile] Error loading user data");
 87:             ErrorMessage = $"An error occurred while loading your profile: {ex.Message}";
 88:         }
 89:         finally
 90:         {
 91:             IsLoading = false;
 92:         }
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     private async Task LoadStatisticsAsync(Guid userId)
 96:     {
 97: 
 98:         var registrationsTask = LoadEventRegistrationsAsync(userId);
 99:         var reviewsTask = LoadReviewsAsync(userId);
100: 
101:         await Task.WhenAll(registrationsTask, reviewsTask);
102:     }
103: 
104:     private async Task LoadEventRegistrationsAsync(Guid userId)
105:     {
106:         try
107:         {
108:             var registrations = await EventService.GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(userId);
109:             EventsAttended = registrations?.Count ?? 0;
110:             Logger.LogInformation("[UserProfile] Loaded {Count} event registrations", EventsAttended);
111:         }
112:         catch (Exception ex)
113:         {
114:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "[UserProfile] Error loading registrations");
115:             EventsAttended = 0;
116:         }
117:     }
118: 
119:     private async Task LoadReviewsAsync(Guid userId)
120:     {
121:         try
122:         {
123:             MyReviews = await OrganizationReviewService.GetReviewsByUserId(userId);
124:             ReviewsGiven = MyReviews?.Count ?? 0;
125:             Logger.LogInformation("[UserProfile] Loaded {Count} reviews", ReviewsGiven);
126:         }
127:         catch (Exception ex)
128:         {
129:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "[UserProfile] Error loading reviews");
130:             MyReviews = new List<OrganizationReviewDto>();
131:             ReviewsGiven = 0;
132:         }
133:     }
134: 
135: 
136: 
137: 
138: 
139:     private string GetDisplayLocation()
140:     {
141: 
142: 
143:         return "Location not set";
144:     }
145: 
146: 
147: 
148: 
149: 
150:     private string GetFullName()
151:     {
152:         if (UserData == null) return "User";
153: 
154:         var firstName = UserData.FirstName?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
155:         var lastName = UserData.LastName?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
156: 
157:         var fullName = $"{firstName} {lastName}".Trim();
158: 
159:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fullName))
160:             return fullName;
161: 
162:         return UserData.Username ?? "User";
163:     }
164: 
165: 
166: 
167: 
168:     private string GetInitials()
169:     {
170:         if (UserData == null) return "?";
171: 
172:         var firstInitial = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserData.FirstName)
173:             ? UserData.FirstName[0].ToString().ToUpper()
174:             : string.Empty;
175: 
176:         var lastInitial = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserData.LastName)
177:             ? UserData.LastName[0].ToString().ToUpper()
178:             : string.Empty;
179: 
180:         var initials = $"{firstInitial}{lastInitial}";
181: 
182:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(initials))
183:             return initials;
184: 
185:         return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserData.Username)
186:             ? UserData.Username[0].ToString().ToUpper()
187:             : "?";
188:     }
189: 
190: 
191: 
192: 
193:     private string GetUsername()
194:     {
195:         if (UserData == null) return "user";
196:         return UserData.Username ?? UserData.Email?.Split('@').FirstOrDefault() ?? "user";
197:     }
198: }
````

````razor
  1: @inject IEventService EventService

  4: <MudDialog Class="registration-dialog">

 21:                     </div>
 22:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="success-title">
 23:                         You're Already Registered! ✅
 24:                     </MudText>

 26:                         You have already registered for this event.<br />
 27:                         We look forward to seeing you there!
 28:                     </MudText>
 29:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 30:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 31:                                Size="Size.Large"
 32:                                OnClick="Close"
 33:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close">
 34:                         Close
 35:                     </MudButton>
 36:                 </div>
 37:             </div>
 38:         }
 39:         else if (!isRegistered)
 40:         {
 41:             <div class="registration-shell">
 42:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-2">@Title</MudText>
 43:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-6 mud-text-secondary">
 44:                     Click confirm to register for this event
 45:                 </MudText>
 46: 
 47:                 @if (currentUser != null)
 48:                 {
 49:                     <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Class="mb-4">
 50:                         You will be registered as: <strong>@currentUser.FirstName @currentUser.LastName</strong> (@currentUser.Email)
 51:                     </MudAlert>
 52:                 }
 53: 
 54:                 <div class="action-buttons">
 55:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
 56:                                Color="Color.Default"
 57:                                OnClick="Cancel"
 58:                                Disabled="isSubmitting">
 59:                         Cancel
 60:                     </MudButton>
 61:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 62:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 63:                                OnClick="HandleSubmit"
 64:                                Disabled="isSubmitting || currentUser == null"
 65:                                StartIcon="@(isSubmitting ? null : Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle)">
 66:                         @if (isSubmitting)
 67:                         {
 68:                             <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
 69:                             <span>Registering...</span>
 70:                         }
 71:                         else
 72:                         {
 73:                             <span>Confirm Registration</span>
 74:                         }
 75:                     </MudButton>
 76:                 </div>
 77:             </div>
 78:         }
 79:         else
 80:         {
 81:             <div class="registration-shell">
 82:                 <div class="success-content">
 83:                     <div class="success-icon">
 84:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle" />
 85:                     </div>
 86:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="success-title">
 87:                         Registration Successful! 🎉
 88:                     </MudText>
 89:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="success-message">
 90:                         Thank you for registering@(currentUser != null ? $", {currentUser.FirstName}" : "")! <br />
 91:                         You will receive a confirmation email shortly.
 92:                     </MudText>
 93:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 94:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 95:                                Size="Size.Large"
 96:                                OnClick="Close"
 97:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close">
 98:                         Close
 99:                     </MudButton>
100:                 </div>
101:             </div>
102:         }
103:     </DialogContent>
104: </MudDialog>
105: 
106: @code {
107:     [CascadingParameter]
108:     private MudBlazor.IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
109: 
110:     [Parameter]
111:     public Guid EventSessionId { get; set; }
112: 
113:     [Parameter]
114:     public string Title { get; set; } = "Register for Event";
115: 
116:     private CreateEventRegistrationDto registrationModel = new();
117:     private UserDto? currentUser;
118:     private bool isSubmitting = false;
119:     private bool isRegistered = false;
120:     private bool isAlreadyRegistered = false;
121:     private bool isLoading = true;
122: 
123:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
124:     {
125:         try
126:         {
127:             // Get current user
128:             currentUser = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
129: 
130:             if (currentUser != null)
131:             {
132:                 registrationModel.EventSessionId = EventSessionId;
133:                 registrationModel.UserId = currentUser.Id;
134:             }
135:         }
136:         catch (Exception ex)
137:         {
138:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading user data: {ex.Message}", Severity.Warning);
139:         }
140:         finally
141:         {
142:             isLoading = false;
143:         }
144:     }
145: 
146:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
147:     {
148:         if (currentUser == null)
149:         {
150:             Snackbar.Add("You must be logged in to register.", Severity.Error);
151:             return;
152:         }
153: 
154:         if (EventSessionId == Guid.Empty)
155:         {
156:             Snackbar.Add("Registration is unavailable for this session.", Severity.Error);
157:             return;
158:         }
159: 
160:         isSubmitting = true;
161: 
162:         try
163:         {
164:             var response = await EventService.RegisterForEventSessionAsync(registrationModel);
165: 
166:             if (response?.Success == true)
167:             {
168:                 isRegistered = true;
169:                 Snackbar.Add("You have been successfully registered!", Severity.Success);
170:             }
171:             else
172:             {
173:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Something went wrong. Please try again later.", Severity.Error);
174:             }
175:         }
176:         catch (Exception ex)
177:         {
178:             Snackbar.Add($"Registration error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
179:         }
180:         finally
181:         {
182:             isSubmitting = false;
183:         }
184:     }
185: 
186:     private void Cancel()
187:     {
188:         DialogReference?.Close();
189:     }
190: 
191:     private void Close()
192:     {
193:         DialogReference?.Close();
194:     }
195: }
````

````csharp
 64:     private async Task LoadEventDataAsync()
 65:     {
 66:         _isLoading = true;
 67:         _isCheckingRegistration = true;
 68:         _isCheckingAuth = true;
 69:         _errorMessage = null;
 70: 
 71:         try
 72:         {
 73:             Logger.LogInformation("Loading event {EventId}", EventId);
 74:             _eventDetails = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(EventId);
 75: 
 76:             if (_eventDetails != null)
 77:             {
 78:                 Logger.LogInformation("Loaded event: {Title}", _eventDetails.Title);
 79: 
 80: 
 81:                 _eventSessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
 82:                 _primarySession = _eventSessions?.FirstOrDefault();
 83:                 Logger.LogInformation("Loaded {SessionCount} sessions", _eventSessions?.Count ?? 0);
 84: 
 85: 
 86:                 var registrationTask = CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
 87:                 var authTask = CheckDeleteAuthorizationAsync();
 88:                 var aspectsTask = LoadEventAspectsAsync();
 89:                 await Task.WhenAll(registrationTask, authTask, aspectsTask);
 90:             }
 91:         }
 92:         catch (Exception ex)
 93:         {
 94:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load event details: {ex.Message}";
 95:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load event {EventId}", EventId);
 96:         }
 97:         finally
 98:         {

100:             _isCheckingRegistration = false;
101:             _isCheckingAuth = false;
102:         }
103:     }

113:             var techTask = EventAspectService.GetTechAspectAsync(EventId);

115:             await Task.WhenAll(islamicTask, techTask);
116:

121:                 EventId, _islamicAspect != null, _techAspect != null);

135:             {
136:                 var user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();

307:     private async Task OpenRegistrationDialog()
308:     {
309:         if (_eventDetails == null) return;
310: 
311: 
312:         if (_eventSessions == null || !_eventSessions.Any())
313:         {
314:             await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
315:                 "Registration unavailable",
316:                 "No sessions are available for this event yet.",
317:                 yesText: "OK");
318:             return;
319:         }
320: 
321: 
322:         if (_eventSessions.Count == 1)
323:         {
324:             await RegisterForSession(_eventSessions.First());
325:         }
326: 
327:         else
328:         {
329:             var parameters = new DialogParameters
330:             {
331:                 { "Sessions", _eventSessions.ToList() }
332:             };
333: 
334:             var options = new DialogOptions
335:             {
336:                 CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
337:                 MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
338:                 FullWidth = true,
339:                 Position = DialogPosition.Center
340:             };
341: 
342:             var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event.SessionSelectionDialog>(
343:                 "Select Session",
344:                 parameters,
345:                 options
346:             );
347: 
348:             var result = await dialog.Result;
349: 
350:             if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is List<Guid> selectedSessionIds)
351:             {
352: 
353:                 int successCount = 0;
354:                 foreach (var sessionId in selectedSessionIds)
355:                 {
356:                     var session = _eventSessions.First(s => s.Id == sessionId);
357:                     if (await RegisterForSession(session))
358:                     {
359:                         successCount++;
360:                     }
361:                 }
362: 
363:                 if (successCount > 0)
364:                 {
365: 
366:                     await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
367:                     StateHasChanged();
368:                 }
369:             }
370:         }
371:     }
372:

382:         };
383: 
384:         var options = new DialogOptions
385:         {

387:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium,
388:             FullWidth = true,
389:             Position = DialogPosition.Center
390:         };
391: 
392:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Components.EventRegistration>(
393:             "Register",
394:             parameters,
395:             options
396:         );
397: 
398:         var result = await dialog.Result;
399: 
400:         if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
401:         {
402:             Logger.LogInformation("Registration completed for session {SessionId}", session.Id);
403:             Snackbar.Add($"Successfully registered for {session.Title}!", Severity.Success);
404: 
405:

407:             {
408:                 await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
409:                 StateHasChanged();
410:             }
411:             return true;
412:         }
413:         return false;
414:     }
````

````markdown
  1: <a name="readme-top"></a>
  2: 
  3: <div align="center">
  4: 
  5: # ISLAMU Event
  6: 
  7: # Event Platform & Management System in Heavy Development
  8: 
  9: ISLAMU Event is a self-hostable, decentralized, multi-tenant event platform for any community or industry. 
 10: The ISLAMU organization hosts a public instance focused on Islamic events, but the software itself is purpose-agnostic, fully white-label, and designed to be rebranded for any use case.
 11: 
 12: ![GitHub Workflow Status][github-workflow-status-shield]
 13: [![Codecov][codecov-shield]][codecov-link]
 14: [![Quality Gate Status][sonarcloud-shield]][sonarcloud-link]
 15: [![GitHub License][github-license-shield]][github-license-link]
 16: [![GitHub Repo Stars][github-stars-shield]][github-stars-link]
 17: [![GitHub Last Commit][github-last-commit-shield]][github-last-commit-link]
 18: [![Contributors][github-contributors-shield]][github-contributors-link]
 19: [![Discussions][github-discussions-shield]][github-discussions-link]
 20: [![Discord][discord-shield]][discord-link]
 21: 
 22: [**ISLAMU's Islamic Instance**][islamu-platform] · [**Docs**](docs/index.md) · [**Roadmap**][roadmap-link]
 23: 
 24: </div>
 25: 
 26: ---
 27: 
 28: ## ℹ About ISLAMU Event
 29: 
 30: ISLAMU Event is an Event Platform & Management System built for both allowing the best Event Discovery and Event Management Experience.
 31: 
 32: > Give us a Star ⭐️
 33: 
 34: - **The software is general-purpose**: it can be used for any kind of Events, Communities, and Organizations.
 35: - **The ISLAMU-hosted instance is Islamic-focused**: ISLAMU’s public instance is curated for Islamic Events and Community needs.
 36: 
 37: ## ✨ Why ISLAMU Event
 38: 
 39: ### Key Differentiators
 40: 
 41: - **🌍 Decentralized by Design:** Federation-ready architecture with ATProto / ActivityPub planned
 42: - **🔐 Privacy-First:** Self-hostable with complete data ownership
 43: - **🎯 Cultural Intelligence:** Advanced filtering by madhab, gender, age, and prayer times
 44: - **🛡️ Verified Organizations:** Two-tier verification system for trust and quality
 45: - **Runtime Mode Switching** Single-tenant ↔ Multi-tenant without code changes
 46: - **Policy-Based Rendering** Blazor render modes controlled by policy, not hardcoded
 47: - **📖 Open Source:** AGPL-3.0 licensed for transparency and community ownership
 48: 
 49: ---
 50: 
 51: ## 🎯 Core Features
 52: 
 53: ### For Event Seekers
 54: 
 55: - **🔍 Powerful discovery** Search & filter events with location, category, language, and time filters
 56: - **👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Culturally-aware filters** (e.g., audience, gender, prayer-relative timing) for instances that need them
 57: - **🌐 Multi-language support** for global communities
 58: - **📱 Mobile-friendly experience** across devices
 59: 
 60: ### For Event Organizers
 61: 
 62: - **📅 Multi-session events** for conferences, seminars, and recurring programs
 63: - **✅ Verification system** to build trust and credibility
 64: - **📊 Analytics and engagement tracking** for organizers
 65: - **Flexible publishing policies** (open, approval-based, or invite-only)
 66: - **Event Extensibility** 
 67: 
 68: ### For Platform Owners
 69: 
 70: - **🐳 Docker-Ready** One-command deployment with docker-compose
 71: - **💼 Single or Multi-Tenancy Support**
 72: - **🛠️ Full white-label control** (branding, domain, instance identity)
 73: - **Configurable policies** Choose who can publish, verification criteria, categories, and more
 74: - **Federation-ready architecture** with ATProto / ActivityPub planned
 75: - **📚 Comprehensive Docs** for deployment, customization, and operation
 76: 
 77: ##  Deployment & Hosting Options
 78: 
 79: This platform is designed to be flexible and self-hostable for any organization.
 80: 
 81: - **Single-Instance Mode**: One organization or community per deployment
 82: - **Multi-Tenant SaaS Mode**: Multiple isolated tenants with custom domains and branding
 83: 
 84: See [Operations Guide][operations-doc] for full deployment details and examples.
 85: 
 86: ## 🎨 Branding & Customization
 87: 
 88: ISLAMU Event is built for white-label use:
 89: 
 90: - **Change instance name and domain**
 91: - **Customize logos, colors, and UI**
 92: - **Define your own categories, tags, and policies**
 93: - **Decide who can publish events and how verification works**
 94: 
 95: See [Configuration Guide][configuration-doc] for full customization options.
 96: 
 97: ## 🛡️ Enterprise Security & Compliance
 98: 
 99: We treat security as a first-class citizen, not an afterthought.
100: 
101: * **Identity & Access:** Managed via **Keycloak**, supporting MFA, Social Login, and SAML/LDAP integration.
102: * **Authorization:** Fine-grained access control (FGAC) powered by **Cerbos**: Policy Decision Point that coordinates unified policy-based authorization, allowing for complex "Who can do what" logic with human readable yaml for non technical users.
103: * **Data Integrity:** All database interactions use **Parameterized EF Core queries** to eliminate SQL injection.
104: * **Secret Management:** Zero hardcoded credentials; all secrets are injected at runtime via **Infisical**.
105: * **Observability:** Integrated **OpenTelemetry** for distributed tracing and real-time security monitoring.
106: 
107: ### Security Features
108: 
109: - **🔒 HTTPS Enforcement:** All traffic encrypted with HSTS
110: - **🔐 Modern Authentication:** OAuth 2.0/OIDC via Keycloak
111: - **🗝️ Secret Management:** Infisical vault for credentials
112: - **🛡️ Authorization:** Policy-based access control via Cerbos
113: - **🔍 Input Validation:** FluentValidation + ASP.NET Core model binding
114: - **🚫 SQL Injection Prevention:** Parameterized queries (EF Core)
115: - **🌐 CORS:** Configurable origin whitelist
116: - **⏱️ Rate Limiting:** ASP.NET Core middleware
117: 
118: ### Extensibility Model
119: 
120: Events use **composition over inheritance**:
121: 
122: ```
123: Event (Core)
124:   ├── IslamicDetails (optional aspect)
125:   ├── TechDetails (optional aspect)
126:   └── EducationalDetails (optional aspect)
127: ```
128: 
129: A "Ramadan Tech Workshop" has both Islamic and Tech aspects. No class explosion.
130: 
131: See [EXTENSIBILITY.md](docs/EXTENSIBILITY.md) and [MODULAR_EVENTS.md](docs/MODULAR_EVENTS.md).
132: 
133: ## 🚀 Quick Start
134: 
135: ### 🌐 Use Our Hosted Instance
136: 
137: Visit **[event.openislamu.org](https://event.openislamu.org)** to: 
138: - Browse events (no account needed)
139: - Create account to post events
140: - Register for events
141: - Follow organizations
142: 
143: ### 🖥️ Self-Host Your Instance (Advanced)
144: 
145: ```bash
146: # Clone the repository
147: git clone [https://github.com/islamu-ngo/Explore.git](https://github.com/islamu-ngo/Explore.git) && cd Explore
148: 
149: # Start without Object Storage (API, DB, Auth, UI...) And provide the secrets inside the Admin UI for Object Storage! 
150: docker-compose up -d
151: 
152: # Start the full stack (API, DB, Auth, UI, Object Storage...)
153: docker-compose up --profile storage -d
154: 
155: 
156: ```
157: 
158: See [Operations Guide][operations-doc] for full deployment instructions.

229: ## 🏗️ Technical Overview
230: 
231: ISLAMU Event is built on **Clean Architecture + CQRS** with a **BFF (Backend-for-Frontend)** pattern.
232: 
233: ### Stack
234: 
235: [- **Backend**: .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, MediatR, EF Core
236: - **Frontend**: Blazor Server + WASM, MudBlazor
237: - **Database**: PostgreSQL + PostGIS
238: - **AuthN**: Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth2)(Core: .NET 10 (LTS) & ASP.NET Core
239: - **AuthZ**: Cerbos (Policy Decision Point)
240: - **Secrets**: Infisical Vault
241: - **Observability**: Serilog, OpenTelemetry
242: 
243: ### The Request Lifecycle (CQRS)
244: We utilize **MediatR** for a decoupled command/query pipeline. This ensures that our business logic is isolated from transport layers (API/Blazor).
245: 
246: ```mermaid
247: graph TD
248:     subgraph Client_Layer [Presentation]
249:         A[Blazor WASM / Mobile] -->|HTTPS/REST| B[ASP.NET Core API]
250:     end
251: 
252:     subgraph Application_Layer [Business Logic]
253:         B -->|Command/Query| C[MediatR Pipeline]
254:         C -->|Validation| D[FluentValidation]
255:         D -->|Execution| E[Domain Handler]
256:     end
257: 
258:     subgraph Infrastructure_Layer [Data & Services]
259:         E -->|EF Core| F[(PostgreSQL + PostGIS)]
260:         E -->|OIDC| G[Keycloak]
261:         E -->|Events| H[Svix Webhooks]
262:     end
263: 
264:     E -.->|Future| I[ATProto / ActivityPub Gateway]
265: ```
266: 
267: ```mermaid
268: graph LR
269:     A[Request] --> B[Controller]
270:     B --> C[MediatR]
271:     C --> D[Handler]
272:     D --> E[Repository]
273:     E --> F[(PostgreSQL)]
274:     D --> G[Response]
275: ```
276:
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/User/Settings.razor
````razor
 1: @page "/settings"
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components
 6: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
 7: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
 8: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
 9: @attribute [Authorize]
10: 
11: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Medium" Class="mt-4">
12:     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" GutterBottom="true">Settings</MudText>
13: 
14:     @if (_loading)
15:     {
16:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Class="d-block mx-auto" />
17:     }
18:     else if (_user == null)
19:     {
20:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">Failed to load user profile.</MudAlert>
21:     }
22:     else
23:     {
24:         <MudCard>
25:             <MudCardHeader>
26:                 <CardHeaderContent>
27:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Personal Information</MudText>
28:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Update your personal details here.</MudText>
29:                 </CardHeaderContent>
30:             </MudCardHeader>
31:             <MudCardContent>
32:                 <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="_success">
33:                     <div class="mb-6">
34:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="mb-4">Profile Picture</MudText>
35:                         <ImageUpload @bind-PreviewUrl="_profileImagePreview"
36:                                    FileSelected="OnProfileImageSelected"
37:                                    PlaceholderText="Select a new profile picture"
38:                                    UploadButtonText="Upload Picture"
39:                                    HintText="JPG, GIF or PNG. Max size of 800K" />
40:                     </div>
41: 
42:                     <MudGrid>
43:                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
44:                             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.FirstName" Label="First Name" Required="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
45:                         </MudItem>
46:                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
47:                             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.LastName" Label="Last Name" Required="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
48:                         </MudItem>
49:                         <MudItem xs="12">
50:                             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Username" Label="Username" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
51:                         </MudItem>
52:                         <MudItem xs="12">
53:                             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Email" Label="Email" Variant="Variant.Outlined" ReadOnly="true" />
54:                         </MudItem>
55:                     </MudGrid>
56:                     <div class="d-flex justify-end mt-4">
57:                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="SaveSettings" Disabled="@(!_success || _isSaving)" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Save">
58:                             @if (_isSaving)
59:                             {
60:                                 <MudProgressCircular Class="ms-n1" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
61:                                 <MudText Class="ms-2">Saving</MudText>
62:                             }
63:                             else
64:                             {
65:                                 <MudText>Save Changes</MudText>
66:                             }
67:                         </MudButton>
68:                     </div>
69:                 </MudForm>
70:             </MudCardContent>
71:         </MudCard>
72:     }
73: </MudContainer>
````

````csharp
 59: public class AdminService : IAdminService

 61:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;

 63: 
 64:     public AdminService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<AdminService> logger)
 65:     {
 66:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 67:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     public async Task<HalCollectionResourceOfOrganizationListDto?> GetOrganizationRequestsAsync()
 71:     {
 72:         try
 73:         {
 74:             return await _apiClient.GetOrganizationsAsync(pageNumber: 1, pageSize: 100);
 75:         }
 76:         catch (ApiException ex)
 77:         {
 78:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[ADMIN SERVICE] API error fetching organizations: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 79:             return null;
 80:         }
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     public async Task<HalResourceOfOrganizationDto?> GetOrganizationDetailsAsync(Guid id)
 84:     {
 85:         try
 86:         {
 87:             return await _apiClient.GetOrganizationByIdAsync(id);
 88:         }
 89:         catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 404)
 90:         {
 91:             _logger.LogWarning("[ADMIN SERVICE] Organization not found: {OrganizationId}", id);
 92:             return null;
 93:         }
 94:         catch (ApiException ex)
 95:         {
 96:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[ADMIN SERVICE] API error fetching organization details: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 97:             return null;
 98:         }
 99:     }

101:     public async Task<bool> ApproveOrganizationAsync(Guid id)
102:     {
103:         try
104:         {
105:             var updateDto = new UpdateOrganizationApprovalStatusDto { Status = ApprovalStatus.Approved };
106:             await _apiClient.UpdatestatustypeAsync(id, updateDto);
107:             return true;
108:         }
109:         catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode is 204 or 200)
110:         {
111:             return true;
112:         }
113:         catch (Exception ex)
114:         {
115:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[ADMIN SERVICE] Error approving organization");
116:             return false;
117:         }
118:     }
````

````razor
249: 
250:                         <!-- Categories -->

370:     private ICollection<VisibilityTypeListDto>? visibilityTypes;
371:     private ICollection<MadhabListDto>? madhabs;
372:     private ICollection<CategoryListDto>? allCategories;
373:     private ICollection<TagListDto>? allTags;
374: 
375:     // Nullable Event properties

380:     private IEnumerable<Guid> selectedCategoryIds = new HashSet<Guid>();
381:     private IEnumerable<Guid> selectedTagIds = new HashSet<Guid>();
382:     private ICollection<CategoryListDto>? existingCategories;
383:     private ICollection<TagListDto>? existingTags;

393:     private ImageUpload? _imageUploadComponent;
394:     private string? _uploadError;

396:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
397:     {
398:         // Get route parameter from Blazouter
399:         var eventIdStr = RouterState.GetParam("eventId");
400:         if (Guid.TryParse(eventIdStr, out var id))
401:         {
402:             EventId = id;
403:         }
404: 
405:         try
406:         {
407:             isLoading = true;
408: 
409:             // Load lookups in parallel
410:             var eventTypesTask = AdminService.GetEventTypesAsync();
411:             var eventFormatsTask = AdminService.GetEventFormatsAsync();
412:             var eventStatusesTask = AdminService.GetEventStatusesAsync();
413:             var visibilityTypesTask = AdminService.GetVisibilityTypesAsync();
414:             var madhabsTask = AdminService.GetMadhabsAsync();
415: 
416:             await Task.WhenAll(eventTypesTask, eventFormatsTask, eventStatusesTask, visibilityTypesTask, madhabsTask);
417: 
418:             eventTypes = await eventTypesTask;
419:             eventFormats = await eventFormatsTask;
420:             eventStatuses = await eventStatusesTask;
421:             visibilityTypes = await visibilityTypesTask;
422:             madhabs = await madhabsTask;
423: 
424:             currentEvent = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(EventId);
425: 
426:             if (currentEvent != null)
427:             {
428:                 // Initialize updateDto from currentEvent
429:                 updateDto = new UpdateEventDto
430:                 {
431:                     Id = currentEvent.Id,
432:                     Title = currentEvent.Title,
433:                     Description = currentEvent.Description,
434:                     AudienceGenderId = currentEvent.AudienceGenderId,
435:                     AudienceAgeId = currentEvent.AudienceAgeId,
436:                     Price = currentEvent.Price,
437:                     CurrencyCode = currentEvent.CurrencyCode,
438:                     FeaturedImageId = currentEvent.FeaturedImageId,
439:                     IsRegistrationRequired = currentEvent.IsRegistrationRequired,
440:                     ExternalRegistrationUrl = currentEvent.EventUrl,
441:                     EventTypeId = currentEvent.EventTypeId,
442:                     EventFormatId = currentEvent.EventFormatId,
443:                     EventStatusId = currentEvent.EventStatusId,
444:                     VisibilityTypeId = currentEvent.VisibilityTypeId,
445:                     FirstSessionDate = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate,
446:                     LastSessionDate = currentEvent.LastSessionDate
447:                 };
448: 
449:                 // Initialize date/time pickers
450:                 if (currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.HasValue)
451:                 {
452:                     var localStart = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
453:                     _startDate = localStart.Date;
454:                     _startTime = localStart.TimeOfDay;
455:                 }
456: 
457:                 if (currentEvent.LastSessionDate.HasValue)
458:                 {
459:                     var localEnd = currentEvent.LastSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
460:                     _endDate = localEnd.Date;
461:                     _endTime = localEnd.TimeOfDay;
462:                 }
463: 
464:                 // Determine if online based on format
465:                 _isOnline = currentEvent.EventFormatId == 2; // Assuming 2 = Online
466: 
467:                 // Set preview to existing featured image if available
468:                 _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri ?? GeneratePlaceholderImage();
469: 
470:                 // Set nullable properties
471:                 selectedMadhabId = currentEvent.MadhabId;
472:                 selectedTimezone = currentEvent.Timezone;
473: 
474:                 // Load categories and tags in parallel
475:                 var allCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
476:                 var allTagsTask = TagService.GetAllTagsAsync();
477:                 var eventCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetCategoriesByEventAsync(EventId);
478:                 var eventTagsTask = TagService.GetTagsByEventAsync(EventId);
479:                 var sessionsTask = EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
480: 
481:                 await Task.WhenAll(allCategoriesTask, allTagsTask, eventCategoriesTask, eventTagsTask, sessionsTask);
482: 
483:                 allCategories = await allCategoriesTask;
484:                 allTags = await allTagsTask;
485:                 existingCategories = await eventCategoriesTask;
486:                 existingTags = await eventTagsTask;
487:                 var eventSessions = await sessionsTask;
488: 
489:                 // Set selected categories and tags
490:                 selectedCategoryIds = existingCategories?.Select(c => c.Id).ToHashSet() ?? new HashSet<Guid>();
491:                 selectedTagIds = existingTags?.Select(t => t.Id).ToHashSet() ?? new HashSet<Guid>();
492: 
493:                 // Convert sessions to editor models
494:                 sessions = eventSessions?.Select(s => SessionEditorModel.FromDto(s)).ToList() ?? new List<SessionEditorModel>();
495:             }
496:             else
497:             {
498:                 Snackbar.Add("Event not found", Severity.Error);
499:                 Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
500:             }
501:         }
502:         catch (Exception ex)
503:         {
504:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading event: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
505:             Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
506:         }
507:         finally
508:         {
509:             isLoading = false;
510:         }
511:     }

513:     private void SetEventType(bool isOnline)
514:     {
515:         if (updateDto != null)
516:         {
517:             // For now, we don't have IsOnline in UpdateEventDto
518:             // This would require backend updates
519:             StateHasChanged();
520:         }
521:     }

523:     private string GeneratePlaceholderImage()
524:     {
525:         if (currentEvent == null) return string.Empty;
526: 
527:         var eventTitle = Uri.EscapeDataString(currentEvent.Title ?? "Event");
528:         var backgroundColor = GetCategoryColor();
529:         return $"https://via.placeholder.com/400x250/{backgroundColor}/ffffff?text={eventTitle}";
530:     }
531: 
532:     private string GetCategoryColor()
533:     {
534:         return currentEvent?.EventTypeFullName?.ToLower() switch
535:         {
536:             var s when s?.Contains("conference") == true => "2196F3",
537:             var s when s?.Contains("workshop") == true => "FF9800",
538:             var s when s?.Contains("webinar") == true => "4CAF50",
539:             var s when s?.Contains("seminar") == true => "E91E63",
540:             var s when s?.Contains("training") == true => "9C27B0",
541:             _ => "607D8B"
542:         };
543:     }
544: 
545:     private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
546:     {
547:         if (updateDto == null) return;
548: 
549:         // Don't allow submit while image is uploading
550:         if (_isUploadingImage)
551:         {
552:             Snackbar.Add("Please wait for the image upload to complete.", Severity.Warning);
553:             return;
554:         }
555: 
556:         try
557:         {
558:             // Update dates - use DateTimeHelper for consistent UTC conversion
559:             updateDto.FirstSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_startDate, _startTime);
560:             updateDto.LastSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_endDate, _endTime);
561: 
562:             // If a new image was uploaded and a storage object id exists, update featured image id
563:             if (_uploadedStorageObjectId.HasValue)
564:             {
565:                 updateDto.FeaturedImageId = _uploadedStorageObjectId.Value;
566:             }
567: 
568:             var response = await EventService.UpdateEventAsync(updateDto.Id, updateDto);
569: 
570:             if (response?.Success == true)
571:             {
572:                 Snackbar.Add("Event updated successfully!", Severity.Success);
573:                 Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
574:             }
575:             else
576:             {
577:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Failed to update event", Severity.Error);
578:             }
579:         }
580:         catch (Exception ex)
581:         {
582:             Snackbar.Add($"Error updating event: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
583:         }
584:     }
585: 
586:     private void NavigateBack()
587:     {
588:         Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
589:     }
590: 
591:     /// <summary>
592:     /// Handles file selection with FileUploadData (bytes already in memory).
593:     /// This is the preferred method for reliable uploads in Blazor WASM.
594:     /// </summary>
595:     private async Task OnImageFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
596:     {
597:         Logger.LogInformation("[EventEdit] OnImageFileDataSelected called with fileData={HasData}", fileData != null);
598: 
599:         _selectedFileData = fileData;
600:         _uploadError = null;
601: 
602:         if (fileData == null)
603:         {
604:             // File was removed - keep existing image unless user explicitly removes
605:             Logger.LogInformation("[EventEdit] Image selection cleared");
606:             return;
607:         }
608: 
609:         _isUploadingImage = true;
610:         Logger.LogInformation("[EventEdit] Setting _isUploadingImage=true, calling StateHasChanged...");
611:         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
612: 
613:         try
614:         {
615:             Logger.LogInformation("[EventEdit] Starting upload for {FileName} ({Size} bytes)", fileData.FileName, fileData.Size);
616: 
617:             // Upload the image using the bytes-based method (avoids stream issues)
618:             Logger.LogInformation("[EventEdit] Calling ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync...");
619:             var uploadResult = await ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(fileData);
620:             Logger.LogInformation("[EventEdit] Upload result: Success={Success}, StorageObjectId={Id}, Error={Error}",
621:                 uploadResult?.Success, uploadResult?.StorageObjectId, uploadResult?.ErrorMessage);
622: 
623:             if (uploadResult?.Success == true)
624:             {
625:                 _uploadedStorageObjectId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
626:                 _uploadError = null;
627:                 Logger.LogInformation("[EventEdit] Featured image uploaded successfully. StorageObjectId: {StorageObjectId}", uploadResult.StorageObjectId);
628:                 Snackbar.Add("Image uploaded successfully!", Severity.Success);
629:             }
630:             else
631:             {
632:                 var errorMsg = uploadResult?.ErrorMessage ?? "Failed to upload image. Please try again.";
633:                 Logger.LogWarning("[EventEdit] Image upload failed: {ErrorMessage}", errorMsg);
634:                 _uploadError = errorMsg;
635:                 Snackbar.Add(errorMsg, Severity.Error);
636: 
637:                 // Clear the preview and selected file on failure
638:                 await ClearUploadState();
639:             }
640:         }
641:         catch (Exception ex)
642:         {
643:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during image upload for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
644:             _uploadError = $"Upload error: {ex.Message}";
645:             Snackbar.Add("An error occurred while uploading the image", Severity.Error);
646: 
647:             // Clear on error
648:             await ClearUploadState();
649:         }
650:         finally
651:         {
652:             _isUploadingImage = false;
653:             await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
654:         }
655:     }
656: 
657:     /// <summary>
658:     /// Clears the upload state on error or cancellation.
659:     /// </summary>
660:     private async Task ClearUploadState()
661:     {
662:         try
663:         {
664:             if (_imageUploadComponent != null)
665:             {
666:                 await _imageUploadComponent.RemoveImage();
667:             }
668:         }
669:         catch (Exception ex)
670:         {
671:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error clearing image upload component");
672:         }
673: 
674:         _selectedFileData = null;
675:         // Don't clear _uploadedStorageObjectId - keep existing image ID if there was one
676:         // Only set _previewImageUrl back to existing image
677:         if (currentEvent != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri))
678:         {
679:             _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri;
680:         }
681:         else
682:         {
683:             _previewImageUrl = GeneratePlaceholderImage();
684:         }
685:     }
686: 
687:     // Session management methods
688:     private void AddSession()
689:     {
690:         sessions.Add(new SessionEditorModel
691:         {
692:             StartTime = _startDate?.Date.Add(_startTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(9),
693:             EndTime = _endDate?.Date.Add(_endTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(17)
694:         });
695:     }
696: 
697:     private void RemoveSession(int index)
698:     {
699:         if (sessions.Count > 0 && index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
700:         {
701:             sessions.RemoveAt(index);
702:         }
703:     }
704: 
705:     private void OnSessionChanged(int index, SessionEditorModel session)
706:     {
707:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
708:         {
709:             sessions[index] = session;
710:         }
711:     }
712: 
713:     // Category/Tag selection text helpers
714:     private string GetCategorySelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
715:     {
716:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any())
717:             return "Select categories";
718: 
719:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} categor{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "y" : "ies")} selected";
720:     }
721: 
722:     private string GetTagSelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
723:     {
724:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any())
725:             return "Select tags";
726: 
727:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} tag{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "" : "s")} selected";
728:     }
729: }
````

````razor
239:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
240:                                 <strong>Review Process:</strong><br />
241:                                 • Your organization request will be submitted for admin review<br />
242:                                 • We'll verify your company registration and contact information<br />
243:                                 • You'll receive an email notification within 3-5 business days<br />
244:                                 • Once approved, you can start creating and managing events
245:                             </MudText>
246:                         </MudAlert>
247:                         break;
248:                 }
249:             </EditForm>
250:         </MudCardContent>
251: 
252:         <MudCardActions Class="justify-space-between pa-4">
253:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
254:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
255:                        OnClick="@(async () => await (currentStep == 0 ? GoBack() : GoToPreviousStep()))"
256:                        Disabled="@(currentStep == 0)">
257:                 @(currentStep == 0 ? "Cancel" : "Previous")
258:             </MudButton>
259: 
260:             @if (currentStep < 2)
261:             {
262:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
263:                            Color="Color.Primary"
264:                            EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward"
265:                            OnClick="@(async () => await GoToNextStep())">
266:                     Next
267:                 </MudButton>
268:             }
269:             else
270:             {
271:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
272:                            Color="Color.Primary"
273:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Send"
274:                            OnClick="@(async () => await HandleSubmit())"
275:                            Disabled="@(!CanSubmit() || isSubmitting)">
276:                     @if (isSubmitting)
277:                     {
278:                         <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate />
279:                         <span class="ml-2">Submitting...</span>
280:                     }
281:                     else
282:                     {
283:                         <span>Submit for Review</span>
284:                     }
285:                 </MudButton>
286:             }
287:         </MudCardActions>
288:     </MudCard>
289: </MudContainer>
````

````razor
158:             </MudItem>
159:         </MudGrid>
160:     </MudContainer>
161: }
````

````csharp
 45: public class OrganizationService : IOrganizationService

 50:     public OrganizationService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<OrganizationService> logger)
 51:     {
 52:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 53:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 54:     }

 62:         }
 63:         catch (ApiException ex)

 65:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error creating organization: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 66:             throw;

 72:     {

 75:             return await _apiClient.ApprovalStatusAllAsync();

 77:         catch (Exception ex)

 79:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error fetching status types");
 80:             return new List<StatusTypeListDto>();

112: 
113:     public async Task<HalResourceOfOrganizationDto?> GetOrganizationByIdAsync(Guid id)
114:     {
115:         try
116:         {
117:             return await _apiClient.GetOrganizationByIdAsync(id);
118:         }
119:         catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 404)
120:         {
121:             _logger.LogWarning("Organization not found: {OrganizationId}", id);
122:             return null;
123:         }
124:         catch (ApiException ex)
125:         {
126:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error fetching organization {OrganizationId}: {StatusCode}", id, ex.StatusCode);
127:             return null;
128:         }
129:     }
130: 
131: 
132:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> UpdateOrganizationAsync(Guid id, UpdateOrganizationDto organization)
133:     {
134:         try
135:         {
136:             return await _apiClient.UpdateOrganizationAsync(id, organization);
137:         }
138:         catch (ApiException ex)
139:         {
140:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error updating organization {OrganizationId}: {StatusCode}", id, ex.StatusCode);
141:             throw;
142:         }
143:     }
144: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventList.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/events"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event
  6: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  7: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  8: 
  9: <PageTitle>Explore Events</PageTitle>
 10: 
 11: <MudContainer Class="event-list__wrapper" MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge">
 12:     <!-- Filters Container - Single Row -->
 13:     <div class="event-list__filters-container">
 14:         <!-- Date -->
 15:         <MudSelect T="string" Value="@selectedDate" ValueChanged="@((string d) => OnDateChanged(d))" 
 16:                    Label="Date" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
 17:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Class="event-list__filter-item">
 18:             <MudSelectItem Value="@("")">Any Time</MudSelectItem>
 19:             <MudSelectItem Value="@("today")">Today</MudSelectItem>
 20:             <MudSelectItem Value="@("tomorrow")">Tomorrow</MudSelectItem>
 21:             <MudSelectItem Value="@("thisweek")">This Week</MudSelectItem>
 22:             <MudSelectItem Value="@("thismonth")">This Month</MudSelectItem>
 23:         </MudSelect>
 24: 
 25:         <!-- Category -->
 26:         <MudSelect T="Guid?" Value="@selectedCategoryId" ValueChanged="@(async (Guid? c) => await OnCategoryChanged(c))" 
 27:                    Label="Category" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
 28:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true" Class="event-list__filter-item">
 29:             <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@((Guid?)null)">All Categories</MudSelectItem>
 30:             @if (categories != null)
 31:             {
 32:                 @foreach (var category in categories)
 33:                 {
 34:                     <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@category.Id">@category.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 35:                 }
 36:             }
 37:         </MudSelect>
 38: 
 39:         <!-- Location -->
 40:         <MudSelect T="Guid?" Value="@selectedLocationId" ValueChanged="@((Guid? l) => OnLocationChanged(l))" 
 41:                    Label="Location" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
 42:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true" Class="event-list__filter-item">
 43:             <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@((Guid?)null)">All Locations</MudSelectItem>
 44:             @if (locations != null)
 45:             {
 46:                 @foreach (var location in locations)
 47:                 {
 48:                     <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@location.Id">@location.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 49:                 }
 50:             }
 51:         </MudSelect>
 52: 
 53:         <!-- Format -->
 54:         <MudSelect T="int?" Value="@selectedFormatId" ValueChanged="@((int? f) => OnFormatChanged(f))" 
 55:                    Label="Format" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
 56:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true" Class="event-list__filter-item">
 57:             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)null)">All Formats</MudSelectItem>
 58:             @if (eventFormats != null)
 59:             {
 60:                 @foreach (var format in eventFormats)
 61:                 {
 62:                     <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@format.Id">@format.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 63:                 }
 64:             }
 65:         </MudSelect>
 66:         
 67:         <!-- Madhab -->
 68:         <MudSelect T="int?" Value="@selectedMadhabId" ValueChanged="@((int? m) => OnMadhabChanged(m))" 
 69:                    Label="Madhab" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
 70:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true" Class="event-list__filter-item">
 71:             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)null)">All Madhabs</MudSelectItem>
 72:             @if (madhabs != null)
 73:             {
 74:                 @foreach (var madhab in madhabs)
 75:                 {
 76:                     <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@madhab.Id">@madhab.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 77:                 }
 78:             }
 79:         </MudSelect>
 80:         
 81:         <!-- Registration Mode -->
 82:         <MudSelect T="int?" Value="@selectedRegistrationModeId" ValueChanged="@((int? r) => OnRegistrationModeChanged(r))" 
 83:                    Label="Registration" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
 84:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true" Class="event-list__filter-item">
 85:             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)null)">All Modes</MudSelectItem>
 86:             @if (registrationModes != null)
 87:             {
 88:                 @foreach (var mode in registrationModes)
 89:                 {
 90:                     <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@mode.Id">@mode.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 91:                 }
 92:             }
 93:         </MudSelect>
 94:         
 95:         <!-- Language -->
 96:         <MudSelect T="int?" Value="@selectedLanguageId" ValueChanged="@((int? l) => OnLanguageChanged(l))" 
 97:                    Label="Language" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
 98:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true" Class="event-list__filter-item">
 99:             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)null)">All Languages</MudSelectItem>
100:             @if (languages != null)
101:             {
102:                 @foreach (var language in languages)
103:                 {
104:                     <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@language.Id">@language.FullName</MudSelectItem>
105:                 }
106:             }
107:         </MudSelect>
108: 
109:         <!-- Tags -->
110:         <MudSelect T="Guid?" Value="@selectedTagId" ValueChanged="@(async (Guid? t) => await OnTagChanged(t))" 
111:                    Label="Tags" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" 
112:                    AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true" Class="event-list__filter-item">
113:             <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@((Guid?)null)">All Tags</MudSelectItem>
114:             @if (tags != null)
115:             {
116:                 @foreach (var tag in tags)
117:                 {
118:                     <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@tag.Id">@tag.FullName</MudSelectItem>
119:                 }
120:             }
121:         </MudSelect>
122:     </div>
123: 
124:     <!-- Cards -->
125:     <MudGrid Class="mt-4" Spacing="4">
126:         @if (isLoading && !allEvents.Any() || isLoadingCategory || isLoadingTag)
127:         {
128:             <!-- Skeleton loaders for loading feedback -->
129:             @for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
130:             {
131:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="6" lg="4" xl="3">
132:                     <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="event-list__card">
133:                         <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="200px" />
134:                         <MudCardContent>
135:                             <MudSkeleton Width="60%" Height="20px" Class="mb-2" />
136:                             <MudSkeleton Width="40%" Height="16px" Class="mb-2" />
137:                             <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="14px" Class="mb-1" />
138:                             <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="14px" Class="mb-1" />
139:                             <MudSkeleton Width="80%" Height="14px" />
140:                         </MudCardContent>
141:                     </MudCard>
142:                 </MudItem>
143:             }
144:         }
145:         else if (!FilteredEvents.Any())
146:         {

148:                 <div class="text-center">
149:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EventBusy" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-2" />
150:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Color="Color.Secondary">No events found</MudText>
151:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">
152:                         Try adjusting your filters or search query
153:                     </MudText>
154:                 </div>
155:             </MudItem>
156:         }
157:         else
158:         {
159:             @foreach (var evt in FilteredEvents)
160:             {
161:                 <!-- Adjusted Breakpoints: MD=6 (2 cols), LG=4 (3 cols - 1080p), XL=3 (4 cols - Ultrawide) -->
162:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="6" lg="4" xl="3">
163:                     <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="event-list__card">
164:                         <MudCardMedia Image="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.FeaturedImageUri) ? GetEventImage(evt) : evt.FeaturedImageUri)"
165:                                      Height="200"
166:                                      Class="event-list__card-media" />
167:                         <MudCardContent>
168:                             <div class="event-list__card-badges">
169:                                 <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Category">
170:                                     @GetEventTypeName(evt)
171:                                 </MudChip>
172:                                 <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn">
173:                                     @GetLocationText(evt)
174:                                 </MudChip>
175:                             </div>
176:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="event-list__card-title">@evt.Title</MudText>
177:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Surface" Class="event-list__card-description">
178:                                 @GetTruncatedDescription(evt.Description)
179:                             </MudText>
180:                             
181:                             <div class="event-list__card-meta">
182:                                 @if (evt.TotalViews > 0)
183:                                 {
184:                                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
185:                                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" /> 
186:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@evt.TotalViews</MudText>
187:                                     </div>
188:                                 }
189:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1 ml-auto">
190:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />

211:                                     Registered
212:                                 </MudButton>
213:                             }
214:                             else
215:                             {
216:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
217:                                            Size="Size.Small"
218:                                            Color="Color.Primary"
219:                                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EventAvailable"
220:                                            OnClick="@(() => OpenQuickRegisterDialog(evt))">
221:                                     Register
222:                                 </MudButton>
223:                             }
224:                         </MudCardActions>
225:                     </MudCard>
226:                 </MudItem>
227:             }
228:         }
229:     </MudGrid>
230: 
231:     <!-- Pagination + info -->

233:         <MudPagination Count="@TotalPages"
````
