````razor
235:                        SelectedChanged="@((int page) => OnPageChanged(page))"
236:                        Color="Color.Primary"
237:                        ShowFirstButton="true"
238:                        ShowLastButton="true" />
239:     </div>
240:     <div class="event-list__results">
241:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Surface">
242:             Showing @((currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage + 1) - @(Math.Min(currentPage * itemsPerPage, AllFilteredEvents.Count)) of @AllFilteredEvents.Count events
243:         </MudText>
244:     </div>
245: 
246: </MudContainer>
````

````razor
131:             </MudGrid>

133:     }
134: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/EventService.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: 
  4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  5: 
  6: public interface IEventService
  7: {
  8:     Task<HalCollectionResourceOfEventListDto?> GetAllEventsAsync();
  9:     Task<HalCollectionResourceOfEventListDto?> GetMyEventsAsync();
 10:     Task<HalResourceOfEventDto?> GetEventByIdAsync(Guid eventId);
 11:     Task<bool> DeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId);
 12:     Task<bool> CanDeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId);
 13:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> UpdateEventAsync(Guid eventId, UpdateEventDto eventDto);
 14:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> CreateEventAsync(CreateEventDto createDto);
 15:     Task<ICollection<EventTypeListDto>> GetEventTypesAsync();
 16:     Task<ICollection<EventFormatListDto>> GetEventFormatsAsync();
 17:     Task<HalCollectionResourceOfEventSessionListDto?> GetAllSessionsAsync();
 18:     Task<HalCollectionResourceOfEventSessionListDto?> GetSessionsByEventAsync(Guid eventId);
 19:     Task<ICollection<object>> GetAllSessionLanguagesAsync();
 20:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> CreateSessionAsync(CreateEventSessionDto session);
 21:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> UpdateSessionAsync(UpdateEventSessionDto session);
 22:     Task<bool> DeleteSessionAsync(Guid sessionId);
 23:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> AssignLanguageToSessionAsync(object sessionLanguage);
 24:     Task<bool> DeleteSessionLanguageAsync(int sessionLanguageId);
 25:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> RegisterForEventSessionAsync(CreateEventRegistrationDto registration);
 26:     Task<ICollection<EventRegistrationListDto>> GetRegistrationsForSessionAsync(Guid sessionId);
 27:     Task<ICollection<EventRegistrationListDto>> GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(Guid userId);
 28:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> UpdateRegistrationAsync(UpdateEventRegistrationDto registration);
 29:     Task<bool> CancelEventRegistrationAsync(Guid registrationId);
 30:     Task<HalResourceOfEventSessionDto?> GetSessionByIdAsync(Guid sessionId);
 31: }
 32: 
 33: public partial class EventService : IEventService
 34: {
 35:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;
 36:     private readonly IOrganizationService _organizationService;
 37:     private readonly ILogger<EventService> _logger;
 38: 
 39:     public EventService(
 40:         IEventApiClient apiClient,
 41:         IOrganizationService organizationService,
 42:         ILogger<EventService> logger)
 43:     {
 44:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 45:         _organizationService = organizationService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(organizationService));
 46:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     public Task<HalCollectionResourceOfEventListDto?> GetMyEventsAsync() => _apiClient.GetMyEventsAsync(1, 100);
 50: 
 51:     public Task<HalCollectionResourceOfEventListDto?> GetAllEventsAsync() => _apiClient.GetEventsAsync(1, 100);
 52: 
 53:     public Task<HalResourceOfEventDto?> GetEventByIdAsync(Guid eventId) => _apiClient.GetEventByIdAsync(eventId);
 54: 
 55:     public async Task<bool> DeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId)
 56:     {
 57:         try
 58:         {
 59:             await _apiClient.DeleteEventAsync(eventId);
 60:             return true;
 61:         }
 62:         catch (Exception ex)
 63:         {
 64:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting event {EventId}", eventId);
 65:             return false;
 66:         }
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     public async Task<bool> CanDeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId)
 70:     {
 71:         try
 72:         {
 73:             var eventResource = await _apiClient.GetEventByIdAsync(eventId);
 74:             if (eventResource?.Data?.ActorId is null) return false;
 75: 
 76:             var actorResource = await _apiClient.GetActorByIdAsync(eventResource.Data.ActorId);
 77:             if (actorResource?.Data?.OrganizationId is null) return true;
 78: 
 79:             var myOrgs = await _organizationService.GetMyOrganizationsAsync();
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/MyEvents.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/myevents"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event
  7: @attribute [Authorize]
  8: 
  9: <PageTitle>My Events</PageTitle>
 10: 
 11: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="my-events">
 12:     <!-- Header -->
 13:     <div class="my-events__header">
 14:         <div>
 15:             <MudText Typo="Typo.overline" Class="my-events__kicker">Manage</MudText>
 16:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5">My Events</MudText>
 17:         </div>
 18:         <div class="my-events__actions">
 19:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 20:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 21:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business"
 22:                        OnClick="NavigateToCreateOrganization">
 23:                 Create Organization
 24:             </MudButton>
 25:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 26:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 27:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 28:                        OnClick="NavigateToCreateEvent">
 29:                 Organize Event
 30:             </MudButton>
 31:         </div>
 32:     </div>
 33: 
 34:     @if (_isLoading)
 35:     {
 36:         <div class="my-events__loading">
 37:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 38:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">
 39:                 Loading your events...
 40:             </MudText>
 41:         </div>
 42:     }
 43:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 44:     {
 45:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="my-4">
 46:             @_errorMessage
 47:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Inherit" OnClick="RetryLoadAsync" Class="ml-4">
 48:                 Retry
 49:             </MudButton>
 50:         </MudAlert>
 51:     }
 52:     else
 53:     {
 54:         <!-- Filters -->
 55:         <div class="my-events__filters mb-4">
 56:             <!-- Organization Filter -->
 57:             <div class="my-events__filter-cell">
 58:                 <MudPopover Open="@_isOrganizationOpen" Fixed="true" Class="my-events__filter-popover px-4 py-3">
 59:                     <div class="my-events__filter-dropdown">
 60:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2">Organization</MudText>
 61:                         <div class="my-events__filter-options">
 62:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2"
 63:                                      Color="@(_selectedOrganizationId == Guid.Empty ? Color.Primary : Color.Default)"
 64:                                      Class="my-events__filter-option"
 65:                                      @onclick="@(() => OnOrganizationChanged(Guid.Empty))">
 66:                                 All Organizations
 67:                             </MudText>
 68:                             @foreach (var org in _myOrganizations)
 69:                             {
 70:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2"
 71:                                          Color="@(_selectedOrganizationId == org.Id ? Color.Primary : Color.Default)"
 72:                                          Class="my-events__filter-option"
 73:                                          @onclick="@(() => OnOrganizationChanged(org.Id))">
 74:                                     @org.FullName
 75:                                 </MudText>
 76:                             }
 77:                         </div>
 78:                     </div>
 79:                 </MudPopover>
 80:                 <MudPaper @onclick="ToggleOrganizationFilter" Class="my-events__filter-paper">
 81:                     <MudText Class="ml-2">@GetSelectedOrganizationName()</MudText>
 82:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.KeyboardArrowDown" />
 83:                 </MudPaper>
 84:             </div>
 85: 
 86:             <!-- Category Filter -->
 87:             <div class="my-events__filter-cell">
 88:                 <MudPopover Open="@_isCategoryOpen" Fixed="true" Class="my-events__filter-popover px-4 py-3">
 89:                     <div class="my-events__filter-dropdown">
 90:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2">Event Type</MudText>
 91:                         <div class="my-events__filter-options">
 92:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2"
 93:                                      Color="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedCategory) ? Color.Primary : Color.Default)"
 94:                                      Class="my-events__filter-option"
 95:                                      @onclick="@(() => OnCategoryChanged(""))">
 96:                                 All Types
 97:                             </MudText>
 98:                             @foreach (var eventType in UniqueEventTypes)
 99:                             {
100:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2"
101:                                          Color="@(_selectedCategory == eventType ? Color.Primary : Color.Default)"
102:                                          Class="my-events__filter-option"
103:                                          @onclick="@(() => OnCategoryChanged(eventType))">
104:                                     @eventType
105:                                 </MudText>
106:                             }
107:                         </div>
108:                     </div>
109:                 </MudPopover>
110:                 <MudPaper @onclick="ToggleCategoryFilter" Class="my-events__filter-paper">
111:                     <MudText Class="ml-2">@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedCategory) ? "All Types" : _selectedCategory)</MudText>
112:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.KeyboardArrowDown" />
113:                 </MudPaper>
114:             </div>
115: 
116:             <!-- Search -->
117:             <div class="my-events__filter-cell my-events__filter-cell--search">
118:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
119:                               Class="my-events__search-input"
120:                               Placeholder="Search events..."
121:                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
122:                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
123:                               Immediate="true"
124:                               DebounceInterval="300"
125:                               TextChanged="OnSearch"
126:                               Margin="Margin.Dense" />
127:             </div>
128:         </div>
129: 
130:         @if (!FilteredEvents.Any())
131:         {
132:             <div class="my-events__empty">
133:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Event" Class="my-events__empty-icon" />
134:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4">No events found</MudText>
135:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
136:                     @if (_events.Any())
137:                     {
138:                         <span>Try adjusting your filters</span>
139:                     }
140:                     else
141:                     {
142:                         <span>Create an event to get started</span>
143:                     }
144:                 </MudText>
145:             </div>
146:         }
147:         else
148:         {
149:             <!-- Event Cards -->
150:             <MudGrid Spacing="4">
151:                 @foreach (var evt in FilteredEvents)
152:                 {
153:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
154:                         <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="my-events__card">
155:                             <!-- Card Media -->
156:                             <MudCardMedia Image="@GetEventImageUrl(evt)"
157:                                           Height="200"
158:                                           Class="my-events__card-media" />
159: 
160:                             <!-- Actions Menu -->
161:                             <div class="my-events__actions-menu">
162:                                 <MudMenu Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MoreVert"
163:                                          Dense="true"
164:                                          Color="Color.Primary"
165:                                          Variant="Variant.Filled"
166:                                          Size="Size.Small">
167:                                     @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
168:                                     {
169:                                         <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => EditEvent(evt))">
170:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Edit
171:                                         </MudMenuItem>
172:                                     }
173:                                     <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => ViewEventDetails(evt))">
174:                                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> View Details
175:                                     </MudMenuItem>
176:                                     @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
177:                                     {
178:                                         <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => ViewRegistrations(evt))">

184:                                     }
185:                                 </MudMenu>
186:                             </div>
187: 
188:                             <MudCardContent>
189:                                 <div class="my-events__card-badges">
190:                                     <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary"
191:                                              StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Category">
192:                                         @(evt.EventTypeFullName ?? "Event")
193:                                     </MudChip>
194:                                     <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Info"
195:                                              Variant="Variant.Outlined"
196:                                              StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business">
197:                                         @(evt.ActorDisplayName ?? "Unknown")
198:                                     </MudChip>
199:                                 </div>
200:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="my-events__card-title">@evt.Title</MudText>
201:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="my-events__card-description">
202:                                     @evt.Description
203:                                 </MudText>
204:                             </MudCardContent>
205: 
206:                             <MudCardActions Class="my-events__card-actions">

208:                                            Color="Color.Primary"

210:                                            Disabled="@(!CanEditEvent(evt))"
211:                                            Size="Size.Small">
212:                                     Edit
213:                                 </MudButton>
214:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
215:                                            Color="Color.Primary"
216:                                            OnClick="@(() => ViewEventDetails(evt))"
217:                                            Size="Size.Small">
218:                                     View
219:                                 </MudButton>
220:                                 <div class="my-events__card-format">
221:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" />
222:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption">@(evt.EventFormatFullName ?? "Online")</MudText>
223:                                 </div>
224:                             </MudCardActions>
225:                             <div class="my-events__card-footer pa-4 pt-0">
226:                                 <div class="my-events__card-organizer">
227:                                     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.ActorProfilePictureUri))
228:                                     {
229:                                         <MudAvatar Size="Size.Small" Class="my-events__organizer-avatar">
230:                                             <MudImage Src="@evt.ActorProfilePictureUri" Alt="@evt.ActorDisplayName" />
231:                                         </MudAvatar>
232:                                     }
233:                                     else
234:                                     {
235:                                         <MudAvatar Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" Class="my-events__organizer-avatar">
236:                                             @GetActorInitials(evt.ActorDisplayName)
237:                                         </MudAvatar>
238:                                     }
239:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption">@(evt.ActorDisplayName ?? "Community")</MudText>
240:                                 </div>
241:                             </div>
242:                         </MudCard>
243:                     </MudItem>
244:                 }
245:             </MudGrid>
246: 
247:             <!-- Pagination -->
248:             <div class="my-events__pagination">
249:                 <MudPagination Count="@TotalPages"
250:                                Selected="@_currentPage"
251:                                SelectedChanged="OnPageChanged"
252:                                Color="Color.Primary"
253:                                ShowFirstButton="true"
254:                                ShowLastButton="true" />
255:             </div>
256:             <div class="my-events__results">
257:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
258:                     Showing @((_currentPage - 1) * ItemsPerPage + 1) - @Math.Min(_currentPage * ItemsPerPage, AllFilteredEvents.Count)
259:                     of @AllFilteredEvents.Count events
260:                 </MudText>
261:             </div>
262:         }
263:     }
264: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/User/MyRegistrations.razor
````razor
 1: @page "/my-registrations"
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
 6: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
 7: @attribute [Authorize]
 8: 
 9: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mt-4">
10:     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center mb-4">
11:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h4">My Registrations</MudText>
12:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack" Href="/user/profile">
13:             Back to Profile
14:         </MudButton>
15:     </div>
16: 
17:     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString" Placeholder="Search events..." Adornment="Adornment.Start" AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search" Class="mb-4" />
18: 
19:     @if (_loading)
20:     {
21:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Class="d-block mx-auto" />
22:     }
23:     else if (!FilteredRegistrations.Any())
24:     {
25:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Align="Align.Center">No registrations found.</MudText>
26:     }
27:     else
28:     {
29:         <MudGrid Spacing="4">
30:             @foreach (var reg in FilteredRegistrations)
31:             {
32:                 <!-- Adjusted grid to match EventList: LG=4 (3 cols), XL=3 (4 cols) -->
33:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="6" lg="4" xl="3">
34:                     <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="my-registrations__card">
35:                         <MudCardMedia Image="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(reg.FeaturedImageUri) ? $"https://placehold.co/600x400?text={Uri.EscapeDataString(reg.EventTitle ?? "Event")}" : reg.FeaturedImageUri)" 
36:                                       Height="180" 
37:                                       Class="my-registrations__card-media" />
38:                         <MudCardContent>
39:                             <div class="my-registrations__badges mb-2">
40:                                 <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="@(reg.StatusId == 2 ? Color.Success : (reg.StatusId == 3 ? Color.Error : Color.Warning))" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
41:                                     @(reg.Status ?? "Pending")
42:                                 </MudChip>
43:                             </div>
44:                             
45:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="my-registrations__card-title">@reg.EventTitle</MudText>
46:                             
47:                             <div class="my-registrations__card-meta mt-2">
48:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
49:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CalendarToday" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
50:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@reg.StartTime?.ToString("f")</MudText>
51:                                 </div>
52:                             </div>
53:                         </MudCardContent>
54:                         <MudCardActions Class="pa-3 pt-0 card-actions">
55:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" 
56:                                        Color="Color.Primary" 
57:                                        EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward"
58:                                        Href="@($"/event/detail/{reg.EventId}")"
59:                                        Size="Size.Small">
60:                                 Details
61:                             </MudButton>
62:                             <MudSpacer />
63:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" 
64:                                        Color="Color.Error" 
65:                                        OnClick="@(() => CancelRegistration(reg.RegistrationId))"
66:                                        Size="Size.Small">
67:                                 Cancel
68:                             </MudButton>
69:                         </MudCardActions>
70:                     </MudCard>
71:                 </MudItem>
72:             }
73:         </MudGrid>
74:     }
75: </MudContainer>
````

````razor
 86:                         }
````

````csharp
460: static string GetSafeReturnUrl(HttpContext ctx, ILogger logger)
461: {
462:     var returnUrl = ctx.Request.Query["returnUrl"].ToString();
463: 
464:     if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(returnUrl))
465:     {
466:         return "/";
467:     }
468: 
469:     if (returnUrl.StartsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
470:         !returnUrl.StartsWith("//", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
471:         !returnUrl.StartsWith("/\\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
472:     {
473:         return returnUrl;
474:     }
475: 
476:     logger.LogWarning("[AuthEndpoints] Invalid returnUrl '{ReturnUrl}' - defaulting to /", returnUrl);
477:     return "/";
478: }

480: // Authentication endpoints - using /auth/* paths to avoid conflict with Blazor routes
481: // The Blazor shim components at /login and /logout will force-load these server endpoints
482: app.MapGet("/auth/challenge", async ctx =>
483: {
484:     var returnUrl = GetSafeReturnUrl(ctx, app.Logger);
485: 
486:     app.Logger.LogInformation(
487:         "[AuthEndpoints] /auth/challenge hit - Url: {Url} ReturnUrl: {ReturnUrl}",
488:         ctx.Request.GetDisplayUrl(),
489:         returnUrl);
490: 
491:     try
492:     {
493:         await ctx.ChallengeAsync(
494:             OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,
495:             new AuthenticationProperties
496:             {
497:                 RedirectUri = returnUrl
498:             });
499:     }
500:     catch (Exception ex)
501:     {
502:         app.Logger.LogError(ex, "[AuthEndpoints] Error during login challenge");
503:         ctx.Response.StatusCode = 500;
504:         await ctx.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = "Login failed", details = ex.Message });
505:     }
506: });

508: app.MapGet("/auth/signout", async ctx =>

511: 
512:     app.Logger.LogInformation(
513:         "[AuthEndpoints] /auth/signout hit - Url: {Url} ReturnUrl: {ReturnUrl}",
514:         ctx.Request.GetDisplayUrl(),
515:         returnUrl);
516: 
517:     try
518:     {
519:         await ctx.SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
520:         await ctx.SignOutAsync(
521:             OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,
522:             new AuthenticationProperties { RedirectUri = returnUrl });
523:         app.Logger.LogInformation("[AuthEndpoints] Signout completed");
524:     }
525:     catch (Exception ex)
526:     {
527:         app.Logger.LogError(ex, "[AuthEndpoints] Error during signout");
528:         ctx.Response.StatusCode = 500;

530:     }
531: });
````
